One supplies the steady aim, the other the skill and the spark, and when the determination fails, what drains away first is exactly that enthusiasm, which is why these two rise and fall together.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Light
codon_ring.teaching: Within the Ring of Light, this code stands as the taming of the small. Its siblings, UL 5, 11, and 26, carry the rest of the ring's reach: the waiting, the peace, and the taming of the great. Bound by one amino acid, the four together work two of the highest themes a body can hold, time and light, the patient accumulation that finally turns boundless.

tarot.teaching: Five Arcana gather around this card, reached by two separate roads. The codon ring gives one Arcana, the Star, the quiet hope that keeps a person tending the small through a long darkness. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Wind above as the Wheel of Fortune and Death, the turning and the shedding; Heaven below as the Fool and the Empress, the first fearless step and the abundance it grows toward. The Star, the turning wheel, the shedding, the Fool and the Empress make one picture: a patient holding under a far hope, the strong force below learning to begin gently and to let what is finished fall away.

sky.teaching: the fixed air that holds a far vision steady, the sign that tends a distant hope across a long stretch without losing the thread.

immortals.teaching: He Xian Gu stands above, the one woman among the Eight, who carries a lotus and walks a path of purity and quiet refinement, and Han Xiangzi below, the flute-player whose music makes flowers bloom and whose art works by gentleness rather than force. Neither of them pushes. She refines what she is already holding, he plays until the flower opens on its own, and the small accumulating happens in exactly that space.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the patient drawing-up of what lies hidden below, meditation and the quiet line cast into deep water, the small steady pull that lands something far larger than itself. The path the ring's Star stands on.

keywords: At Ease in Your Own Skin
cards.essence: This energy is being yourself: at ease in your own skin, walking your own way, and it shows in how you move. Nobody is being performed for. You do the thing the way you do it, and nothing about it is heavy: a person walking as themselves has a lightness in the step that a performed walk never has.

glance.reading:
This energy is being yourself: at ease in your own skin, walking your own way, and it shows in how you move. Nobody is being performed for. You do the thing the way you do it, and nothing about it is heavy: a person walking as themselves has a lightness in the step that a performed walk never has.

Real ease has nothing to defend, because you have stopped holding a position on yourself. Easy is right, and those three words are the whole of it. Most people do not do easy: the harder you struggle the more you feel you exist, so the easy way is the one you pass every morning. What you do with ease has play in it, and people relax near it, because someone at home in themselves gives everyone else leave to be at home too.

Let the looking run down. There will be days when you cannot stop watching yourself, checking how you are coming across before you have said a word, and the checking is what stiffens the step. The easy road is there, seats along it, friends along it, and most people turn back from it because it asks so little. Walk the way you walk.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Lake: the whole of the sky, with a stretch of open water lying still and glad beneath it. Its creature is the tiger, whose tail you have stepped on, and the tiger does not bite. The old character shows a body with its repeating steps, one word for the path and for the way a person walks it.
iching.reading:
You are walking close to something that could hurt you: someone with power over you, or a moment with teeth in it. You will come through, and how you carry yourself while you are near it is the whole of the matter. Nothing here is won by being stronger than the strong thing. The tiger does not bite because there is no fear in the step, only a plain gladness at walking, and gladness provokes nothing.

What it asks is that you tell high from low and keep to your own place in it. Do not provoke what is bigger than you, and do not shrink from it either, because both are ways of watching it instead of walking. Say what is yours to say and no more. Keep your steps light, and want only what is already yours. This is the ground a life is built on, the way you behave when nobody is making you, and it either holds or it does not.

In the body the sky is the head and the lake is the mouth. Notice where you are holding yourself now: the head up and clear, the mouth easy, the weight not yet on the foot that is down. Walk as yourself, walk lightly, and the way that is dangerous becomes the way through.
judgement_lines: Treading on the tail of a tiger, and it does not bite.
It goes through.
image_lines: Heaven above, the lake below.
So the wise tell high from low, and give people something steady to set their hearts on.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
lower_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lines.image: plain shoes on the accustomed road, walking alone.
lines.reading: In plain shoes on the road you already know, you are not calling anyone's attention. Nothing is put on for the watchers and nothing above your place is wanted. This is not the hour to be noticed, or to ask for company. Walk it alone, wanting only what is yours, and there is no fault in going on.

lines.image: a level road, and someone quiet walking it apart from the crowd.
lines.reading: The road is level and wide, you have it to yourself, out past the crowd with all it wants. Whoever walks here has left the loud life for a quieter one, and is not lonely in it, because time spent with yourself is how you learn who to be. Keep straight, keep quiet, and do not call out for company. The road is the company.

lines.image: a squint called sight, a limp called a stride, and a bold foot on the tail.
lines.reading: Seeing with one eye, walking with a limp, you step on the tail as if you could see, and this time the tiger turns. You have taken on more than your strength, pushed by what is behind you into what is in front. Only a soldier fighting for his lord gets to be that reckless. Know the size of what you have, and step to it.

lines.image: the tail underfoot, and a wary tread.
lines.reading: Your foot is on the tail and you know it, which is the right kind of fear. Not the fright that freezes, which gets bitten, but a watchfulness that goes on walking, firm where it must be and soft everywhere else. A step checked before it lands is not a step lost. Go carefully all the way through, and it ends well.

lines.image: a fork in the road and a firm step taken at it.
lines.reading: At the fork you decide, and you walk your choice with your whole weight. Your footing is right, so is your place, and even so there is danger, because the higher you stand the further there is to fall. What was won by a clean choice is lost in the moment after by carelessness. Stay humble, stay watchful, and keep what you have gained.

lines.image: the whole road walked, looked back on from the top.
lines.reading: From the top you can see the whole road you came by, and what it tells is your fortune. Look at where you were glad, where you were not, and turn toward the glad, because a walk that matches its road is what luck is made of. If the treading was sound from first step to last, what comes round to you now is the best there is.

gene_keys.shadow:
Attention turned in on yourself, and stuck there, is where this energy starts. You walk into a room and the room is about you: how you are coming across, who you even are. Most of the time it hides in busyness: the hours filled with work or errands, the resting put off until Friday, until the holidays. At the end a life has gone by. Underneath is a fear of losing yourself, and the fear sends you looking. Who am I is the question. The search for an answer becomes a maze with plenty of drama in it and no way out, because the one thing the search makes sure of is that you never have to face yourself. As long as you are looking at yourself you cannot see anyone else, and everyone you look at becomes someone you would like to change.

Nothing here needs judging or fixing. See the pattern and add nothing to it. The search wears out on its own once it is seen, because what it was hunting was never a thing that could be found. What is left when it stops is you, unwatched.
gene_keys.repressive: This person has turned the attention off themselves so completely that nobody is home at the centre. Their life is lived for others, through others, and from outside it passes for kindness. It is compromise all the way down. Whatever authority they need they find in someone else, because looking in has been made unbearable.
gene_keys.reactive: Here is someone with no room in their life for anybody else. The fear of being lost lives in them as anger, and the anger goes at whoever might take their freedom. They cannot yield a part of themselves to anyone. They are in love with a self, and it is not the true one.
gene_keys.gift:
Being what you already are, with nothing put on, is the ease this energy is made for. You do the thing the way you do it, and the doing has play in it, the way a child draws. You are not your name, or your feelings, or anything else a label could be put on. Once that is felt the tightness around the question goes out of the body, and what was tied up in the search comes back as energy. Your edges soften. There is nothing to defend, because you have stopped holding a position on yourself. What you make from here is new, because it is copied from nobody. If it is playful it is yours. If you have heard it somewhere before, it is not.

This cannot be practised or copied. The moment being natural becomes a method it is the watching again in a new coat. Nothing you feel is unnatural, the laziness or the pain, and seeing that is what softens you. Softer, more open, more yielding: that is the whole of the way, and it has no path.
gene_keys.siddhi:
There is nothing to find here and no one looking for it. The question that started everything is gone, the way a thing you were carrying is gone once you set it down. Life has no hidden meaning left in it, and it is beautiful, one moment turning into the next. There is laughter in this, because from here the whole search looks like a joke everyone is in on. It is so ordinary you would not spot it in a room. If you stayed near it long enough, the one thing you would notice is how unrested you are.

This is what ease becomes when even the one being easy lets go. There has never been anything to do, because there is no one to do it, and so everything gets done. It is the plainest state there is.
gene_keys.programming_partner: The opposite pole is Ordinary Valiance, the self that goes grey and hides in the crowd, afraid of being different. Yours is afraid of being nobody and cannot stop looking at itself. At their lowest the two feed each other. The one who follows the crowd and the one who flees it are running from the same fear. Open it when being yourself has turned into an effort to be unlike anyone.

human_design.gate:
The pressure here is on behaviour: that what you do should match who you are, down to the small acts nobody sees. Gate 10 is the door it comes through, and its other name is self-love, because the two turn out to be one thing. When you are at home in yourself the people near you relax and are freed to be at home in theirs. When you are not, it is unbearable, and the pressure turns outward into blame, or into a hard word that cuts. In you it runs as a refusal to act a part: you would rather be disliked as yourself than liked as someone else. Putting something on feels like a lie in the body.

From outside this can look like self-absorption, and sometimes it is, because a self being lived out loud takes a great deal of attention. People who carry this all their lives learn to tell the attention that keeps behaviour honest from the attention that only watches. They tell them apart by how the body feels while it does each.
human_design.centre:
This pressure sits in the centre of the chest, in the Identity Centre, which holds who you are and which way your life faces. It is the heart of the whole chart. It has no engine. It works like a magnet with a single pole, only ever drawing: the people a life needs are pulled toward it, the work too. The way you behave is that self showing its face. When you trust it, what you do and who you are line up without effort. When you do not, you go to war with what it was already bringing you.

In about six people in ten this centre is switched on: the sense of self holds, whoever they are with. For someone like that there is a self to be true to, which does not move with the room, and what starves it is a borrowed manner kept up to pass. Keep that up for years and the heart goes out of you. In the other four it is not switched on, and the self is borrowed from whoever is nearest, then let go when they leave. For someone like that, being yourself means meeting what is in front of you as whoever you are that day. Place does half the work: the wrong seat in a room can put them out of themselves. What starves them is the effort to become somebody.
human_design.channel: Being yourself has to come out somewhere or it stays private. One wiring runs to Gate 20 in the throat, the part of you that speaks or acts in the present moment. The two make the Channel of Being Yourself: the self said out loud as it happens, which wakes the same thing in whoever hears it. The same gate reaches Gate 34, the power to act, and Gate 57, the knowing in the gut, one door onto three rooms. Whichever half sits in you, or in someone near you, behaviour becomes a life only where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: The family here is six, and between them they tell the one story every human life tells. The Mysteries Play is the wound you start with. Inner Light Symphony is the fight with your own shadows. Pearl of Christos and Beyond Binary are the mind's limits and the need to control, both given up. Internal Treasure is the finding of your own nature. The Thunder of Your Giving is the waking that comes after. Open any to see where in the story you stand.
tarot.tarot_resonance: A foot on the tiger's tail, and five faces watching the step.

body.physiology:
This energy lives in the heart, and the reason is the beat. Nothing tells your heart how to beat. A patch of cells in its own wall sets the pace, and a heart cut from every nerve, as a transplanted heart is, goes on beating. The nerves only lean on it, faster or slower. It is the one part of you that behaves entirely as itself, which is what being yourself is from inside, a thing that was already going. The heart is the sovereign of the body, ruling by being in place rather than by doing. Your presence lives there, the thing in a face that tells you someone is home.

It sits behind the breastbone, left of the middle. Lay a hand flat there, or two fingers at the side of your neck, and wait for it. When you feel watched the beat picks up, and that is all the watching ever gets to do here: hurry it. It was going before you noticed, and it goes on after you stop.
body.amino_acid: Being yourself has a chemistry in you, and the substance is arginine. It is one of the twenty small pieces every part of you is built from, and one your body makes for itself. Once you are grown you do not have to eat it. When you were a child your body could not make enough of it, and took the rest in from meat or a handful of nuts. Everything this energy is kin to shares the one substance, a single chemistry for the whole family, most of which is about the heart, about what happens when it is trusted. So ease is not added to you from outside. It is there inside you already, the moment you stop arguing with your life. Its substance was made in your own body, on its own, without a thought from you.

relations.unity_line: Each of these is a self that has to walk near something larger than itself, and what you meet in each is how it carries the walk.

pair.teaching: Ease in This is where this walk ends up a season on. The strength that was beside you is now under you, held by something small. There the force waits under a thin check and you get on with the small steps. Here you walk past the force lightly. Open it when the danger has passed and the question is what to do with power that is now yours to hold.

inverse.teaching: Upside down this is Ease in This again, so the bond is one and it is written above.

Open it when being yourself has turned into an effort to be unlike anyone.

tarot.teaching: A foot on the tiger's tail, and five faces watching the step.

sky.teaching: the crab, soft inside a shell it carries everywhere, at home wherever it walks. The Chariot's own sign, and the plain fact that a self needs an edge to move from.

immortals.teaching: Han Xiangzi and Zhong Li Quan walked off the road laid down for them. Han Xiangzi was raised for the examinations and took a flute into the hills instead. Zhong Li Quan lost an army and came back from the mountains with a fan that wakes the dead. Ask either what it took to leave the part they were given. One answers with a tune, the other with a grin.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the fence round a field, the line that says where you end so that you can walk right up to it and not past it.

keywords: The Light Was in the Dark
cards.essence: This energy is peace: the hour when what rises meets what settles, and everything between them grows. In you it lives as pictures. They come faster than one life could ever act on them, each whole with all its parts at once. Among them is a picture of how things could be, set so high that no realist would put their name to it. That picture is what lights you. When it is alive in you the day has a direction, it gets you out of bed with something to do, and every choice begins to arrange itself around it.

glance.reading:
This energy is peace: the hour when what rises meets what settles, and everything between them grows. In you it lives as pictures. They come faster than one life could ever act on them, each whole with all its parts at once. Among them is a picture of how things could be, set so high that no realist would put their name to it. That picture is what lights you. When it is alive in you the day has a direction, it gets you out of bed with something to do, and every choice begins to arrange itself around it.

You hold the picture loosely. It is not a plan to be built as drawn; it is what draws you upward. You cannot know what it will become as it comes into the world, only the feeling it stirs in you. Believe in the dream and give up what it looks like. Give it something to land in, a shape, a table it can be worked at, because a picture with nothing to land in stays a picture. Not every one that comes through you is yours to make. Most are for other people, and your part is to hold them clear until the one they are for arrives.

There are stretches when a haze settles between you and the world, when the pull is to read it as needing more: another teacher, a better account of how it all works. The light is behind the cloud, and the cloud is made of the pictures you have been pushing out of sight because they would not line up into sense. Let them come as they are, without asking them to mean something first, so the haze thins on its own. What you were looking for was already in you, waiting to be let out.

iching.trigram_combination: Earth over Heaven: the ground on top, the sky underneath, the wrong way round, and that is the point. What always rises is placed below, so it rises into what always settles, and the two meet in the middle instead of drawing apart. The traditional character shows a person standing in water, joined to what holds them up.
iching.reading:
You are in a good season, and it is a season, not a place. What was small in you is leaving, what is large arriving: the habit of adapting to whatever came along has less hold each day, and an aim you chose for yourself has room to grow. It is the first month of spring, with half a year of growing ahead, and it came because you walked the last stretch carefully. Things that would not meet are meeting: what you hoped for with what is there, the people above you with the people below.

The good season asks that you work inside it rather than rest in it. There is no flat ground without a slope coming, no going without a return, so the hour will pass. It lasts longer for the one who braces it: who spends what they have to keep the meeting open, who bears with what is rough and unfinished, who does not forget the ones far off or close the circle round a few. There is a time to make peace by strength and a time to keep it by yielding; this is the second.

The belly settled down over the head is this energy in the body, the soft front of you placed above the thinking. Let the belly lead, the head under it, and the meeting holds a while longer.
judgement_lines: Peace. The small departs and the great arrives.
Good fortune. It goes through, and it grows.
image_lines: Heaven and earth come together: the image of peace.
So the one in charge divides and completes the course of heaven and earth, furthers and orders what they give, and helps the people with it.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: a reed pulled up, its roots bringing the others with it.
lines.reading: Pull one reed and its neighbours come up with it, root tangled in root. The first move in a good season brings its own company: what you do well now gathers those who are like you, without your asking. Do not set out alone, or for yourself alone. Set the aim past your own concerns, go forward, and the others lift with you.

lines.image: bearing with the rough, and crossing the river with no boat.
lines.reading: Nothing is finished, there is no boat, and the way is still to go. Bear with the rough and unskilled, wade the river on your own feet, keep the far-off in mind, take no side. You have ability with no aim yet worth it, and the middle road is where the aim shows. Hold the whole barren field, not your favourites, and walk down the centre of it.

lines.image: no flat ground without a slope, no going without a return.
lines.reading: Here is the border where sky touches ground, and the tide is about to turn. Every flat has its slope waiting, and it is not yours to stop. Stay upright through the hard stretch and no fault is yours. Do not grieve that you were good and it was not repaid. Eat what is on the table while it is there.

lines.image: fluttering down, not rich, calling the neighbours.
lines.reading: Past the middle of the season you come down light, without the store you had, and turn to the people near you. They come without being warned, because the wish is from the heart. What was solid has thinned, and force will not thicken it. Trust the ones who want what you want, with no pact written, and let that be what holds.

lines.image: the sovereign gives his younger sister in marriage, below her rank.
lines.reading: The one at the top bends down on purpose: a sister of the royal house married to a lesser lord, and she goes under his roof. From that willing descent come blessing and great good fortune. Power that stoops to meet what is under it lasts. Whatever you hold, let it come down to the one who needs it, gladly, and you get what you wished for.

lines.image: the city wall slides back into the moat.
lines.reading: The earth dug out to raise the wall has fallen back into the ditch it came from, and the season is over. Do not send the army; there is nothing left to defend it with. You may still give orders inside your own gate, and even right ones bring regret, because the order has already gone. Mourn it, and stop speaking as if the wall stood.

becomes.name: The Taming Power of the Great

gene_keys.shadow:
A haze can settle between you and what is in front of you, so that you look at your beliefs about a thing, calling it sight. That haze is obscurity. It loves a system: a teacher, a method, anything that promises to lift the fog without your having to walk into it. The relief is real but short, because the new belief sits where the old one sat, between you and the thing. A method is a raft, for crossing, then for leaving on the far bank. Most people read the dimness as needing more, so they pile it on, and the pile is the problem.

What is in the cloud is the stream of pictures that comes up from the side of you that does not think in words, pushed out of sight because it would not make sense. Left there it turns into private fantasy and hidden wishes. The pictures you avoid most come back to find you, often wearing the face of the person you love. The fog is not the wall. It is the door, and it asks only that you not understand it yet.
gene_keys.repressive: This person has sealed the pictures indoors. The vision runs on as a private world, richer every year, quietly draining the body of the strength that would have built the real thing. The life they were meant for is hidden behind the fantasy, and the longer it is kept there the darker it twists.
gene_keys.reactive: Someone like this throws the picture at the world, insisting it is already true. They announce a future they cannot yet make, unable to let go of who they will one day be. It runs on denial and buried anger, ending in disappointment, because a false dream stands in front of a real one.
gene_keys.gift:
Trust the stream of pictures that is already yours and the fog begins to thin, not because you understood it but because you stopped demanding that it make sense before it could move. What opens is idealism, and not the soft thing the word has come to mean. You set a picture of how things could be so high that no realist would sign it, heaven on earth, the world made whole, and you do not believe it is literal. You let it organise you. Every choice begins to arrange itself around it, and it warms you from within long before any of it shows.

The craft is in the holding. You commit to the dream and give up what it will look like, because a picture coming into form never arrives as it appeared in your head. A castle you were shown turns out to be a way of working you could not have named. Grip the appearance and the flow chokes. Play with it, as with a story you know is a story, so it keeps moving. What you have to give was never the picture. It is your heart, open enough to catch other people alight.
gene_keys.siddhi: One point of light in a dark sky is a single moment of pure awareness, a pause where thought stops. Then there is another, then another, until the sky of a life is more light than dark and the dark patches crack open from inside. That is what the pictures become when the last of them fuse into one, and the one is faced: a clear light behind every form, showing through it, not the light the eye sees, with no one left standing outside it. You find it only by going down into the dark, which is why the ones who carry it seem to lead people away from the light, deeper into their own murk. From here nothing is hidden and no one can pretend. Good and evil stop being the way the world is sorted; it comes back the way a child first met it, with the light showing through everything.
gene_keys.programming_partner: In the genetic code too the partner is UL 12, Petals of Freedom, the open code held there by the code of caution and discrimination. What this one floods toward, the other slows and sorts. Together they know that vision without the discipline to tell true from false becomes its own fog. The idealist needs the discriminator at the same table.

human_design.gate:
Ideas arrive in you as a pressure, and Gate 11 is the door they come through: more of them than one life could ever act on, with the urge to sort the flood into order. It feels like standing under a waterfall with a cup. The cup is real. The waterfall was never yours to bottle. Not every idea that comes through you is yours to act on. Most are for other people, and the skill is knowing the few that are, then guarding those, because others will take them to sell.

From outside, a person carrying this can look dreamy, all talk. What is going on is the labour of being a place where an idea can land and be kept until the one it is for turns up. The cost is a particular panic: that each idea must be seized, forced into the world, or it is lost. That panic wears a person down until they no longer trust their own timing. With years of this you learn to ask one question of any idea, what if, and then to let it go until it is wanted.
human_design.centre:
The forehead is where this pressure is felt, the Ajna Centre, the part of you that takes what inspires you and makes sense of it. It can see the whole of a thing and all its parts at once. What it cannot do is act. It has no path of its own to any engine in the body, so its clearest idea sits still until something else moves it. Grabbed at, it tightens the whole body, and you can see it in the wrists.

Roughly one person in two has this centre switched on, and their mind runs the same way every day. Such a person has ground under their thinking: they know what they think, and they are certain, which is a strength until it hardens into being right. What starves them is having something clear to say with no one ready to hear it, since the same word is medicine to one person and poison to the next. The other half have it switched off, so the mind borrows its way of thinking from whoever is nearest and lets it go when they leave. For someone like that, ideas pass through like water through a sieve, certainty is not theirs to have, and holding the wheel loosely is the whole skill. They can see a thing from every side, which is a brilliance of its own.
human_design.channel: An idea kept clear has no voice of its own. Telling a thing so that it lands in someone is the other half, Gate 56, in the throat. Idea and voice together make the Channel of Curiosity, through which a picture becomes a story. The story is what carries the idea out of you into the room. It tells the truth for everyone better than its own, so it needs a lived day in it to be believed. The idea crosses only where the two meet, whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you.

body.physiology:
The pituitary is the gland in you that sends word, and the reason this energy lives there is that a picture in you has to reach the rest of you. It is the size of a pea, sitting deep behind the bridge of your nose. Nearly everything it releases is a message to another gland: the one that sets your pace, the ones that make a child. It does none of your work itself. It tells the parts of you that do, and the whole body answers. That is what a picture does in you. It is seen behind the eyes, and it changes the body from there.

The nerves from your two eyes meet and cross just above it, so what you look at passes over it before it becomes seeing. Put a finger to the bridge of your nose: the crossing is straight back from there, deep in the head, with the gland hanging under it. How tall you grew was decided there, while you slept.
body.amino_acid: The seeing in you has a substance, and the substance is threonine. Nothing in you makes it; it arrives in milk or cheese, or not at all. Three kin in you share it, and what the four do together is set how your body takes in light to make it something it can use. Yours is the part that concerns light in the mind: the eye, and the way an image made of light becomes, further back in the head, a thing you imagine. When there is a haze over what you see, that is where it sits, between the light and how you read it. Much of what you eat of it goes to renew the slippery lining that runs the length of you inside, a coat no light ever reaches.

sky.teaching: the fixed air of the visionary, the one who sees the pattern whole and ahead of its hour, light poured out for everyone at once.

immortals.teaching: Lan Cai He stands above, the wandering, ungendered minstrel who carries a flower basket and scatters coins behind them without a backward glance, and Han Xiangzi below, the flute player who could call flowers into bloom out of season. One scatters coins without looking back, the other calls flowers up out of season, and the open hour asks that same lightness of anyone standing in it.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the fish-hook that draws the hidden up out of deep water, meditation that lifts the buried vision into the light. The ring's path runs from Hod to Yesod.

cards.essence: A pure heart is the energy here, with the sense that comes with one, which tells the real from the fake by what your heart does when each is put in front of you. A thing made from the heart lands one way in you, a thing faking it lands another, before you have a word for either. What you cannot fall in love with, you do not trust. It lives most of all in the voice, where what you meant is heard under the words you chose. You can pick the most beautiful words there are, and the tone under them will still tell what you meant. It comes with a guard, built early, which is what most people meet before they meet the heart.

glance.reading:
A pure heart is the energy here, with the sense that comes with one, which tells the real from the fake by what your heart does when each is put in front of you. A thing made from the heart lands one way in you, a thing faking it lands another, before you have a word for either. What you cannot fall in love with, you do not trust. It lives most of all in the voice, where what you meant is heard under the words you chose. You can pick the most beautiful words there are, and the tone under them will still tell what you meant. It comes with a guard, built early, which is what most people meet before they meet the heart.

You get the truest work from this sense by pointing it at yourself first. The same honesty that sees through everyone else is pointed at your own holding back, at where you keep people out, at why. What it finds there is a fear that someone could take what is clean in you. Nobody can. What is clean in you is out of everyone's reach, so the flood you have spent a life keeping out can be let in, the feelings, the wounds of other people, all of it. It turns out not to drown you. Feelings rise, then they fall again, and what is left when they have fallen is that you remember what love is like. The aloneness you were looking for was never aloneness. It was this, your own heart clean, depending on nothing outside you.

Letting people in is slow, a refining that goes on for the whole of a life. The heart opens the way a flower does, a petal at a time, each one let go as the fear behind it proves false. Stretches come when you have let no one in for a while and cannot say why. The shut is not coldness. Behind it is someone who loves more than they will admit, waiting for it to be safe, and it was never unsafe. The last of the guard goes late, all at once.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Earth: the sky above and the ground beneath, each in the place that looks right for it. Each is moving away from the other, the sky rising, the ground sinking, so that nothing passes between them. The traditional character is a bird up in the sky that will not come down, with an open mouth between its wings, saying no.
iching.reading:
Nothing is getting through. What you say does not land, what you do goes nowhere, and the people who should be meeting you have turned away, each to their own side. This is a season, the seventh month, when the growing has finished and the decline has not shown yet. None of it is your doing. The small are coming forward while the worthy step back, and however unfair that is, it is what such a time is like.

Do not force the way open, because no force opens it. Draw in. Spend little, of money and of yourself. Refuse the pay and the honours a blocked time offers, since they go to the wrong people now. Keep to your own kind, the ones who go quiet with you, and let the rest go on without you for a while. Hold your own worth inside, where nobody can see it. Do not let the wrongness of what is happening rot the thing in you that is still clean. It is your turn to move and there is nowhere to move to; that is the whole of it. It is a season, so it ends.

The head and the belly are this energy in the body, the head above, the belly below, each keeping to itself with nothing passing between them. Feel for it now: the face in order, the belly gone quiet under it. Let the head come down a little, and wait the way the ground waits.
judgement_lines: Standstill. It is the doing of people who are no people, and it does not reward the one who holds to what is true.
The great departs. The small arrives.
image_lines: Heaven and earth do not meet: that is standstill.
So the wise fall back on what they are worth inside, to come through the hard time, taking no pay from it and no honour.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: a reed pulled up, and the roots of its neighbours come with it.
lines.reading: The reed pulled up brings its neighbours with it, roots and all: this is the first hour of the closing, when nothing has set hard yet. You are not alone in it. The ones bound to you come the moment you move. Withdraw with them, hold to what is right, and the closing can still be turned before it is a closing at all.

lines.image: bearing it and enduring; luck for the small, and the great held back.
lines.reading: Going along with the blocked time is what the small do, and it pays them. For you it chokes. The world is not at peace, you are uneasy at heart, and the unease is the very thing that will get you through, because it keeps you from being carried off with the crowd. Bear the obstruction as it is, without bending to it, and it becomes your way through.

lines.image: shame carried folded inside.
lines.reading: Shame is being carried here, folded away where no one sees it, because the false has been taken for the real and called a plan. The position is wrong and some part of you knows. No one will warn you, since the shame is the warning. Stop hiding from what you can already see, and do the thing that helps, without a thought for how it looks.

lines.image: acting on the order from above, and no blame; companions share the good.
lines.reading: Something has begun to move inside the standstill, and not by your will. The order comes from above, from what was always right in you, as complete in the ordinary as in the wise, and it carries no blame. Turn back toward it and the good that was covered over appears. Move only as you are moved, and the ones like you will come to share it.

lines.image: the standstill giving way, and a great one tied to a clump of mulberry.
lines.reading: The standstill is giving way, and the one who ends it does well. Still he says, it could fail, it could fail, then ties what he has to a clump of mulberry so it cannot be carried off. Trouble is beaten before it starts, in what the calm lets you overlook. End the block, keep ruin in mind, and fasten what you have recovered to something that holds.

lines.image: the standstill overturned; first blocked, then joy.
lines.reading: The standstill is over, and it goes as easily as turning over a hand, because nothing built to block can stand for long. What was shut collapses under its own weight. First the block, then the joy, in that order and no other. Empty out the old thinking with it, then go and find the ones who were scattered.

gene_keys.shadow:
There is a part of you that believes it is on its own, and loves that. It is not pride, which needs an audience. This is quieter, hiding in what you feel or leave unsaid, and the finer you become the finer it becomes. Under it is one fear, that another person could take away your freedom, reach in and remove something. So you are careful with your heart. People are let in now and then, in small measured amounts, then they leave wanting more. You go on looking for more room and never find enough. The mind is sharp, always able to find the reason the other person falls short. On the surface you hold it together. Underneath, the feeling runs hotter than you let on, and being loved can be the most frightening thing of all.

You cannot think your way out of it, because even the thought that you are getting over it is more of the same. Know that it is there, and leave it. As long as you feel yourself to be separate it keeps pace with you. It lets go late, all at once, of its own accord.
gene_keys.repressive: This person has gone refined. They agree with you out loud while thinking otherwise, or say nothing. They stay apart, quietly clearer than everyone in the room, beyond any belief that could hold them. It looks like humility. It keeps them from the one leap they most want, until they see it for what it is.
gene_keys.reactive: Others turn the sharp tongue outward. Feeling put upon, they find the exact word that wounds and say it, with a voice that knows how to reach a person like no one else can. None of it is planned. It is anger, under the anger fear, and it usually ends in their own wreckage.
gene_keys.gift:
A fake reaches you as a discomfort before any reason for it: someone pretending, or a thing made with no soul in it. The sense is done by feeling, and it cannot be argued away. The same sense tells you what is good for you, what to eat, who to keep. It makes you a critic people are a little afraid of, one who cannot be taken in by anyone selling a dream. It sets you apart, because it will not stay near compromise. It turns into art, the work that carries a feeling across to another person whole.

What it is for is love, the human kind, with all its drama and its danger. The people who carry it are moved by feeling all their lives, and they are here to pass it on. Enter the drama unafraid and let it run through you. In time you stop watching love from the side and become it. The voice that comes from that place stirs whoever hears it.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Purity is a heart with nothing on it, and everyone has one under everything else. The self you were once fell in love with itself; here, what is highest in you falls in love with you, and the two turn out to be one love with the separation gone. Nothing can touch it. Lock such a person up and their love goes on. Even the worst of people has this at the centre, so there is no evil, only thicker and thinner layers over it.

To arrive here you give up everything you gained, the whole climb, and you come out like a child, still human, with a voice past words. Most who live it live the plainest of lives, unseen, passing quietly, reminding whoever meets them that this exists in a human form. Its colour is white beyond white. The moment you see anything as bad, it is gone.
gene_keys.programming_partner: UL 11, Sol Star, is the second code this one is bound to, and here the pairing works differently than the pair. The voice that guards itself is held by the light that idealises and dreams. The dreamer needs the discriminator. Vision without the fine taste for what is real is only a pipe dream, and taste with nothing to dream toward has nothing to refine.

human_design.gate:
Saying what you feel, and not before its time, is the pressure this energy puts on the body. It enters at Gate 12: the drive to put a feeling into words, held back by a fine sense of when the words would land and when they would not. You speak when you are moved to, not because a silence needs filling. You take longer than most to answer, because the answer has to come up from what you feel before it is true. When the words come easily, the time is right. When they will not form, that is not failure; it is the signal to wait. Forced out early, they fall flat and leave you doubting them.

From outside the waiting looks like shyness, or like being hard to reach, and people who like speed will say so. The cost is that when you are overwhelmed you go silent, and the silence gets read as coldness. A lifetime of this teaches that the shyness was never a weakness, only the timing. A word said at its hour weighs more than a hundred said before it.
human_design.centre:
The Throat Centre holds this pressure: the one place in a person where what is inside becomes something outside, a word or an act. Everything else in you is pushing to get here; it is the town square of the body. It has no drive of its own, so whichever part it is joined to speaks through it. This pressure joins it to the feelings, deep in the belly, so what comes out of you is how you feel. How you feel comes in a wave that rises and falls over days, which is why the words that were there on one day are not there the next.

Most people, about seven in ten, have this centre switched on, and their voice is the same whoever is in the room. It is one song, sent out rather than taken in, sometimes bluntly. Their work is the hour: the voice is always there, and saying it at the wrong time is how it goes unheard. In three people out of ten it is switched off, so the voice takes its colour from whoever is near and gives it back. They feel a pressure to talk without knowing what will come out; left quiet until asked, the words arrive on their own and say what the whole room was feeling. The pauses in a voice can carry as much as the sound.
human_design.channel: The caution in the throat has nothing to say by itself. A feeling waiting low in the belly to be shared is its other half, Gate 22. Joined to the feeling, the caution becomes the Channel of Openness: the feeling given words, with the grace to know when a room can take them. The wave in the belly powers the voice, so in the mood the words reach the depths of despair or the heights of joy; out of it, none are forced. The feeling speaks only where the two meet, whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you.

tarot.ring_role: This code stands almost alone. It holds a ring of its own, the Ring of Secrets, a single card nested inside the larger Ring of Trials it shares with UL 33 and UL 56. Those three are the genetic stop signals, the three great tests on the road to oneself, and this one is the last of them. What the ring guards stays locked until the highest frequency turns the key.
tarot.tarot_resonance: A secret sits at the middle of this card's Arcana. The ring gives one, the High Priestess, keeper of what is hidden. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Heaven above as the Fool and the Empress, the open beginning and the fullness that nourishes; Earth below as the Devil and the World, the binding attachment and the finished whole. A beginning that has not spoken, a silence that keeps its reason, and at the far end a whole that already contains it.

body.physiology:
Swallowing is the reason this energy is given to the throat. Every time you swallow, the voice box lifts, a small flap folds down over it, and the two folds inside it shut. Your breath stops, for about a second, while what you swallowed goes past behind. It happens several hundred times a day, and every time everything in you stands still so that one thing can pass. That is this energy in your flesh. A baby can breathe while it feeds; you lost that when your voice box came down to where words are made, which is the price of speech. When you laugh or cry, the pattern of your breath changes, and your chemistry with it.

Put a finger on the ridge at the front of your throat and swallow. It rises under your finger, and for that second no breath comes. The ridge under your finger is the Adam's apple, named for the man who swallowed what he should not have and never got it down, a mind caught on its own words.
body.amino_acid:
Your body has no substance that answers to this energy. Nearly everything you are made of is written in small words, each naming one piece, read one after another. Three of the words you are written in name nothing, and this is one of them. Where your body reads it, nothing more is added, and what was being made is let go, whole. In you that is the passage from one state to a higher one, in which your tie to your own past is ended, so that you come out permanently changed. It ends your separate existence too, and the sense of being separate goes with it: crossing your own throat, you are swallowed by life.

Two others in you carry the same stop, and of the three this is the last, the innermost. Each of the three can bring you to a halt.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 11, this is the year's two breaths, the channels closing and the channels open, estrangement and union as one turning.

pair.teaching: Together with Sol Star, these two are the whole rhythm of mingling and estrangement. One is heaven and earth flowing into each other, the channels open, the small and the great in their right places. This one is the same powers turned away from each other, the flow stopped, the worthy withdrawing. Peace and standstill are not opposites so much as the in-breath and the out-breath of a single year.

sky.teaching: the reflected light that waxes and wanes, that rules the tides and the hidden inward water. Like the standstill, it is the dark half of a cycle that always turns back toward the full.

immortals.teaching: Han Xiangzi stands above, the flute player whose music made flowers open out of season, and Lan Cai He below, the wandering singer who carried a flower basket and sang verses about how fast a life goes by. A flute that opens flowers out of season and a wanderer's song about how briefly it all lasts are the two sounds that unseal a shut channel.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the long crossing of the desert, memory carrying water between worlds. Its path runs straight up the middle of the Tree, from the crown to the heart, the same abyss the Gene Key calls the throat that must be crossed for higher consciousness to dawn.

keywords: The One People Tell Things To
cards.essence: Listening is the energy here, the part of you that people tell things to. Hearing is done with the ears. This is done with everything you are, and it needs time, with a little distance, to work. People feel it and set things down in front of you, the secret, the old hurt, because something in you can hold what is said without needing to answer it. It lives wherever two people are more than the words passing between them.

glance.reading:
Listening is the energy here, the part of you that people tell things to. Hearing is done with the ears. This is done with everything you are, and it needs time, with a little distance, to work. People feel it and set things down in front of you, the secret, the old hurt, because something in you can hold what is said without needing to answer it. It lives wherever two people are more than the words passing between them.

You are the first person it listens to. You hear your own heart before your mind starts talking, because the mind is not wrong, only early. While someone is still talking you catch your own reply forming underneath, set it down, and go on listening. What you hear then is the note under the note, the thing a person means and cannot say. They feel it as trust before they know why, and trust spreads outward from the one who can take things in. Listening asks nothing of anyone, which is why it is the one power that changes people without pushing them.

The past is where this energy does its work. What you lived through is still in you, and what you never finished hearing returns, in a new face each time, until you do. There are seasons when all you can hear is the bad news, and it feels like seeing clearly. It is only the oldest part of you, listening for danger alone, and it can be heard too. Listened to all the way through, the old story loosens its hold, and the past you were locked in becomes the one you learned from.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Fire: the open sky, and under it a fire that rises toward it. Fire climbs and the sky goes on, so the two move one way. The traditional character sets a cover over a mouth, the silent understanding of two who fit without a word, beside the sign for people. A fire in the open, with people gathered to it, all facing one way.
iching.reading:
You are among people who are not your own, gathered in the open with one fire between you, and the question is what will hold you together. Not blood, because the open country is far from the family house, and not habit, because none of you has been here before. What holds a circle like this is an aim everyone faces, with a fire in the middle to see each other by. It asks this first: see each person for what they are before you draw them in. A fellowship is a fire that tells one kind from another, then warms them both.

Keep your own motive out of it. A circle gathered for someone's private gain breaks at the first strain. One gathered for a purpose none of them own can cross the great river. There is always one soft place in the middle of such a company, the person everyone wants beside them, and the circle holds as long as that person is not claimed by any one side. Help the others toward what they want and you will find your own aim reached on the way. Never let a friend walk alone at night.

In the body this energy is the eyes. Notice where your gaze is now: on the one you are with, or past them at the fire. Look at each face as it is, unhurried, and keep your hands open. What holds a company together is that each of them was seen.
judgement_lines: Fellowship in the open country, far from the walls. It goes through and grows.
It is good to cross the great river.
It goes well for the one who holds to what is true.
image_lines: Heaven, and fire rising under it: fellowship.
So the wise sort the families by their kind, and see each thing for what it is.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
lower_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lines.image: fellowship at the gate, just stepping out.
lines.reading: At the gate, just stepping out, before anyone has been chosen, while nothing has closed. Whoever you meet here you meet in the open, with no private bargain behind you, and nobody could fault it. You already know, before you are through the door, whom it is right to stand with. Go out while the going is still clean.

lines.image: fellowship kept to one's own clan.
lines.reading: Kept within the family, among the people who already share your name. It is warm, it is small, and it ends in regret, because sameness with your own kind is the one sameness that costs nothing. Fall in with whoever is nearest and you become one of them without choosing to. Widen the circle past the ones who were always going to agree.

lines.image: weapons hidden in the long grass, a watch kept from the high mound, three years without rising.
lines.reading: Weapons in the long grass, a lookout on the hill, and for three years nothing moves. This is fellowship wanted from someone who belongs elsewhere, and force cannot make it. The other side is too strong, so the wanting turns into watching, then the watching into a life. Nobody comes to harm, because nobody acts. Put the weapons down and be content with what is.

lines.image: climbed onto the wall, and the attack not made.
lines.reading: Up on the wall with the strike in your hand, and the strike does not come. You have the strength for it, with the sense not to use it, because forcing a bond that is not yours would be wrong, and the wrongness reached you in time. Being stopped is the good fortune here. Come down the wall, and what was blocked mends itself.

lines.image: the fellowship first weeps and cries out, then laughs; the great army wins, and they meet.
lines.reading: First the crying out, then the laughter: the ones who belong together have been kept apart, and the grief is honest. What stands between you is strong enough that it takes everything to break through. Your way is true and your heart is straight, so the meeting comes, with a laugh you did not expect. Weep openly, gather all you have, and go through.

lines.image: fellowship out in the meadow, beyond the town, the aim not yet reached.
lines.reading: Out in the meadow, past the last houses, with nobody standing beside you and nothing to regret. The great fellowship has not come. What has come is a way of being among people without being altered by them, outwardly the same, inwardly your own. It is not the whole of what you wanted. Take the peace of it, and keep the aim.

gene_keys.shadow:
Discord is what listening becomes when it hears only one band. Something older than thought in you is tuned to danger. On the days it has the ear, the whole world comes through as bad news, one crisis after another, proof that people cannot be trusted. It does not feel like an opinion. It feels like being realistic, and every generation says it in the same words, that things were simpler once, that people cared more. The good news arrives too. You hear it and cannot believe it. How could so many be wrong, and you be right?

Under the heaviness is distrust, one person of another, and under that a distrust of life itself, as if its story were bound to end badly. A life has a shape the way a story has, and the shape does not run downhill. This is not a choice you made. It is too much noise in the head, too many layers over the heart. The day you stop arguing with the heaviness and let it say what it has been saying, it begins to move. What you had forgotten, under the noise, was love.
gene_keys.repressive: Some go along with everyone. They make a show of listening, nod through whatever is said, and let people walk over them without learning a thing. It looks like kindness. Underneath it is a refusal to take in either the pain or the pleasure, both given up for a safety that is not real.
gene_keys.reactive: Others go against everyone. One hard view, held for life, bitter about what people are and angry at anyone who still hopes. It feels like conviction. It is the same deafness turned outward, a fear made into a philosophy, and it spends its days proving the hopeful wrong.
gene_keys.gift:
Discernment begins when you turn and listen to yourself. The feelings are still running, the wants still course through the body, but now there is someone watching them go by, and that someone is not swept down with them. You start to see how much of your view of other people was your own mood, and your agenda comes into the light, where it can be set down. From there the ear opens. You catch your own reply forming under someone's words and let it wait. You hear the note under the note, what a person means and cannot say. Because you heard it, they trust you before they know why.

Then the past changes. What looked like a run of accidents shows a pattern, the same few stories every life is telling, the ones every people has told as tales by a fire. You are living one, and seeing that brings a hope that is not cheap: it is felt in the belly, not decided in the head. Listen to the heart first, which is silence, then let the mind speak. The deeper you listen, the more of what you hear is love.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Empathy is being inside another, not beside them. Sympathy needs two. This needs one, and the one is not you. For that the separate self has to go, which is why thirteen was always feared as the number of death: it is a death, of the one who was listening. What remains is the listening itself, so total that it takes in everything, a panther, a stranger, from the inside. There was a fear to cross first, the cold of feeling cut off from everything alive. It was crossed by going all the way into it.

To sit with a person who has come here is to be healed by being heard. Every fear you have comes to the surface and is loved until it is gone. The past opens in you so wide that you are no longer a point but a place, with every creature in it, and from there the future can be seen.
gene_keys.programming_partner: UL 7, Essential Nexus, gathers scattered people into one body, and this code is its partner. One holds the past and learns from it, the other faces the future and leads toward it. Together they steer how human beings move as a group, the listening that learns from what was and the guidance that points at what will be. Neither works without the other.

human_design.gate:
The pull that makes people tell you things is this energy in the body. Gate 13 is the door it comes through: the drive to take in what has been lived, yours and other people's, then keep it until it means something. Strangers feel it before you have said a word. They sit down beside you and out comes the secret, the story they have carried for years, because something in you holds what is said without needing to fix it. You did not ask to be told. You were told anyway.

The cost is weight. Stories that were set down in you stay there, and a person who keeps everyone's past can end up living in it, retelling the old hurt until it is who they are. The drive can also go quiet about itself: so much room made for other people's stories that there is none left for your own. What the drive is for is the retelling. The past you keep is not fixed. The story you tell of it sets the direction your life faces, and it can be told again, truer, on any day you choose.
human_design.centre:
This pull is felt in the middle of the chest, the Identity Centre, which holds who you are, what you love and which way your life faces. It has no engine. It works as a magnet does, drawing toward you whatever a life needs, people or work, and the stories are part of what it draws. That is why a story kept here is never at arm's length. It is wired into the self, so a story that is not yours, an inherited one, a frightened one, turns the whole life to face the wrong way. A true one turns it back.

In about six people in ten this centre is switched on, and the self holds whoever they are with. For someone like that the stories come in and the self stays where it was. The risk is thinking everyone should be facing their way, and losing heart if they follow another's road. In the other four it is open. Other people's lives come in and are made louder, their wounds with them, so that another's story can be felt so completely it is mistaken for one's own. For someone like that the room matters, even the seat in it, and the question is whether you can feel a story all the way through without becoming it. Done well, that is the good of it: people feel seen for exactly who they are.
human_design.channel: What is gathered here has nowhere to go on its own. Its other half is Gate 33, in the throat, the drive to withdraw and make sense of what was lived before saying anything. The two make the Channel of the Prodigal, the one who goes away and comes back with the story. It is not built for talk. It stores, it keeps, then it speaks when the time is right, and its solitude is not a turning away. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the stories are told only where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: This code sits in the Ring of Purification with UL 30. The two purify through fire. This one is the listener, the one who takes the whole of the past in and digests it clean; the other is the blaze of desire that has to burn through before it clarifies. Discord becoming empathy, raw wanting becoming rapture. A small family, bound by what it must dissolve.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The Devil carries the weight of these five arcana. The Ring of Purification gives the Devil, the face of attachment and the bondage that has to be seen before it loosens. The two trigrams give their own faces: Heaven above as the Fool and the Empress, the open beginning and the abundance it ripens into; Fire below as the Emperor and the Sun, the clear sovereign seeing and the bright joy at the center. So the card leaves a question standing: does this fellowship warm what it gathers, or hold it?

body.physiology:
The amygdala is the organ your body gives this energy, and the reason is the flinch. The amygdala is two knots of nerve cells the size of an almond, one deep in each side of your head. It hears first: a rough copy of every sound and sight reaches it a fraction of a second before the thinking part of you has the whole. It keeps each memory with the feeling that came with it, so a voice or a smell that once came with hurt is stored with the hurt still on. A likeness sets the heart going before you know why. Someone speaks, and something in you has already answered. The listening this energy is made of begins there, where you watch that answer instead of obeying it.

The next time a sudden sound makes you jump, notice the order: the jump, then the knowing what it was. Put a fingertip just in front of the opening of your ear. A few centimetres straight in is the part of you that heard first.
body.amino_acid:
The heaviness you hear on a bad day is in your body as well as your ear, and it holds only as long as you believe it. It has a chemistry in you, and the substance of it is glutamine. Your body makes it, in the muscle, and bread is full of it. There is more of it loose in your blood than of any other.

Where it goes first is your gut. The cells that line your gut burn it before anything else, taking it from the blood as it passes. The gut is where the great sorting is done: what feeds you is drawn out, the rest is let go. Listening, in your body, is the same sorting. What you take in, from a day or from a person, is kept or released down there, below thought. That is how purifying it is when you listen.

relations.unity_line: Beside UL 14, this is the listening that gathers the human story and the bright abundance that gathering makes possible.

pair.teaching: With Ancestors Bloom, the pair holds the two halves of true wealth. One gathers the people, the shared fire that makes a fellowship; the other is the abundance that a real fellowship pours out. Fellowship is what you build, great possession is what it yields. The same circle, seen as the gathering and as the harvest.
