sky.teaching: the cardinal water that builds a shell to hold what it loves, protection that can clamp or can shelter, the territory the Shadow guards and the home the Gift keeps.

immortals.teaching: Lu Dong Bin stands above, the scholar with the demon-cutting sword who learned that the real blade severs delusion, and Cao Guo Jiu below, who left the court and its borrowed power behind. One learned his blade was only ever meant for delusion, the other left the throne standing empty, and between them they mark out the only authority worth biting through for.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the enclosure, the boundary drawn around a field, the line that says this is mine to tend. The same letter holds both the wall that divides and the keeping that protects, which is the whole question of this code.

cards.essence: Here the energy is grace, the warmth in a person who has felt everything and blames no one for it. In you it begins as feeling at full strength: joy, grief, wanting, anger, each one arriving whole and before you have a word for it. What you do with it in the minute after is where grace lives. It shows in how you take bad news, how you speak to a stranger, and whether the person across the table leaves lighter than they came.

glance.reading:
Here the energy is grace, the warmth in a person who has felt everything and blames no one for it. In you it begins as feeling at full strength: joy, grief, wanting, anger, each one arriving whole and before you have a word for it. What you do with it in the minute after is where grace lives. It shows in how you take bad news, how you speak to a stranger, and whether the person across the table leaves lighter than they came.

You trust a feeling first and understand it later. It came for a reason you may never learn, so it is not fought, not fixed, not made sweeter than it is. Trusting it is not the same as acting on it. You can feel the whole of it and put none of it on the person in front of you, which is rarer than it sounds. Felt like that, a feeling lasts a few minutes, then moves on. The one who was with you comes away feeling heard, though you may have said nothing. That is what you have to give, and people are more grateful for it than they know how to say.

There is a low in this, and it comes in its own time, the way rain does. Nobody sent the rain, and nobody sent this, though the first thing you will want is to find who did. Looking for the sender is what keeps it. Stay in it instead, uncomfortable as that is, because there is no way up in you that does not go through what you feel. Take it in small moves that show nobody how hard it was.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Fire: a mountain, and a fire lit at its foot as the day goes. The light reaches up the slope, showing every fold the daylight had flattened, and the mountain is not changed by it. The traditional character sets cowry shells, the old money, beside flowers: what is worn, tied to what it is worth.
iching.reading:
You are seen, and what is seen is the outside of a thing whose inside is already set. The light is on the slope now, and the light is real: the way something is said, a face made ready. It changes nothing underneath, nor needs to. Its work is to let what is there be seen for what it is.

It asks you to keep the light for small things. Use it for the day's business, the greeting, the room made pleasant, and it goes well. Do not use it to settle anything that weighs. A fire at the foot of a mountain shows the shape of the mountain; it cannot tell you what is inside the rock, and a matter decided by how it looked will not hold. Let what is solid lead and what is fine follow, because the moment the ornament goes first the way is lost. If you want more from this than small gains, the road to it is not a finer surface but a longer walk: what you know becomes your beauty, what you have lived through becomes your grace, a little of each every day.

The eye under the hand is where this energy sits in the body. The eye is lit, taking in every edge of what is in front of it; the hand above holds still. Feel where you are holding yourself right now: looking, not yet reaching. Keep the hand still a while longer, and let the eye do its work.
judgement_lines: Grace comes through. In small matters it is good to set out.
Let what shows take the lead, and little comes of it.
image_lines: Fire at the foot of the mountain: the image of grace.
So the wise bring light to the day's affairs, and dare not settle the great case by it.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
lower_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lines.image: the feet adorned; the carriage left standing, and the walk begun.
lines.reading: Your feet are dressed for it, the carriage stands ready, and you get down to walk. Nothing is wrong with the ride; it is not yours to take today. What you have at the start is yourself, and the plain road on your own feet is what keeps that whole. Leave the easy thing standing where it is, and walk.

lines.image: the beard adorned, and it moves only with the chin.
lines.reading: A beard is groomed, and a beard goes where the chin goes. What you are adding is ornament, and it has no life of its own; it rises with what it is fixed to. The patience here is the kind that waits for hair to grow. Keep close to the one above you who has the substance, and let what you do move with them.

lines.image: adorned and wet with favour; firmness kept through it.
lines.reading: Everything is going your way and it shows, the way wet stone shines. The favour is real, and it came from where you happen to stand rather than from anything you did, so it can leave the same way. The shine is safe only while what is under it stays firm. Keep to what is true through the whole of the good time, and no one can slight you.

lines.image: adorned or plain; a white horse coming as if on wings, not a robber but a suitor.
lines.reading: You cannot tell whether to dress this or leave it plain, and something is coming at you fast, white, as if it had wings. For a breath it looks like a raid. It is not. What is coming wants to join you, and the plainness is the sign of it. Let the doubt pass on its own, and take what arrives in plain colours as what it is.

lines.image: grace among hills and gardens; a roll of silk, small, slight.
lines.reading: You have gone up to the quiet places with a small roll of plain silk, less than the occasion seemed to ask. The shame of it is real and short. An offering that is sparing and meant is worth more than a lavish one that is not; in the quiet places this is known. Give what you have, tie the knot in the cord, and it ends in joy.

lines.image: white grace, with nothing added to it.
lines.reading: At the top the colour has gone out of it, and what is left is white, with nothing on it. The whole climb was toward this. The plain is not less than the fine; it is what the fine was for, and there is no fault in it. Wear nothing you do not need, say what is so in the fewest words, and what you set out for is yours.

gene_keys.shadow:
A feeling comes that you do not want, and the first thing you do is look for who sent it. The weather, or the one who said the thing. The reason is always out there, so the feeling is never yours, and a feeling that is never yours cannot be felt through, only pushed about. That is dishonour, which starts at home. You dishonour yourself every time you refuse the way you feel, whether you swallow it or fling it. Then you do the same to other people, handing them the mood to carry, and a mood put on someone dishonours both of you at once.

Every feeling you have was put there to be trusted. Trusting it is not doing what it says; it is letting it be in you without arguing. Left alone, it passes. Fought, fixed or hidden, it stays. It comes back too, because nothing you feel or do goes unheard, and what goes out from you returns to where it started. Nobody is at ease being uncomfortable. Being uncomfortable plainly, with no story about whose fault it is, is the whole of the way through; no higher place in you is reached by going round.
gene_keys.repressive: This person keeps it in. Outwardly they are calm, correct and hard to fault. Under the manners the feeling seethes, checked and checked again, because the one thing they fear is losing hold of it. It reads as composure. It is a lid, and a lid held long enough comes off all at once.
gene_keys.reactive: Here is someone who puts it all out. Whatever they feel, the room feels next, before they have heard it themselves. There is fire in it, often real art, and a private life in pieces behind them. What they cannot do is listen, so even what they mean well arrives at the wrong time.
gene_keys.gift:
Graciousness is what you have once your feelings are your own. You stop looking for who sent the mood and carry it yourself, so nobody near you is asked to hold it. It is slow work, sorting your own weather from other people's until you can sit beside someone in a low without going into it with them. Out of it comes a way of treating people that is rarer than it should be: everyone gets their dignity, and everyone feels listened to before they have finished speaking.

It is not polish. Think of an old floor of elm, weathered, marked by the saw, given a light sanding and laid with the marks still in it: honest about every year it has had, soft under the hand. You live fully, keeping no feeling back, and you keep every feeling off the people who did not ask for it. Careful without being fearful. Warm without being heavy. Candid without being cruel. It is tested all your life, which is what refines it, and in time you come to be grateful for whatever comes, the hard with the sweet, wanting less from either.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Grace is the moment that lifts you when you have fallen, and you did not make it. A small bird on the hedge at dawn with a flame of gold on its head stops you where you stand, then it is gone, and the day is changed. Everyone has had these. They cannot be arranged. What can be done is to meet every fall cleanly, because grace is buried in every low you have ever had, waiting for you to act in a new way.

From here nothing you feel becomes anything but love. You are no longer the one deciding; you are an instrument, played. Fear has gone out of you for good, and with it the need to hide, since everything was always heard anyway. When you look back at the years of blame, the lids and the spills, there is nothing in them to be ashamed of. It was love, still on its way to you.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Garden of Alchemy, UL 47, sits at the far end of this code's genetic thread. The one that receives the world's feeling is held by the one that holds the world's wound, the karma wound up in the oldest DNA. Together they know that suffering met graciously is not endured but transmuted, the pressure becoming the very thing that opens you.

human_design.gate:
This energy presses, in the body, to be heard. It comes in through Gate 22: a feeling that has arrived in you wants somewhere to go, and the somewhere is another person taking it in. Its fear is the plain opposite, that you will speak and nothing will land. The nervousness it makes is silence: you go quiet in a room, or a whole day passes in you unsaid. The pressure runs on the mood. When the mood is in, the depth of what you feel finds its words; when it is out, you do not want to speak to anyone, which is not a fault. It is the same door, closed for a while.

Seen from outside, this can look like charm, or moodiness, or too much feeling, and it is none of those. It is a wide instrument that takes in whatever comes near it, with a knack for timing: when to say the thing, when to listen. The cost is that when the feeling is held back for fear it will not be met, you settle for less than you wanted and call it being realistic.
human_design.centre:
The pit of the stomach is where this pressure is felt, the Emotional Solar Plexus Centre. It is the only place in you that both makes energy and knows something, which is why nothing has more power over a person than what they feel. It moves in a wave, from hope down to pain and back, so the same fact looks like everything one day, like nothing the next. There is no truth in the now here. What is true shows once the wave has passed and you are standing on the far side of it.

About half of people have this centre switched on, and they carry the wave all their lives. With this door it is the passionate, moody kind, mostly level, with quick rises and falls, its low end holding a melancholy that, if it can be borne, has much wisdom in it. For them the work is to wait the wave out before deciding anything, taking the low alone rather than forcing company. For the rest, it is not, so they have no wave of their own. They soak up the feeling of whoever is nearest, make it louder, and for a while it feels like theirs. For them the low goes when they leave the room, in a quarter of an hour, and the risk is being agreeable to keep the peace, until they no longer say what is true.
human_design.channel: A feeling with nowhere to go stays in the pit of the stomach as a weight. In the throat sits the other half, Gate 12, the caution that knows there is a right moment to speak and holds back until it comes. The two together make the Channel of Openness, through which what you feel can be said so that a stranger feels it too, in the mood and never on demand. It makes no difference if that other half sits in you or in someone near you: the depth only gets out where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: Within the Ring of Divinity, this code stands as the seventh seal, the grace the whole family points toward. Its siblings, UL 36, 37, and 63, carry the rest: the darkening that hides the light, the home that holds it, the completion that nearly arrives. A small ring, bound by one chemistry, turned toward the descent of the divine into the body.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Three roads run into this card and five Arcana come up them. The codon ring gives the Hierophant, the keeper who hands down the living tradition. The two trigrams give their own faces: Mountain above as the Hierophant again and the Hermit, the teacher and the seeker who carries the lamp; Fire below as the Emperor and the Sun, the form given order and the light that makes everything plain. Each of these five makes something visible, the teacher and the lamp and the ordering hand and the plain daylight, and grace is what they do to a form.

body.physiology:
The solar plexus is where this energy lives in you, and the reason is the catch. A feeling lands there before you have said anything: bad news comes, and in the first second there is a catch under the breastbone, the breath held a beat, the word for it arriving after. The solar plexus is a knot of nerves the size of two fingertips on the front of your spine, behind the stomach, a hand's depth in from the hollow under the breastbone. Whatever reaches you reaches there first. The moment after is this energy from inside: the feeling goes up to the throat and out, or it stays where it landed. Held long enough, it becomes fear kept as tension in every part of you; let through, it leaves the body at rest.

Lay a hand flat in that hollow and take a sharp breath in. The hollow pushes out against your palm, then falls back as the breath goes. Under the hand is the part of you that knows before you do.
body.amino_acid:
The grace that comes into you has a substance in you, and the substance is proline. One of the twenty pieces you are built from, it is made in you out of another of the twenty, so nothing you eat has to bring it. This energy does not rise in you from below; it comes down into you and saturates all of you. A woman early in pregnancy is flooded with a chemistry that readies her for what has not yet arrived, and it is like that: you are made ready, low down, for what you cannot yet see.

What floods you was never taken in from outside; your body makes it, in its own time. This same substance runs in the ones who share this energy, so what fills you is one chemistry with theirs. You cannot feel it being made, only that you have been made ready.

One bites down hard to reach what is real by removing what is in the way; the other lays light over the real to let it be seen. Force and grace, the chewing and the showing, two ways the truth gets handled.

Each of these five makes something visible, the teacher and the lamp and the ordering hand and the plain daylight, and grace is what they do to a form.

sky.teaching: the fixed earth that loves beauty and holds it slowly, sensual and patient, grace that takes its time and does not let go of the form it loves.

immortals.teaching: Zhang Guo Lao stands above, the old immortal who rides his donkey facing backward, carrying the reverence for what came before, and Lu Dong Bin below, the scholar with the sword that cuts through illusion to the real. Facing backward keeps the ancestral form in view, the sword keeps the false ornament off it, and grace needs both of those at once.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the letter that joins, the peg that fastens one thing to another, as grace fastens the light to the form it adorns. The path of the Hierophant on the Tree, connection made structural.

cards.essence: The energy here is simplicity: knowing what is essential, and cutting away everything else. In you it is a knowing that arrives whole before there are words for it, and a hand that lifts the one thread that matters out of the tangle. It lives in what you say and in what you keep. Adding is easy. This is the power to take away, and it asks more of you than adding ever did.

glance.reading:
The energy here is simplicity: knowing what is essential, and cutting away everything else. In you it is a knowing that arrives whole before there are words for it, and a hand that lifts the one thread that matters out of the tangle. It lives in what you say and in what you keep. Adding is easy. This is the power to take away, and it asks more of you than adding ever did.

Simplicity makes a life with room in it. Between too little and too much there is a place where things are right, which you know by feel. Your body tells you when to drink, then when to stop, so a life can be lived the same way, taking what is needed, no more. What you keep is what you use or what is beautiful, and the rest goes. The plain thing said once carries further than the clever thing said well. You do not have to think your way to it. You have only to stop adding.

Waiting is what it takes. The mind does not trust a plain thing, because a plain thing gives it nothing to hold, so it reaches for the complicated version and calls the long way round being careful. When that happens the words run ahead of the meaning, too fast and at the wrong hour. The harder you press to be understood, the further the room moves away. Under the pressing is a fear of being left outside, and the pressing is what puts you there. Let the thing arrive whole. Wait for the one who is ready to hear it. Then cut away everything that is not it, and say what is left once.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Earth: one firm line at the top, and under it five soft lines that have climbed up from the ground, eating the firm from below. The old character is a knife at work, peeling a thing back to what it is. This is the ninth month, the last of autumn, when the dark comes up from the floor of the year and takes the summer down.
iching.reading:
Something you have stood on is being taken from underneath, a wearing away that started low, where you were not looking, in the last month of a thing whose summer is over. Whatever was propped up rather than grown, the shape of a life or a way of carrying yourself, is coming off one layer at a time. The ground gives, then the frame, then it reaches you. What looks tall from outside stands too steep on too narrow a base, and the base is what goes.

Do not set out anywhere now. Setting out with an aim while the ground is moving loses the aim and the ground together. Stay low. Be generous to what is under you, because a height is only ever held up by what is below it, and the one way to keep your place is to give to those beneath it. What is against you is stronger than you now, and it will pass. The turn comes of itself, sooner than it feels from here. One firm thing is left, and it cannot be stripped. Keep it, and the whole falling becomes the turn.

The body's place for this energy is the hand, resting flat and still. Notice what your hands are doing now, reaching or gripping, and let them lie. Rest in the stop while it lasts, because it is how what was emptied fills again. Hold yourself as the mountain sits, low on the ground, letting go.
judgement_lines: Splitting apart. The worn form comes away.
It does not help to set out anywhere now.
image_lines: The mountain rests on the earth. That is how a thing comes apart.
So those above make their place safe by giving generously to those below.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: the legs of the bed splintered from below.
lines.reading: With the bed's legs gone, the wearing has begun at the foundation, where it looks like nothing and costs the most. Someone has come for your head and struck only at the leg. Do not answer it, and do not plant yourself hard against it, because standing firm here is what breaks. Keep still, say nothing, and find the quiet ones who are still with you.

lines.image: the frame of the bed splintered, the legs already gone.
lines.reading: With the frame gone after the legs, the wearing has climbed nearer the body, and no one has yet come to stand beside you. Showing your authority now, or arguing the damage back, does no good. Any hard stance brings the loss on faster. Give way, stay soft, and keep watch on how far the splintering has reached.

lines.image: stripping, and no fault in it.
lines.reading: Among those doing the stripping stands one who does not belong to them. Placed in the crowd that is pulling everything down, you look up instead, toward the one firm thing still standing, and keep your loyalty quiet. It costs you the company beside you and below, with no blame in the loss. Let both go, and keep the tie to what is above.

lines.image: the stripping reaches the skin of the one on the bed.
lines.reading: With the bed gone and the wearing at the skin, the danger is no longer near. It has arrived at the body. Every warning before this was a rap on the frame, and this is the last, the moment before the house burns. Nothing can be mended now, only saved. Go soft and go now, because the slightest hardness here turns loss into ruin.

lines.image: a string of fish, led into the favour of the house.
lines.reading: With one fish leading and the whole shoal following as if strung on one line, the tide turns. What was pulling the mountain down is gathered, ordered and brought into the house. The ones who seemed to hold no power hold most of it. Go the soft way, around rather than through. Win the one, and the rest come with it. Nothing now stands against you.

lines.image: the great fruit left uneaten, its seed inside.
lines.reading: With one firm line left at the top, past the whole stripping, the large fruit hangs uneaten. Inside it is the seed, and the seed is next year. Whoever keeps it is carried again, lifted by the very people who seemed to be tearing everything down. Whoever eats it strips the roof from over their own head. Keep the seed. The turn back is already inside the falling.

gene_keys.shadow:
The mind makes a tangle when it is trying to be safe. A plain thing gives it nothing to hold, so it wraps the plain thing in more, and the more feels like control. It comes out in the talking: the answer that will not fit in one word however plainly you ask, or the explaining that goes round again until the listener shifts in their seat and edges away. It is never the words that do it. It is the beat under them, and fear in the beat cannot be taken in by anyone, however fine the words are. Under all of it is a fear of being left outside, and the rush to be understood is what shuts the door.

By forty most lives have been made so complicated that the rest of them is spent finding the way back. The way back is not more thinking. It is small changes made at home, one thing let go at a time, with one question asked before every choice: will this make my life simpler, or more complicated?
gene_keys.repressive: Some learn young, often under a parent who would not hear them, that saying the true thing costs too much. The words are held back until they stop coming, and what is said instead is small talk or nothing. Seen from outside, it looks like slowness. It is a voice choked quiet by fear.
gene_keys.reactive: This person cannot stop talking, and the timing is off in a way they cannot hear. They say the wrong thing, or the right thing at the wrong moment, in circles, explaining twice. Each try at being heard pushes them a little further off. Under the circling is anger at not being understood deeper down.
gene_keys.gift:
There is a knack to living plainly, and it cannot quite be taught. You hear the difference between what matters and the noise you have been carrying, then you put the noise down. What you say is precise, short and clear. Your rooms have air in them. You are good with money for the plainest reason: you know where not to waste it. Difficult things come out easy once you have said them, and people relax around you, the body first, because nothing has to be resolved. The knowing does not come by thinking. You watch in silence until the answer stands up on its own, then say it, and it often comes out funny, catching the whole of a moment in one line.

Inside, the clearing goes on for years. Thoughts get gaps between them, feelings are allowed to run their course, and most of what looked like problems turns out to have been made by wanting. A mind in cloud goes round in circles looking for the way out. Above the cloud it is quiet. When you lose the rhythm, use your hands: cook something, or dig. A life made by hand is a simple one.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Inside the essence of a thing there is another essence, and inside that one again, with no floor. It is the old dream of the alchemists, gold drawn out of base metal. A person living here draws it out of other people with a word or a look, not by trying, because nothing is left in them between the seeing and the saying. Every thought that was not needed has split apart, letting go what it held, and what remains is not a quieter mind but life itself speaking through the shell of a person.

Nobody arrives here on purpose. It is found by mistake, in wonder, by someone who has stopped seeking, stopped longing, and walked into the mystery to drink it through the skin. From here the gaps are the point: the silence between two words is where the meaning was. The essence of life turns out to be death, and the essence of death is life.
gene_keys.programming_partner: The DNA pairs this card with UL 43, Cipher of Knowledge. The one that transmits is held by the one that knows in silence. What they understand together is that a true thing said at the wrong moment, to ears that cannot yet hear, only deafens the room. Knowing and saying must keep the same clock.

human_design.gate:
This energy presses in you as the need to hand over what you know. Gate 23 is where it presses: the drive to take something complicated, break it down and say it in a way nobody has said it before, so that another person can take it in. Nobody taught you the knowing. It arrives on its own, ahead of the proof, and often ahead of everyone else, which is what makes you an outsider in a room until the room catches up. The trouble is never the knowing. It is the hour. Said too early, to people who are not ready, the truest thing you have lands as arrogance, or as a need to be right. You are left unseen, bitter, wondering why nobody can see what is so plain to you.

Carrying this for a lifetime teaches you two things: to trust what you know before you can defend it, and that the ones who are ready will ask. Held until then, the same thing lands whole. Broken down too far it can lose what mattered in it, so the work is to make it small without making it less.
human_design.centre:
Everything in you is aimed at one gate, the Throat Centre, where this pressure comes out. Eleven roads run into it from six directions, and whatever arrives there leaves as a word or an act. It has no power of its own. It is a gearbox rather than an engine, and whichever part of you is joined to it speaks through it: joined from the mind, as this gate is, you speak what you think. Its law is that a thing is said before it is done.

Roughly seven in ten carry this centre switched on, and the voice keeps one tone all their life, a song of their own. For someone like that, being heard is not the difficulty. Saying it at the right hour is. For the rest, it is not, so the voice is heard only when the conditions are right. Such a person was often not listened to as a child, and grew up either quiet or loud to make up for it. They feel the pressure to speak without knowing what will come out, since it is often what the whole room was not saying, and they can wear themselves out trying to be heard. Their strength is the same thing turned over: the voice of the room speaks through them, best when it has been asked for.
human_design.channel: What the throat hands over has to come from somewhere. The mind supplies the other half, Gate 43, the insight that arrives with no proof and no way to explain it. Together they form the Channel of Structuring, turning a knowing nobody could follow into a shape another mind can walk into. Alone, this gate is a voice with nothing fixed behind it. Whether you hold the other half yourself or find it in someone near you, the knowing only gets out where the two meet, and it has always been ahead of its time.

tarot.ring_role: Within the Ring of Life and Death, this code stands as the stripping, the cut back to the essential. Its siblings, UL 3, 20, 24, 27, and 42, carry the rest of the cycle: the difficult arrival, the present-moment presence, the return, the nourishing, and the increase. The Buddha's plainest teachings are folded through this whole family. Together they hold the span from first breath to last and the simplicity on the far side of both.
tarot.tarot_resonance: A grim spread, at first glance, and the glance is wrong. The codon ring gives one Arcana, Death, the great passage. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Mountain above as the Hierophant and the Hermit, the tradition that is kept and the wisdom found alone; Earth below as the Devil and the World, the attachment that binds and the completion that arrives when it is let go. Under all five sits one picture, a hand letting go, and what stays behind in the open palm.

body.physiology:
The body gives this energy to the throat, and the reason is the pause. Every breath in parts the two small folds in your throat, and while they are parted no word can be made. They close for sound, then part for the next breath. So every sentence you have ever said was built between breaths, and the gap was never chosen. Your speech has to split apart to breathe before it can say anything. Put your hand flat against your throat and breathe in. It goes still under your fingers. Say a long sentence and it stops where the breath runs out.

Below the voice sits the small gland that sets the pace of the whole of you, and its work is never seen as it happens. What it sends out enters each cell and works there, so that what it did this morning shows in you only hours or days from now. The timing that decides whether your words fit the one listening works the same way, well below anything you can watch.
body.amino_acid:
This energy has a substance in you, and the substance is leucine. You cannot make it. It comes into you only through food, meat, milk or beans, or not at all. This substance sits in every protein you are made of, and the muscle you move with takes it apart, without sending it to the liver. What you share with the kin that carry it is the plainest fact: everything alive in you is changing, and everything that changes comes to an end.

The essence of all this is not in your head. It sits deep in your belly, the centre of your centres. The chemistry you share with your kin is the chemistry of a life taken apart and put back as it goes, in the muscle you use, in the meal you eat. Leucine is in you only as long as that goes on, taken in fresh, day after day.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 24, this is the whole turn of the year, the long stripping down to the seed and the first quiet return of the light.

pair.teaching: Together with Frequency Flutter, these two are the bottom of the cycle and its turn. One is the last of the old form being peeled away until only the seed is left. The other is that seed stirring, the single light coming back up from the floor of the dark. Splitting apart and returning are the same midnight, read from either side of it.

inverse.teaching: Together with Frequency Flutter, these two are the bottom of the cycle and its turn. One is the last of the old form being peeled away until only the seed is left. The other is that seed stirring, the single light coming back up from the floor of the dark. Splitting apart and returning are the same midnight, read from either side of it.
