What they understand together is that a true thing said at the wrong moment, to ears that cannot yet hear, only deafens the room. Knowing and saying must keep the same clock.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Life and Death
codon_ring.teaching: Within the Ring of Life and Death, this code stands as the stripping, the cut back to the essential. Its siblings, UL 3, 20, 24, 27, and 42, carry the rest of the cycle: the difficult arrival, the present-moment presence, the return, the nourishing, and the increase. The Buddha's plainest teachings are folded through this whole family. Together they hold the span from first breath to last and the simplicity on the far side of both.

tarot.teaching: A grim spread, at first glance, and the glance is wrong. The codon ring gives one Arcana, Death, the great passage. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Mountain above as the Hierophant and the Hermit, the tradition that is kept and the wisdom found alone; Earth below as the Devil and the World, the attachment that binds and the completion that arrives when it is let go. Under all five sits one picture, a hand letting go, and what stays behind in the open palm.

sky.teaching: the fixed water that holds death and rebirth as one substance, depth that strips a thing down to find what cannot be destroyed.

immortals.teaching: Zhang Guo Lao stands above, the old hermit who rides his donkey facing backwards, seeing where he came from more clearly than where he goes, and Lan Cai He below, the wanderer who carries a basket of flowers and holds nothing for long. A stripping takes only what is still gripped, which is why the memory riding backward survives it, and so does a basket carried by someone who holds nothing for long.

hebrew_letter.teaching: transformation without loss, life kept whole through the change, the way a fish keeps living inside moving water. The ring's path runs from the heart of the Tree to Netzach.

cards.essence: The energy here is return: going back to where a thing began so that it can start again. In you it is the thought that comes round again, the same trouble revisited until it gives up something new, the low place where a life turns. Nothing shows yet. The turning has already happened.

glance.reading:
The energy here is return: going back to where a thing began so that it can start again. In you it is the thought that comes round again, the same trouble revisited until it gives up something new, the low place where a life turns. Nothing shows yet. The turning has already happened.

The art of it is catching the turn early. You know a loop while you are in it, which most people never do, so you come back before you have gone far, and the coming back costs nothing. You can bear the empty moment when a pattern stops, the second or the week when the usual thing stops. What is new in you arrives there, never while you are pushing, only while you are at rest, and it cannot be scheduled. The change that lasts is small: one new step, taken again the next time, until it is simply how you go.

Coming back small, and early, is what it takes. The empty moment feels like falling, so the first reflex is to fill it, with a drink or a screen, and the loop starts again. What was under the fall was a floor, and nobody told you it was solid. When you stay, the old pattern falls quiet and something you had not thought before is there in its place. You did not make it. You only did not leave.

iching.trigram_combination: Earth over Thunder: five soft lines lying still, and under them one firm line that has just come back. The old character is a foot retracing a path it walked before. This is the eleventh month, the winter solstice, the day the sun stops sinking and turns. Nothing above the ground has changed. Deep under the frozen field, the year has turned.
iching.reading:
You are at the bottom of a long decline, and the turn has come. Something ran all the way down, the light went out of the days, and at the point where it looked like death the direction reversed. The turn is real. It is also tender and small, one line at the lowest place, with everything above it still looking like winter. It is the day the year turns toward spring, and not yet the spring.

The turn asks to be sheltered. The old kings closed the passes at the solstice, the merchants stayed home, the ruler did not ride out, not because the roads were dangerous but because the returned light was too new to be marched anywhere. Keep to your own for now. Go out, come in, without strain, and let those who belong with you come to you. In seven days the turn comes round again, and once it has come it is good to have somewhere to go. Part of the return happens on its own, like the sun turning, and part is your own effort in holding it steady. Only where the two meet is it complete.

In your body this energy is the foot, the one that sets out and retraces the path. Notice where your feet are pointed now, and whether the step you are about to take is away or back. Move enough to keep warm, no more. Hold yourself as thunder rests in the earth, small, sure, out of sight.
judgement_lines: Return. It goes through, and grows.
Going out and coming in, nothing harms. Friends come, and no one is at fault.
To and fro goes the way. On the seventh day, the return. It is good to have somewhere to go.
image_lines: Thunder in the middle of the earth: the year turns.
So the old kings closed the passes at the solstice. Merchants and travellers stayed home, and the ruler did not go out to view the land.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: return from a short way off, before there is anything to regret.
lines.reading: With the path left only a step ago, this is the easiest return there is. You feel the wrong turn almost as you make it, and nothing has hardened yet. What comes in from outside is put out again at once, calmly, with no regret to carry. Turn back now, while the wandering is still small, because the first one back is the safest.

lines.image: a figure leaning on a tree to rest, then coming back.
lines.reading: With a figure leaning on a tree to rest, the return is quiet and good. You went away, rested, and came back without drama. What made it good is that you stood near someone steadier than yourself, borrowed their footing, and felt no shame in it. Where your own knowing runs short, lean on the kind, and come back beside them.

lines.image: returning over and over, the whetstone that sharpens by friction.
lines.reading: With the return made again and again, this is the hard way, which works. You find the way back, lose it, find it, and the repeating feels like failure. It is not. Each loss is a whetstone, and what it grinds is your will to return. Something you left unfinished will come round again now, so meet it, decide, and come back once more.

lines.image: walking in the middle of the road, turning back alone while the others go on.
lines.reading: With the whole company walking one way, you alone turn round. Nothing is wrong with them and nothing is wrong with you. You have found the path and they have not, so following it means walking it without them for a while. Do not measure your direction by theirs. Turn back alone, in the middle of the road, and keep to the way.

lines.image: the sincere return, made from the centre, with nothing to repent.
lines.reading: With the return made from the centre, in earnest, there is nothing left to regret. This is the honest turn back toward the source, made by someone able to look at themselves without flinching, drawing on what the ones before them left. Knowing the error is not the return. Act on it, and there will be nothing to repent.

lines.image: lost in the return, bewitched; the army marches and is broken.
lines.reading: With the moment to turn already passed, you turn anyway, blindly, lost inside the returning itself. Lost here also means bewitched: enchanted away from the path while sure you are on it. Set an army marching from here and it is broken. The ground does not recover for ten years. Do not mistake the way back for a campaign.

gene_keys.shadow:
A mind settles on a few tunes early and plays them for the rest of its life. There is a whole keyboard in you, but most days you touch the same dozen keys, in the order you were taught, and walking those worn paths feels like thinking, so you call it that. Now and then the tune stops. A gap opens, a second or a week of it, with your own discomfort inside, nothing between you and it. The reflex is to fill it fast, with anything that starts the tune again. Every way of thinking is addictive. Only silence breaks it.

This is why the outer changes never take. A new town, a new partner, and the same scene plays out with new faces, because the pattern was never out there. The mind puts its hope in the future rather than the present, and nothing outside you can end what runs inside you. What begins to shift it is smaller than that: the moment you notice you are in the pattern, the pause between two frames has already opened.
gene_keys.repressive: Some meet the gap by going rigid. The fear of that empty second locks the body, drains the energy out of it and narrows the seeing until the world is small, guarded. From outside it looks like a person gone very still. They shrink from the empty state, and so nothing seeds in it.
gene_keys.reactive: This person turns the same fear into motion. They cannot sit still, so they fill the hours, work too hard, and keep the noise loud enough that the empty second never lands. It looks like drive. It is panic dressed as activity, run by a body avoiding the most natural chemistry it has.
gene_keys.gift:
The gap turns out to be a door once it is met. It opens on its own, to everyone, for a second or a week, and the whole difference is whether you cower before it or stay. You stay. The falling feeling comes, it does not kill you, and on the far side of it is something the loop could never have reached. This is not inventiveness, which is a knack you can practise. It is the new thing itself, arriving from nowhere, surprising you as much as anyone. The great player throws the shot nobody could have drilled against, at the moment of most pressure, from here.

It happens when you are at rest: sitting doing nothing, or asleep. You ponder a thing, travel the worn paths round it, then the gear changes and you see it whole, in a new light. The same loop, lifted a note higher each time it comes round. What it asks of you is honesty, the willingness to say you do not know and may never know. That admission is the ground the new thing grows in.
gene_keys.siddhi:
The looping stops, for good, and what is left is quiet the way the night sky is quiet, alive with light. Not the empty kind, the hush of a switched-off room. The living kind, the one the gaps were always windows onto. It comes down on you, though it was inside you the whole time, under the noise. The seat of you drops out of the head, settles lower, into the belly, and from there you are no longer thinking so much as being thought.

From here the last addiction ends, the one under all the others, the belief that you are separate from life. Bodies come and go. What seems to keep returning never left. The only thing that comes back, every time, is the silence between the words, and it was there before the beginning.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Deep in the genetic code this card is answered by UL 44, Sophia's Orchestra. The one that keeps returning to its own patterns is held by the one that reads the patterns running through everyone, and the loops of a single life turn out to be threads in a far larger weave. Seeing the weave is what finally frees the thread.

human_design.gate:
Here the pressure is to know why, and Gate 24 is where it presses: the mind going back over the same material, the old hurt or the unsolved thing, looking at it again to see what it missed, until one pass gives up something new. To anyone watching it can look like a person stuck, chewing the same bone. It is not. This is how a mind of this kind works, by revisiting rather than advancing, and it never stops. Its trouble is that it can talk itself into anything. Given a pain, it will find a reason to keep it, a story in which settling for less is only sensible, and the story feels like protection while it does the damage.

People who carry this all their lives learn to trust what they know before they can prove it, and to go back to the old pain on purpose, to find what it gave them, then tell it again with that inside it. The answers the brain cannot think of are in the space between two thoughts, so the work is not to stop the mind but to notice its gaps.
human_design.centre:
The going back happens in the mind, the Ajna Centre, which sits behind the forehead. It makes sense of whatever presses in from above, turns it into something that can be thought, then keeps it as belief and memory. It has no power to act. It can only see, sort, understand, and the pressure to understand is what it runs on.

In about half of people this centre is switched on, and the mind has one way of working that can be counted on. For someone like that there is a solid floor under their thinking: they know what they think, they hold what they learn, and other people's ideas do not knock them about. What traps them is certainty, believing their own thinking so well that the search for a final answer never ends and wears them down. In the other half it is not, so the mind has no one way of working. Ideas come in, go out like water, a question can meet a blank, and what they think is often borrowed from whoever is in the room, then gone when that person leaves. Such a person grips the wheel to feel steady, and the grip is what makes them unsafe. Held lightly, the same mind sees a whole situation in a second, with no effort, because nothing of its own is in the way.
human_design.channel: Going back over things, on its own, is a loop with no way out. Its other half is Gate 61, at the crown, the pressure to know what cannot be known, the wanting to understand that sits above the mind and asks why. The two make the Channel of Awareness, a mind that keeps making sense of the mystery and is never meant to land on a final answer. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the loop only opens where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: Within the Ring of Life and Death, this code is the return, the gap where the wheel turns over. Its siblings, UL 3, 20, 23, 27, and 42, carry the rest of the great cycle: the first arrival, the long looking, the stripping away, the nourishing, and the increase. Together they govern the comings and goings of form, and the silent intervals between them.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Watch what these cards do at the bottom of the year. The codon ring gives one Arcana, Death, the great turning that is not an ending. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Earth above as the Devil and the World, the binding and the completed round; Thunder below as the Tower and Judgement, the shock that breaks the loop and the call that wakes the buried thing. Each of these cards shows something closed being opened: a bondage broken, a sleeper called back, the year unlocking at its lowest point and starting its quiet climb toward the light.

body.physiology:
The outer sheet of the brain is where the body keeps this energy, and the reason is the path. Everything you have learned is a route worn into that sheet: a way taken once is faint, a way taken a thousand times is a road, and the sheet cuts back what it does not use. That is why your second time is easier than your first and your thousandth happens without you. The tunes your mind plays are roads like that, and the wearing goes on all your life. A thing you have learned well takes less of the sheet than it did while you were learning it, so the better you get at something, the quieter the sheet becomes.

Sign your name, then sign it with the other hand. The first is a road worn over years. The second has no path at all, every letter a first attempt, and you can feel the difference in a second. A new route in you is cut the same way the old one was: one step, taken again.
body.amino_acid:
This energy has a chemistry in you, and it shares it with its kin: the substance is leucine. It comes to you in food or not at all. Corn is full of it while being short of something else, so a bowl of corn and a bowl of beans lack different things, which is why the two have sat on one plate together for as long as anyone has grown them.

What runs through the family that shares it is the gap. It is the family of coming into a body and going out of one, of the wheel, of the spaces between: between two lives, between two notes. Whatever changes in you changes there. Leucine is in you on both sides of every such gap, and it is taken in fresh at each meal.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 23, this is the whole turn of the year, the long stripping away and the single light that comes back at the bottom of it.

pair.teaching: Together with Beneath the Surface, these two are the bottom of the cycle and its turn. One is the last of the old falling away, the structure stripped down to a single line at the top. The other is that same line reappearing at the bottom, the first return. Stripping and returning are one motion read at its lowest point, the night and the first minute after midnight.

inverse.teaching: Together with Beneath the Surface, these two are the bottom of the cycle and its turn. One is the last of the old falling away, the structure stripped down to a single line at the top. The other is that same line reappearing at the bottom, the first return. Stripping and returning are one motion read at its lowest point, the night and the first minute after midnight.

programming_partner.teaching: Deep in the genetic code this card is answered by UL 44, Sophia's Orchestra. The one that keeps returning to its own patterns is held by the one that reads the patterns running through everyone, and the loops of a single life turn out to be threads in a far larger weave. Seeing the weave is what finally frees the thread.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Life and Death
codon_ring.teaching: Within the Ring of Life and Death, this code is the return, the gap where the wheel turns over. Its siblings, UL 3, 20, 23, 27, and 42, carry the rest of the great cycle: the first arrival, the long looking, the stripping away, the nourishing, and the increase. Together they govern the comings and goings of form, and the silent intervals between them.

tarot.teaching: Watch what these cards do at the bottom of the year. The codon ring gives one Arcana, Death, the great turning that is not an ending. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Earth above as the Devil and the World, the binding and the completed round; Thunder below as the Tower and Judgement, the shock that breaks the loop and the call that wakes the buried thing. Each of these cards shows something closed being opened: a bondage broken, a sleeper called back, the year unlocking at its lowest point and starting its quiet climb toward the light.

sky.teaching: the fixed water that holds death and rebirth as a single substance, the depth where the turn happens out of sight.

immortals.teaching: Lan Cai He stands above, the wandering minstrel with the flower basket who sings that life passes quick as spring and keeps nothing, and Cao Guojiu below, who walked away from the inherited court. The return is made with empty hands, a basket carried for its own sake and a court walked out of without a look back.

hebrew_letter.teaching: transformation without loss, continuity carried through change, as a fish keeps its life inside the moving water. The ring's path is the Nun path on the Tree, the way that crosses through death and comes out still living.

cards.essence: This energy is innocence: the way you meet life before anything in you has learned to scheme, and the love that comes with it, which goes to everything alike. It moves the way weather moves, with force and without a plan, the first thunder of the year rolling under an open sky. In a life it is the hour when what you do comes straight from what you are, with nothing added to make it look better.

glance.reading:
This energy is innocence: the way you meet life before anything in you has learned to scheme, and the love that comes with it, which goes to everything alike. It moves the way weather moves, with force and without a plan, the first thunder of the year rolling under an open sky. In a life it is the hour when what you do comes straight from what you are, with nothing added to make it look better.

Innocence trusts when nothing in you interferes with it. Things come to you when you stop chasing them, and a setback looks like part of a larger pattern rather than proof that there is none. You belong everywhere, a grudge is hard to keep, and there is an air of another world about you while your feet stay on the ground. The way through a day is to allow it: the slow car ahead, the rain at the wrong moment, each let be what it is. You have to slow down to do it, and the day tastes different.

Fixing it is not the answer. Nothing here is mended by will, and the surest way to keep a grip is to fight it. There will be days when the tightness is all you can feel, and on those days the only work is to stop bracing. Love opens the way a season does, in its own time, once nothing in you is holding it shut.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Thunder: the first roll of thunder coming up out of the ground, with the whole open sky above it. Everything alive hears it and is for a moment what it was before it learned to pretend. The old name is two characters, the second meaning reckless or false, the first cancelling it: without falsity, nothing in the way.
iching.reading:
Something has risen in you that owes nothing to calculation: a move as sudden as thunder, with the open sky over it and no scheme in it anywhere. This is the hour to act from the place it came from, before the mind arrives to manage it. What comes up like that is right in a way no plan can be, because it was not made to get anything.

What it asks is the hardest simple thing there is: do not tamper with it. Keep it straight. A move that is true carries the best fortune there is, and the same move with a crookedness in it, a wish to be seen, a bargain hidden somewhere, goes wrong, with no direction to help it. Do not set out on a long road now, and do not push a direction onto what is unfolding. Wisdom in this hour is knowing when tinkering with a thing will bring more trouble than letting it be.

In the body the sky is the head and the thunder is the foot, the first step that starts before you have decided to take it. Notice where you are holding yourself now: the head clear, the foot already lifting. Let the step be as plain as it rose, and the sky will not stand in its way.
judgement_lines: Innocence. Great success, and holding to what is true brings it through.
If there is a crookedness in you, there is trouble, and setting out helps nothing.
image_lines: Under heaven the thunder rolls, and everything alive returns to what it is.
So the kings of old, rich in their nature and in step with the season, fed and raised the ten thousand things.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: setting out with nothing false in it.
lines.reading: Setting out with nothing false in you, the going is fortunate. The whole of it is decided here, at the start, where the thought is still clean and the act has not yet followed. What is true at the root stays true the whole way up. Do not reach for anything heroic. Go as you are, and your wish is met.

lines.image: reaping a field you did not plough for the reaping.
lines.reading: Ploughing without counting the harvest, clearing ground without an eye on what it will yield: this is work done for its own sake, and things go well for it. Do not sow and reap in the same breath, nor grow the same crop on the same tired field. When the wanting drops out of the doing, any direction is a good one.

lines.image: a tethered ox led away by a passer-by.
lines.reading: The ox was tied where it should be, a traveller led it off, and the village is blamed for the loss. Misfortune can find the one who did nothing wrong, and no amount of being right prevents it. What harms you here is clinging to the principle after the ox has gone. Let the loss be a loss, and do not turn it into a second wound.

lines.image: holding fast to what you are.
lines.reading: Strong, in a place that asks for softness, you are able to act and that is the danger. Nothing here is wrong yet, and nothing needs doing to keep it so. Do not move because you can. Hold to what you are, which was never something you had to make, and the moment passes clean.

lines.image: a sickness that needs no medicine.
lines.reading: You have done nothing wrong and you have fallen ill anyway. Do not reach for the cure. What came through no fault of yours will leave the same way, in its own time, without your help. Reach for the medicine and you will cling to it until the clinging is the sickness. Wait, and there will be cause for joy.

lines.image: acting after the time has closed.
lines.reading: At the top the move has run its whole course, and even a true one goes wrong from here, because the season for acting is over. This is knowing how to go forward and not how to stop, going at full strength into a dead end. Nothing is helped by it. Be still, and let the thunder that has rolled be finished.

gene_keys.shadow:
A tightness you have carried so long it feels like you is how this energy shows at first. It is in the breath: a grip across the chest, a tension pressed down into the belly, learned as a child from the way the people who raised you breathed. Fear is what the grip is made of, and fear is clever. It is afraid of itself, so it never turns to look, and never looking is what keeps it alive. It reaches out into how you hold things, an opinion or a person, and love, which only grows where there is room, dies in the grip. Most of the time you read the tightness as something out there to be handled, so you go out to handle it, and the relief lasts as long as the handling does. Choked down, it takes more of you, until a whole life can be lived around it, a half-life of distraction.

The tightness is not the enemy. It is the start of the way, and turning toward it instead of away is the whole of the beginning.
gene_keys.repressive: This person has arranged never to look at their own pain. All their energy goes to not seeing it, and they call the not-seeing peace. The deeper the wound is held down, the dimmer the rest of them goes. It is a managed kind of numb.
gene_keys.reactive: Here is someone who cannot bear how the wound feels, so they hate it, and the hatred comes out as cold. Warmth is pushed away the moment it comes near, because warmth reminds them of the pain. Nobody gets close for long. The chill passes for strength, and it is a flinch.
gene_keys.gift:
Letting what is there be there is this energy at its full, and it is a seeing rather than a method. It begins in the body. Whatever you feel, you let the body feel it, down to where even fear is only a sensation, a chemistry, and reduced to that it loses its hold, so you no longer have to be afraid of being afraid. After a while the breath drops lower on its own. Then the feelings, met once the breath has steadied: you may weep, or go cold, and none of it overwhelms you, because you have remembered your heart, which says things are still all right underneath. Last the mind, which lets go when the heart has, like a manager who has spent all day keeping the machines from overheating and finally gives up.

This is not resignation, the dropped head that decides nothing can change. It is done with the head up, almost with defiance: I see you, and you are only the beginning. Every attempt to accept yourself shows a further place where you do not, so what is finally accepted is your own helplessness. Life keeps testing it, and each time it goes deeper.
gene_keys.siddhi:
This is love with nothing personal left in it. It is the thing that holds everything together, and from here you cannot say you love anyone more than anything else, because the same warmth goes to all of it. It cannot be reached by wanting it. The heart cannot be forced open this far. The only way is to go on allowing until the personal flavour burns off, and what remains is a knowing in the cells that everything is one.

Blood is its oldest picture, the one thing that passes from person to person down the generations, holding both the wound and its cure. From here nothing about the tightness is shameful: it was the only door, the grit inside the oyster that the pearl forms round. Every time someone comes through to this, a knot loosens a little in everyone, in people not yet born.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Opposite this code in the genetic code sits UL 46. The open spirit is held by the one that loves the body and the delight of being in it, and the soft approach is what both of them arrive at. Acceptance and delight are partners. Love opens through ease, never through force.

human_design.gate:
Gate 25 is the pull toward something larger than you, and what it drives you to do is bow: to live as an offering rather than as a performance put on to prove your worth. The love it carries is the purest a body holds, and that is its difficulty as much as its strength. A love this open has no single person to land on, so it can overwhelm the one carrying it, or leave you idealising people, missing what is plainly wrong with them. In you it runs as trust: you are not easily disillusioned, and what knocks other people flat leaves you standing, still open.

The misread is to mistrust the pull and make things from will instead, proving your worth by effort. That is spirit gone cold. What looks like naivety in you is usually the opposite: an innocence that has decided, on purpose, to stay open, taking up no more room in the world than its place, no less either.
human_design.centre:
This pull is felt in the centre of the chest, in the Identity Centre, which holds who you are, the way your life faces, and love, as one thing. It is the still point of the whole chart, a magnet with one pole that only draws, pulling toward you the people your life needs, the work too, and that pull is called love itself. So the spirit you carry is wired to who you are: to live the love is to be who you are, then let the rest be drawn in. When you trust it, the right things arrive without being chased. When you abandon yourself for a borrowed direction, the current jams, and you are at war with your own life.

For six people in ten this centre is switched on, and love runs out of them like a stream that does not stop: somewhere under the noise they know they are lovable. In the other four it is not, and the question of being lovable stays open. They take it up from whoever is near, and the wound they carry is the fear that if they are nobody in particular there is nothing to love. What waits on the far side of that fear is the strangest thing this pull gives: to stand not on an identity at all, but on being love itself.
human_design.channel: Open love on its own has no edge to wake it, so it can drift, never arriving. Its other half is Gate 51, in the small centre over the heart, the gate of shock, the blow that cracks a life open. Together they are the Channel of Initiation, the move from the mind's control to the heart's. The pairing is rough on purpose: this love does not mature by being protected but by being struck, and the heart is pushed past the personal into something wider. Whichever of you carries the other half, the waking happens where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: Within the Codon Ring of Humanity, this code is the hub, the core of what it is to be human. Its kin, UL 10, 17, 21, 38, and 51, carry the rest of the human story: how we tread, how we follow, where we bite through, how we stand in opposition, and the shock that initiates. Together they are the family that holds the whole drama of being a person, with the seed of love at its centre.
tarot.tarot_resonance: This code draws its Arcana along three lines of descent, the codon ring and the two trigrams. The ring gives one Major, the Chariot, the will that steers a powerful motion in a straight line. The two trigrams give their own faces. Heaven above carries the Fool and the Empress, pure beginning and open abundance. Thunder below carries the Tower and Judgement, the shock that breaks the old form and the call that wakes the new life. Nothing in this set can be held back, not the step off the cliff, not the wall thrown down, not the dead standing up.

body.physiology:
The heart is where this energy lives, and the reason is the blood. The heart sends the same blood to every part of you, picking no favourites: the brain and the little toe get it alike, a full round of the body in about a minute. It has done this since about three weeks after you were conceived, before there was a brain to know it. That is what this love is like from inside, a warmth that goes to everything because that is the only way it goes. Fear does its work here too. When you are afraid the chest tightens around the heart, the breath rises high, shallow, and the whole front of you holds.

Put your hand flat on the left of your chest. Under it the beat goes on, sending out to everything, and around it you can feel the tightness. Let the fear be felt instead of braced against, and the chest gives, by a fraction, then a fraction more. It does not have to be told. It only has to stop being held.
body.amino_acid: The love this energy carries has a chemistry in you, and the substance is arginine. It is wound into every protein you are made of, one of the twenty small pieces there are, and there are times you cannot make enough of it: a body healing from a wound falls short, taking the rest in from meat or beans. The tightness you were born into comes in layers, wound close, the way the thread that carries what you are is wound in every cell, and the layers are relaxed one at a time, deep inside you, until the flow of love is moving in you again. What you are accepting is in your body, wound into it, and it loosens as your body does.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 26, this code is the open sincerity that must be reined in and stored before it can be of any use.

pair.teaching: Turned over, Innocence becomes Great Taming, one movement caught at two points along its length. One is the spontaneous true motion, the thunder under the open sky. The other is the great restraint that holds and accumulates that force, the firm hand on the powerful thing. Pure sincerity and the discipline that stores it up are the same energy seen from two ends.

inverse.teaching: Flip this code's lines and you get Great Taming. The same innocence, read from the other side, is no longer a thing rushing freely outward but a thing held back on purpose, ripened in the holding. What is wild at one end is cultivated at the other.

programming_partner.teaching: Opposite this code in the genetic code sits UL 46. The open spirit is held by the one that loves the body and the delight of being in it, and the soft approach is what both of them arrive at. Acceptance and delight are partners. Love opens through ease, never through force.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Humanity
codon_ring.teaching: Within the Codon Ring of Humanity, this code is the hub, the core of what it is to be human. Its kin, UL 10, 17, 21, 38, and 51, carry the rest of the human story: how we tread, how we follow, where we bite through, how we stand in opposition, and the shock that initiates. Together they are the family that holds the whole drama of being a person, with the seed of love at its centre.

tarot.teaching: This code draws its Arcana along three lines of descent, the codon ring and the two trigrams. The ring gives one Major, the Chariot, the will that steers a powerful motion in a straight line. The two trigrams give their own faces. Heaven above carries the Fool and the Empress, pure beginning and open abundance. Thunder below carries the Tower and Judgement, the shock that breaks the old form and the call that wakes the new life. Nothing in this set can be held back, not the step off the cliff, not the wall thrown down, not the dead standing up.

sky.teaching: the cardinal water that begins from feeling and shelters what it loves, a tenderness that initiates. The open heart of this code finds its season here.

immortals.teaching: Han Xiangzi stands above, the flute-player among the Eight Immortals whose music could make flowers open out of season, and Cao Guo Jiu below, the one who walked away from the inherited court. The flute sounds without calculating and the courtier's hands are empty of borrowed station, and between them the truest motion is the one that opens like a bloom with nothing to gain by opening.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the enclosure that holds a field so what grows in it is protected, the boundary that makes innocence safe rather than naive. The path it stands on carries the spirit across the threshold of the heart.

cards.essence: This energy is a great strength held in, the way the whole sky is held inside a mountain. In you it is the power to make things happen. When you set your will on a thing it tends to come, the position, the room turned toward you, and you can dress a true thing so well that people take it in. You love being seen carrying something that matters. None of that is the flaw. Under it runs a quieter thing, an intention that was there before you chose anything, and everything you have done well was done in its direction.

glance.reading:
This energy is a great strength held in, the way the whole sky is held inside a mountain. In you it is the power to make things happen. When you set your will on a thing it tends to come, the position, the room turned toward you, and you can dress a true thing so well that people take it in. You love being seen carrying something that matters. None of that is the flaw. Under it runs a quieter thing, an intention that was there before you chose anything, and everything you have done well was done in its direction.

At full strength the will is not spent; it is penned. There is a fear that says nothing is given, only taken, that the world is short so you had better get yours first, and a person run by that fear cannot rest for a moment. What you were made for cannot be forced out. It can only be listened for, under the noise of your own plans. Held that way the strength does not weaken. It ripens out of sight until the drive that used to grab is a thing you give, and what you are selling is worth the selling.

Listen before you push. When the want is loudest, stop, and wait for the aim you did not invent. When it comes clear, sell it with your whole heart, for the love of it. Then leave no fingerprint on what you made better, since the change matters more than anyone knowing it was you.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Heaven: the whole force of the sky held inside a still mountain, and it loses no power for being held. It gathers, the way a river dropping its silt builds black soil year on year. The traditional character sets great, the will pointed at one aim, beside a sign that means to hold, to feed, to tame.
iching.reading:
You are holding a great power, and the work now is to hold it, so that it grows instead of leaking away. Most strength is spent the moment it arrives, on the first thing in front of it. Here the force is the largest there is, and the counsel is to keep it in, not to crush it, the way a strong young animal is penned so that what would scatter becomes substance. You came to this by getting what you have without scheming, and what was got honestly is what can be stored.

What it asks runs two ways at once. Fill yourself daily with what those before you said and did, until it has built something in you, the way silt builds soil. Then set out with an aim across the great water, and do not eat at home: take no profit from the people you serve, because a power that feeds itself has already begun to leak. Held long enough, kept true, the pen opens of its own accord, and the strength that grew in the dark walks out on the open road.

In the body this energy is the hand laid over the head, the part of you that holds placed above the part that drives. Notice where you are holding yourself now. Rest a hand flat on the top of your head, feel how much wants to move under it, then keep it there a moment longer.
judgement_lines: Great taming. It furthers to hold to what is true.
Not eating at home brings good fortune. It furthers to cross the great water.
image_lines: Heaven within the mountain: the image of great taming.
So the wise gather the sayings of the past and the deeds of those before them, and build their character with what they gathered.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: danger at hand; it furthers to stop.
lines.reading: Danger is one step ahead, and the strength you have is real. This is not its hour. Press on now and you walk into what was waiting. Hold, and it passes you by. There is work on yourself still to finish before you reach for anyone else's. Stop here, gladly, and let what is in you go on growing where nobody sees it.

lines.image: the straps taken from under the wagon.
lines.reading: The wagon is loaded, and the strap that would let it roll has been taken off. It does not move, and there is no resentment in that, because you are the one who took it off. What you carry is not lost by waiting. Keep it whole, wait for the hour to let it out, and know that the stopping was wisdom, not failure.

lines.image: a good horse giving chase, with driving and defence practised daily.
lines.reading: Now the held strength is let run, a fine horse giving chase, and those above are with you. The danger is speed, going so fast that you slip. Train every day, at driving and at guarding, so the skill matches the force. Know the road is hard, stay upright on it, and it is right to have somewhere to go.

lines.image: the board fitted over the horns of a young bull.
lines.reading: The horns are only beginning, and the guard goes on now, while they are soft. Restraint this early costs nothing, so no one is ever gored, because the fault dissolves before it has formed. There is joy in that, the good fortune of the thing caught at its start. Fit the guard while the strength is young, and it grows up gentle.

lines.image: the tusks of a gelded boar.
lines.reading: A boar gelded keeps its tusks and loses its fury; the hard thing is still hard, it just no longer wants to charge. The danger is not fought here. It is changed at the root, by softness. Empty the mind of the fight and fill the belly. Tame the wild thing in you that way, so you can keep it safely for the rest of your life.

lines.image: the open highway of heaven.
lines.reading: The long holding is complete, and the pen stands open. What was gathered in the dark walks out onto the open road of heaven with nothing in its way. The one who strove where no one could see is known now, and what was worked at in private is done in the open, on a grand scale. Go, because the way is wide.

gene_keys.shadow:
Nothing comes to you in this life unless you reach out to take it: that is the voice of pride, and it is a fearful voice, not a loud one. It believes the world is short of what you need, so you had better get yours, and it cannot relax for a single moment, because resting feels like falling behind. It is clever. It finds the bargain, edits its own conscience, and does not see that what is taken from one place is taken from the whole.

Will really can move things, and people run by it do climb, do win, do get the position. The cost is hidden until late. To rise by will alone you push others down, mostly without noticing, and each one cuts another thread tying you to everything around you, so that however much you have, inside it is never enough. Under all of it is the oldest fear, the fear of being no one, and the more solidly you build yourself up, the more that fear has to feed on.
gene_keys.repressive: This person has taken the pride underground. It comes out sideways: a put-down dressed as concern, shame slid in where no one can point to it. Most of it runs below their own notice, so they rarely feel answerable for the small wounds left behind. Cunning, spent on making others feel less.
gene_keys.reactive: Here the pride is worn out loud: what they own, who they know, all of it to be seen as anything but powerless. The display is meant to draw admiration; it draws envy. Under it a great anger is held down, and when it goes off it is the ugliest pride there is.
gene_keys.gift:
Will is not intention, and learning the difference is the whole turn. Will is you forcing your idea onto the world. Intention was already running underneath everything you do, before you chose anything, and it cannot be forced out, only listened for. The more you listen inward, the more you find it behind every word you say, and the moment you stop pushing in order to hear it, everything changes.

What opens is artfulness, which is pride used instead of being used by. You love attention, and that is no longer a flaw: this is the love of selling a true thing, of dressing it so that people take it in, in the exact language of the person in front of you. Sold through fear it is a con; sold through love it is a craft. In a camp where most were huddled waiting, one group scavenged what it could, lit a fire at the centre and cooked a stew big enough to share. That is the same cunning, turned toward the whole. The question it lives by is plain. Giver, or taker.
gene_keys.siddhi: To give up an ego you first need one worth giving up, and here the pride is not destroyed but polished, all the way, until the same energy that grasped is a jewel put to the service of everything. What is left is invisibility, which does not mean unseen. It means unfindable, the way quicksilver is, taking the shape of whatever holds it: wherever you look they are there, and when you try to pin them down they are gone. Good is done that no one can trace back, and the doer wants no credit, since only they know. These are the tricksters every people keeps, who take life less seriously than anyone and so touch it more deeply, who lure the mind with a puzzle to lead it past its need for answers. Nothing they do is for reward. The laughter that comes off them rings like a string of bells and asks nothing back.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Its programming partner is UL 45, the gathering of the tribe around one who holds it together. The transmitter and the gatherer think alongside each other. Value only matters when it moves through a people. The one who sells and the one who unites are running the same circuit of the tribe between them, one carrying what is worth carrying, the other holding the hands that reach out to receive it.

human_design.gate:
The pull to carry what is valuable to the people who need it is where this energy enters the body, and Gate 26 is its door. It is a real engine: the capacity to decide a thing and do it, to stand in front of people convincing them that something matters. What decides everything is what the selling serves. Aimed at filling your own store out of a fear of not having enough, the same drive turns pushy and faintly false. Aimed at a real answer to a real need, it is the warmth that makes a good thing spread.

From outside it can look like self-promotion, and the mistake is to stop there. The cost of carrying this is what happens when you do not believe you can afford your rightful place: you trade your values for feeling safe or accepted, and your worth goes under the fear. People who carry this all their lives learn to act as if they are precious, to take care of themselves so they have something to give, and to sell only what they know is worth the price.
human_design.centre:
The small place over the heart is where this pull is felt, the Will Centre, the smallest of the nine places and one of the four engines, the one that deals with the material world. It holds value and capacity, the plain charge of I can do this. It is an engine, which works then rests; pushed on without rest it burns out, and the rest only comes to a person who believes they are worth resting.

In fewer than four people in ten this centre is switched on. For someone like that, saying what they will do, then doing it, is the ordinary run of a day; each promise kept builds trust in the next, and proving themselves is a kind of play. Around them other people feel able to do more than they could alone, then lose it when they leave. What starves them is driving on ambition with no listening under it, until the body gives out. In the rest it is not, so worth is borrowed from whoever is nearest: they walk into a room and pick up someone's sense of being not enough, then spend years trying to prove a value that was never in doubt. For someone like that the work is to taste what is valuable, to let their values change, and to stop proving. An orchid is not worth more than a daffodil, and they were never asked to be.
human_design.channel: A strong voice with nothing true to say is what this drive is alone. Its other half is Gate 44, in the gut's instinct, the part of you that reads in a flash whether a thing is sound or rotten. The two make the Channel of Surrender: the will hands the choosing to what already knows, then carries what was chosen to people with everything it has, doing a great deal of work in a fraction of the time. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the sale is honest only where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: This code belongs to the Ring of Light, a family of four bound by the chemistry of light and the amino acid threonine. Its siblings are UL 5, UL 9, and UL 11: the patience that waits in rhythm with the cosmos, the small taming that holds focus on the detail, the peace where heaven and earth meet. This code is the one among them that bends light through the will, the finder of shortcuts through the matrix. The family as a whole governs how a body takes light in and turns it to instruction.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Nothing arrives here in a hurry: one Arcana down the codon ring, two off the mountain, two up from the heaven beneath it. The Ring of Light carries the Star, the quiet light that heals after the storm. The two trigrams each lend their own faces: Mountain above as the Hierophant and the Hermit, the keeper of the lineage and the one who walks apart to find the path; Heaven below as the Fool and the Empress, the open beginning and the abundance that pours. Every one of them is holding something in reserve, the banked star, the kept lineage, the lamp carried apart, the step not yet taken, the harvest waiting on its season.

body.physiology:
The thymus is the place in you where your body learned what is its own, and this energy lives there because the fear under pride is of never having enough, of being no one. Behind the top of your breastbone sits a soft gland where one kind of guard cell is taught. Each arrives unfinished to be tested there, and any that would turn on your own tissue is put down before it leaves, so what stands guard in you knows you too well to attack you. A will that cannot rest wears your guard down; a will that has softened is felt in the same place, as warmth through your chest.

Most of its work was done in your childhood: it is largest in infancy, shrinking from the time you stop growing, though the cells it trained stand guard in you still. Lay a hand flat below the notch at the top of your chest: you are resting it on the part of you that knows what is yours.
body.amino_acid: The will in you has a substance, and the substance is threonine. You cannot make it; your body takes it in, from fish or eggs, or goes without. Four kin in you are built of it, sharing one work, which is what your body does with light, and yours is the part done by the will: what you let in is turned to your use. The one thing you can check on any bright day is this: sunlight on your skin makes something in you that your body needs and cannot make in the dark. What comes to you from outside, your will turns into what you have.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 25, this is the will that gathers and the will that lets go, the same power tamed and the same power left wild and clean.

pair.teaching: Turned over, this code becomes its pair, Innocence. Great Taming is power accumulated, held, disciplined into substance. Innocence is power with nothing added, action that rises clean with no calculation behind it. One tames the great force by penning it; the other trusts it by getting out of its way. They are the same strength met from opposite ends, the held and the unguarded.

inverse.teaching: Turned over, this code becomes its pair, Innocence. Great Taming is power accumulated, held, disciplined into substance. Innocence is power with nothing added, action that rises clean with no calculation behind it. One tames the great force by penning it; the other trusts it by getting out of its way. programming_partner.teaching: Its programming partner is UL 45, the gathering of the tribe around one who holds it together. The transmitter and the gatherer think alongside each other. Value only matters when it moves through a people. The one who sells and the one who unites are running the same circuit of the tribe between them, one carrying what is worth carrying, the other holding the hands that reach out to receive it.

sky.teaching: the fixed air that holds a vision steady for the whole and pours it out like water, the sign of the gift turned toward everyone rather than the self.

immortals.teaching: Zhang Guo Lao stands above, the old hermit who rides his donkey facing backward, seeing where he came from more clearly than where he is bound, and Han Xiangzi below, the flute-player who left an inherited position to follow the way. The backward rider keeps the wisdom of what came before, the flute-player walked away from borrowed rank to sound his own true note, and the great force is tamed between the two of them.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the letter the Star carries, the hook that draws the hidden thing up out of deep water into the light. It speaks of meditation and the quiet line cast inward, the accumulated power drawn up gently rather than seized.

cards.essence: You carry nourishment, the care for whatever cannot yet feed itself. Everything alive is fed by something else and feeds something else in turn. When you feed something you are fed by it. This care is the hand that reaches out before you have thought.

glance.reading:
You carry nourishment, the care for whatever cannot yet feed itself. Everything alive is fed by something else and feeds something else in turn. When you feed something you are fed by it. This care is the hand that reaches out before you have thought.

The care has to begin with you, because nobody can feed anyone from an empty heart. Before you give, ask what would help the people you belong to. Ask what would help you and you get a different answer. Generosity has little to do with what you own. What you give is your time, and when you give it freely a day lasts longer. A day with an open heart moves like a river through open country, slow and full. A day spent holding on is over before you have drawn a breath.

Give to what will grow. There are seasons when life closes in and every day is worry, with no room in you for anyone else. In that season you tell yourself you will give once you have enough, and that day never comes. When you hold on to stay safe, you stay hungry. When you close yourself so you cannot lose anything, you cannot be fed either. Open your hand a little and you are fed.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Thunder is the hexagram of how you are fed. Thunder is the movement in you that reaches for what you need. Mountain is the stillness in you that knows when you have had enough. The stillness sits above the movement because reaching on its own never stops. That is why this hexagram has long been read as a mouth. A mouth opens to take food in and closes when it is full. The same mouth speaks. So the care you take in eating is the care you take in what you say. You are fed by what you reach for and by when you stop.
iching.reading:
You have gathered something, and now it is time to eat from it and feed others with it. You stand at the mouth, where food goes in and words come out. What matters now is what you let in and what you let out. Heaven and earth feed every living thing. The wise feed the people who will feed others, and so it reaches everyone.

This time asks for care in two things: what you eat and drink, and what you say. Words are food too, so what you say to someone is something they have to eat. Keep to the kind who feed rather than take. Feed the ones below you before you go asking from the ones above.

Your jaw is the place to check. When you are reaching for more than you need, it hangs a little open, ready for the next thing. Close your lips, let the jaw go loose, and chew what you already have before you swallow it.
judgement_lines: Nourishment. Holding to what is right, it goes well.
Watch what you feed, and watch what you reach for to fill your own mouth.
Seek what fills your mouth from its source, and the source is yourself.
image_lines: Under the mountain, thunder: the jaws.
So the wise are careful in what they say, temperate in what they eat and drink.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: the tortoise that lives on air set down, and a mouth watering at another's plate.
lines.reading: You have what the tortoise has, enough in yourself to live on. You have set that down to stare at what someone else is eating. Your own share is enough, and the staring is what makes it feel small. Nobody respects a mouth hanging open at another's table. Turn back to what is yours and eat from that.

lines.image: food sought from the hill-top, against the way it flows.
lines.reading: Food flows down from the strong to the weak; that is its proper way. You are reaching up the hill for it, toward someone with nothing to spare either. Going that way costs you your friends, because you have turned from the ones beside you. Ask nothing of the people above you. Feed yourself from where you stand.

lines.image: the back turned on what feeds, for ten years.
lines.reading: You have turned your back on what truly feeds you and care only for food and clothes. Keep that up as firmly as you like and it still ends badly. The part of you that you are starving is what keeps you alive. Ten years can pass that way with nothing to show for them. Stop now, while it has cost you ten years and not a life.

lines.image: a tiger's stare, fixed and hungry, and no fault in it.
lines.reading: This hunger is the right kind. You look down for what you need the way a tiger looks, steady and about to spring, and there is no fault in it. Asking those below you for the strength you lack is no shame, so long as you mean it and force nothing. Keep your eyes on what feeds you and go when it moves.

lines.image: off the usual road, and holding the ground where you stand.
lines.reading: You are off the usual road, responsible for people you have no means to feed. Stay upright where you are and lean on the one above you who has what you lack. Leaning is no weakness; it is how the wise find what is right. Keep what is in place and start nothing new. Do not cross the great stream yet; the big leap is not for this season.

lines.image: the one the food comes from, in a high and dangerous place.
lines.reading: You are the one the food comes from now, and everyone below you eats from your hand. The place is dangerous because so much rests on it, and it goes well because you know that. You have fed others through a hard time, so you can feed them in any season without being told. Cross the great stream: the big leap is yours.

gene_keys.shadow:
Selfishness is holding on to what you have, and it is the oldest move there is. Everything alive eats something else, and one thing's death is another's birth. You are in that chain, and holding on is what kept your blood line in it. So it is not a sin, whatever you were told. But it makes a small room, where life is tight and worry runs under everything. When you hurt inside you have no room to think of anyone else. At the table you eat with your arm around the plate.

You came into the world unselfish. A house or a school taught you to take, and what you learned you can unlearn. What is missing underneath is a purpose, a reason for your life bigger than yourself. People will do almost anything to avoid feeling that gap: once they went to war to fill it, now they go shopping. Stay in the small room long enough to ask what the larger reason would be. That question is what makes the room bigger.
gene_keys.repressive: Held down, the selfishness turns into giving everything away, and none of it from the heart. What this person hands over is their own strength, with no limit on it. So people use them, or resent the strain in the gift. A thin guilt runs under all of it, and slowly the body pays.
gene_keys.reactive: Turned outward, the giving has a hook in it: this person gives to get something back. It looks generous until the return does not come, and then the anger underneath breaks the surface. The shock is how generous it looked at the start. This giving comes from the head, never the heart.
gene_keys.gift:
Care that wants nothing back is your nature, and nobody taught it to you. When one dolphin in a pod is in trouble, the whole pod turns toward it at once, with no decision made. An older one will give its life for a younger without a pause. They all know it at the same moment, as if they were one body. That is how you care. When your arm comes off the plate it goes to the middle of the table, and you are fuller for it.

This care knows, without being taught, what is worth giving to whom. It will not feed anyone's wish to stay helpless. It is the same pull that keeps a parent beside a child for the first seven years, the years that shape everything. A wound of your own from those years heals as you give what you did not get. What comes off you is trust, so people near you lower their guard, some for the first time in their lives. Purpose wells up out of this like water from a spring and spreads to whoever stands close.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Nobody sits at the head of this table now. You still feed people, and there is no you doing it. What remains is a longing your body carries, for everything to be at peace with everything else. Food is only the visible part of it. This is different from doing good. The ones who help so they will be seen, or to cover a pain of their own, still have a self doing the helping. Here no self remains, so these people go unnoticed, ordinary as anyone in the street.

They give without end and never run dry, fed by the love around them. Where an ounce of life remains in anything, this care can reach it. Listen from there and everything eating and being eaten sounds like music. What you hear in it is love. You came into the world without a self and you will leave it without one. The self in between is something you dreamed up.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This care keeps a body alive and cannot say what the life is for. The Dark Side of Light holds what this one lacks: a reason to live, and the nerve to risk something for it. Without that reason you eat for the sake of eating, and you turn selfish. Open it when you are fed and still do not know why you are alive.

human_design.gate:
Low in you sits the pressure to look after what is yours. Gate 27 is the name for it. It drives you to feed and protect the people you are responsible for, yourself among them, before anyone has asked. It is the pull that checks the door at night and counts the ones asleep. Nobody has to ask, and when it has nowhere to go you are restless without knowing why.

Left to itself, the same pull feeds people who did not need it and holds them so close they cannot grow. It picks up loads that were never yours, until you are tired, unthanked and sour. The question to ask is whose problem this is. Treat the other person as able, and let go with love so they can find their own strength. Looking after yourself is not the selfish part.
human_design.centre:
This care sits in the Sacral centre, low in the body between the navel and the thighs. It is the strongest energy you have, the one that brings a child into the world and feeds it. It does not decide; it answers. Put something in front of it and your gut says yes or no before you think. In anyone who carries it the caring is warm and motherly. Spend it on what you said yes to and it comes back as fast as you spend it. Spend it out of guilt and it drains. People learn to take from it, because a yes they talked you into looks like yours.

Most people, about seven in ten, have this energy running on its own all day. They can trust their gut about who is theirs to look after. Their risk is the role of the one who is always there. They keep it up long after the wanting has gone, until they get ill. The other three in ten have no caring energy of their own and take it in from the people around them. They can look after everyone in a house for a while. Then it is gone all at once, because nothing in them said when enough was enough. What they can do instead is stand back and watch the caring without joining it. They know what is theirs to do and what is not.
human_design.channel: On its own, the drive to feed does not know what deserves feeding. What completes it is Gate 50, the part of you that holds the values a family lives by. It sits in the Spleen centre, which knows by instinct what keeps you safe. Together they make the Channel of Preservation, two gates joined into one line of energy. With both you guard what you value. Not everyone needs your care, and Gate 50 knows it. It may sit in you or in someone close to you, and the channel runs only when both gates are present.

tarot.ring_role: This care is the feeding that keeps one thing alive on another. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death. The other five go by their UL numbers, the numbers printed on the cards. UL 3 is where a life begins and UL 20 is where you stand fully in it. UL 23 is where it falls apart, UL 24 is where it comes back and UL 42 is where it grows on. Together they hold the turning of life into death and back.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, come to this card through its family and its two trigrams.

body.physiology:
The sacral plexus is where feeding ends in you, and that is why this energy is given to it. It is a weave of nerves on the inside of the flat bone at the base of your spine. The same low place holds the energy to carry and feed a child. What went in at your mouth this morning ends its road here. Nerves from this weave move the last of it along and say when to let go. Low in your back beside it, you keep the strength you were born with. You lived on that before you could eat, and every meal since has added to it.

You are doing it now. Something you ate is on the last of its road, and this weave is moving it without a thought from you. Put your hand on the small of your back, where the bone goes flat. Your hand is resting on the part of you that finishes what feeding began.
body.amino_acid:
The care in you has a substance, and its name is leucine. Your body cannot make it. It arrives in meat, eggs or beans, or not at all. After a meal your muscle notices it first, and between meals it is gone. Whether you hold on or give, you are running on the same chemistry.

Give for the sake of giving and you start healthy currents deep in your body. This care shares its chemistry with five others in its family.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 28, this is the whole knot of feeding and purpose, the mouth that takes in and the weight that decides whether any of it was worth the taking.

pair.teaching: This care feeds whatever is in front of it and never asks what the feeding is for. The Dark Side of Light is where it goes next, the weight of everything you have taken on. Open it when you are feeding everyone and cannot say why. That is when you carry more than you can bear.

inverse.teaching: This care is the same whichever end of it you stand at. Its hexagram is one of the eight that come back unchanged when turned over. Whether you are the one feeding or the one fed, the law is the same: to give is to receive. Feed the people around you and they feed you.

programming_partner.teaching: This care keeps a body alive and cannot say what the life is for. The Dark Side of Light holds what this one lacks: a reason to live, and the nerve to risk something for it. Without that reason you eat for the sake of eating, and you turn selfish. Open it when you are fed and still do not know why you are alive.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Life and Death
codon_ring.teaching: This care is the feeding that keeps one thing alive on another. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Life and Death. The other five go by their UL numbers, the numbers printed on the cards. UL 3 is where a life begins and UL 20 is where you stand fully in it. UL 23 is where it falls apart, UL 24 is where it comes back and UL 42 is where it grows on. Together they hold the turning of life into death and back.
