sky.teaching: the element of the ring's Arcana, the quick transforming force that wakes and consumes, influence as the thing that catches and spreads.

immortals.teaching: Zhong Li Quan stands above, the old general who left command behind to seek the way and carries the fan that revives, and Zhang Guo Lao below, the hermit who rode his mule backward, facing where he had been. Ridden backward, the mule keeps its rider's face on what he already knows, and the fan revives in hands that gave up command; influence here comes of both.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the letter of fire and of breath, the sound that grinds the old down so the new can be spoken.

cards.essence: This energy is the art of lasting, the way a thing goes on after the newness has worn off. It lives in the long middle of things: the marriage years past the wedding, the work that no longer announces itself, the practice kept on a day when it gives nothing back. What lasts does not hold still.

glance.reading:
This energy is the art of lasting, the way a thing goes on after the newness has worn off. It lives in the long middle of things: the marriage years past the wedding, the work that no longer announces itself, the practice kept on a day when it gives nothing back. What lasts does not hold still.

Lasting comes with one knowledge: the only failure is the failure to live well. Under it sits a fear older than you, the body's memory that to be cut off from the others was once to die, and in a modern life that fear hides inside money, so that no amount arriving ever quite settles it. What it wants is not the number. It wants to belong to something that goes on, and it is fed by every choice that ties you to a larger life rather than cutting you off from one. An ending is not a failure when it ends with grace. Letting life in, even where it hurts, is what makes you stronger.

Keep the strong old root and put the new growth onto it. Some of what you have is worth carrying to the next generation, and some is dead wood. Knowing which is the whole craft, and letting the dead wood go takes the same nerve as saving the rest. There will be days of a low hum of panic, rushing from one thing to the next to reach some rest that never comes, and that hum is the fear of failing with the words taken out. Slow down inside it, and the things worth keeping will still be there.

iching.trigram_combination: Thunder over Wind: the shock that moves above, the breeze that works below, and the two go on together without wearing out. Both are wood, so the picture is a tree, stirring at its crown while its roots hold. The name means to continue in the same spirit: constant, habitual, renewing itself as it goes.
iching.reading:
You are in the long middle of something, past its beginning and well short of its end. This is the sequel to being drawn together: the two who met are a household now, and the question has changed from how to begin to how to go on. The sky over the earth goes on, the sun goes on, the seasons turn and go on, with none of them standing still to do it. They last by changing inside a shape that does not change.

What it asks is that you stand firm and do not change your direction, while everything inside you keeps moving. Outwardly, conviction. Inwardly, a change that never stops. The way to endure is to keep changing, and the way to fail is to grip. You may be carrying more than you should have been asked to carry; endure it with dignity, and if good fortune comes, carry that with humility. You cannot force anyone else to change with you, only yourself. Keep near the ones least like you, because a thing that lasts is made of parts that are not the same.

In the body this energy is the legs, the feet that move you and the thighs that carry the weight. Notice how you are standing now: rooted, or shifting, or braced against the ground. Stand as a tree stands, and let the top of you move. It furthers to have somewhere to go.
judgement_lines: Lasting goes through, and there is no fault in it.
Holding to your course brings reward. It furthers to have somewhere to go.
image_lines: Thunder and wind, moving on together: that is lasting.
So the wise stand firm in their place, and do not turn with every wind.

upper_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
upper_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lower_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
lower_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lines.image: digging for depth at the very start.
lines.reading: Digging deep on the first day, you are asking for the settled form of a thing before it has had time to grow one. Depth is not forced; it comes to what has lasted. Push for it now and there is loss whichever way you turn, with no direction that helps. Let the thing find its own pace, even where that feels like losing control.

lines.image: regret gone, in the middle place.
lines.reading: In the middle place, with the strength held in balance, the regret goes. You are neither eager nor unwilling, holding to the road rather than to any one thing on it, so there is nothing to defend and nothing to correct. Keep the power you have in check, showing only what the moment needs. Constancy like this leaves no cause for sorrow.

lines.image: a character that will not hold its shape.
lines.reading: Setting your heart on something without staying with it, you are seen to waver, and even where you are right it shames you. Keen to advance, quick to fall back, a beginning with no end, and nobody makes room for someone like that. Keep to your own stated principles, the ones you ask of others, before you go on.

lines.image: a field with no game in it.
lines.reading: Hunting a field with no game in it, you can be as patient as you like and nothing will come. The persistence is real; the place is wrong. Constancy spent on the move, far from where you belong, catches nothing. Go back to your own ground and be still there, since only stillness catches anything.

lines.image: constancy in one virtue, good for the one who follows, bad for the one who leads.
lines.reading: Holding steadily to a single way, you are faithful from start to finish, and whether that is good depends on your part. For the one who follows it is right, and it holds. For the one who has to decide, the same steadiness is a fault, since deciding needs the freedom to change with what comes. Know which part is yours before you keep to it.

lines.image: agitation kept up as if it were constancy.
lines.reading: Shaking yourself into endurance at the top, the force has run out and you are keeping up the movement anyway. You feel full while you are empty, raised high and about to fall. Restlessness kept up for years is not perseverance, and it achieves nothing. Choose a long road and commit to it, then stop wasting yourself on motion.

gene_keys.shadow:
Failing has one meaning in the body, and it is being cut off. Long before you, the ones you come from learned that to be put out of the group was to die, and that lesson is still in you, older than any exam or business you ever failed at. In a modern life it has moved into money: the larger the number, the further from failure you feel, yet it never settles, because fear always needs something to feed on, and if money went it would find the next thing. Its close cousin is the fear that your line dies out, with no one to hand anything to.

The fear made people stingy in spirit, keeping to their own small circle, and it kept the species alive while it did. It is rooted deep in the body, and it is the mind that feeds on it, telling the fear's story over again. When you let go into the pattern life moves in, the support was there all along, and what you truly need comes when it is needed.
gene_keys.repressive: This person contracts. The circle is drawn tight, the rules held so hard they cut, and everything outside the circle is suspect. They are choking themselves, in body as in money, starved of breath and of help. Groups made this way stop meeting the wider world, and in time they die out.
gene_keys.reactive: Here the thread has been dropped. Underneath is anger, the anger that nothing holds you up but yourself, and it drives one bad decision after another, each cutting a little further from the source. The days stop belonging to each other. It can look like freedom next to the tight ones. Nothing in it lasts.
gene_keys.gift:
Keeping things alive is what this energy becomes, and its whole art is knowing what to keep. You begin to sense the long arc of a thing, whether it has a future in it, before you could say why. You can hold your energy back from what tempts but will not serve, and trust a feeling about someone that no reason supports. The balance is between restraint and risk: what to keep as it is, what to change. The one who buried what he was given, for fear of losing it, lost it.

The craft is grafting. You keep the old root, the part that has proved itself strong over generations, and you set the young shoot onto it. Nature is the old root, you the young shoot, which is why the old ways draw you. Then you see that what you were fighting to preserve was never the real thing, and the shell of it cracks. A man once planted trees every day in widening circles around his home, through wars and governments, most of them dying, until a forest stood where there had been bare ground, with villages living off it. Nobody knew who he was. He knew.
gene_keys.siddhi: Reverence is the state of seeing your place in the chain of living things, and it is what remains when the fear has burned all the way out. Below you are lives less far along, above you lives you cannot follow yet, and you look at your own place with no self in the looking, so all that is left is wonder. You stand on the shoulders of the ones who came before you, and you give your shoulders to whoever comes next. Even the smallest insect is holding you up. You feel tiny and immense in one breath, a single thread from the past to what is still to come. It gives off something, a scent caught on someone in whom wisdom has taken up residence. Wisdom lives in a host, passes through, and moves on to the next one. The one discipline it asks is to pause, and listen inward.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Duration is only half of it. UL 42, Moving to Perfection, carries the other half, the art of letting go. They share a long focus on endings, on death, on what is released back. The one who knows what to preserve is held by the one who knows what to release, and between them is the whole breath of a life: a thing held strong, a thing let go, neither without the other.

human_design.gate:
A sense of what will last is the pressure in you, and Gate 32 is where it works. It reads a thing, a plan or a bond, for whether it has a future, before you could say what you saw, and it tells you which chances to take for the long run. Growth under this pressure comes in cycles rather than leaps; real change takes time, and you know it in your body. The drive is to prepare, to set the stage, to be ready when the time comes without dragging it forward.

From outside it can look like caution, or like clinging. The cost is the fear of failing, which can stop you from even trying, or from preparing, so that when the time finally comes you are not ready for it, or it can push you the other way, too hard for too long, against a timing you cannot command. People who carry this all their lives learn the difference between holding on and clinging, learn when to let go, learn that patience was their power all along.
human_design.centre:
Under the ribs on the left side is the place this pressure works from, the Spleen Centre, the body's awareness of what is safe and what is not, older than thought. It is the centre of time: it meets each moment fresh, adjusting in the instant to keep you well. It is also the centre of the survival fears, and the one that belongs to Gate 32 is the fear of failing, which says I am not going to try. The sense of what will last works from the same place that fears loss, which is the whole teaching: the instinct and the fear come up one channel.

For the ones in whom this centre is switched on, a little over half, the sense of timing is their own; they can act in the moment, on a hunch, and be right, with a body that stays well while they trust it. The risk is the mind talking over the hunch, asking for reasons, and the hunch does not repeat itself. For the ones in whom it is not, time slips or presses, so they are always late or always early, while the fears in a room feel like their own. What they have instead is a fine sense of what is healthy for someone else. For them the moment to act is not to be trusted; the slow decision is.
human_design.channel: The sense of what will last is a reading with no force behind it: it can see the long arc and cannot climb it. Its other half is Gate 54, at the base of the body, the ambition that pushes a life upward from where it started. The two make the Channel of Transformation, which knows which big dreams to follow and has the drive to bring them to fruition, whether in work or in waking up. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the dream only moves where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: Within the Ring of Illusion this code sits with one sibling, UL 28, the crossing into the dark. The ring's theme is what is not as it seems, the great illusions of failure and of death, the fears that look solid and dissolve when you walk into them. This code carries the illusion of failure; its sibling carries the illusion of death. Both are doors the body mistakes for walls.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five Arcana hold this card up, one carried by the codon ring and two by each trigram. The ring gives the Moon, the dreaming water under consciousness where memory and fear move unseen. Thunder above gives the Tower and Judgement, the shock that breaks the false structure and the call that wakes the buried thing. Wind below gives the Wheel of Fortune and Death, the turning of the long cycle and the passage that changes form without ending. Not one of the five stands still, and that is the teaching: what lasts here lasts by turning, breaking, and being called up again.

body.physiology:
The spleen is where this energy is kept, and the reason is keeping. What passes through it is sorted: the worn out retired, what still serves kept for use. Every red cell in your blood lives about four months, and this is where most of them end, taken apart; the iron that reddened them is kept, then built into the next cell. Your body loses almost none of its iron. What reddens your blood today was carried by cells that are gone, and by cells before them, so the red in you has been yours for years. In the old medicine the spleen keeps from the other side too: it holds the blood inside its channels, moves the water through you, and turns what you eat into what you live on.

It sits behind the stomach, high under the left ribs, about the size of your fist. Look at the pink under your fingernails: that colour is blood, and the iron that reddens it has been kept for you by what sits under your ribs, cell after cell, for years.
body.amino_acid:
Lasting has a chemistry in you, and the substance is asparaginic acid. It is built into the letters your body is written in, part of what each of them is made from. Joined to one other piece it is the sweetener in a diet drink, printed on the can. What is yours in it is the fear of dying with your life unfinished, the fear that ties death to money in a body that keeps and counts; that fear is chemistry too, older than any account.

The same substance is the old root and the young shoot: what has held for generations, with the new set onto it so it grows. In your body the keeping with the grafting is one chemistry, shared with one other energy, the one that fears the ending itself.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 31, this is the whole of bonding, the courtship that draws two together and the long marriage that has to last after.

pair.teaching: Together with Theater of Truth, these two are the deck's full story of union. One is the attraction, the courtship, the moving toward. The other is what comes after the joining, the steady art of staying. Influence draws the two together; this code is the marriage that must now endure the years. The same lines, turned over, become each other.

inverse.teaching: Flip this code's lines and you get its pair, the moment of first attraction. Read from that end, the long marriage is only the early pull seen far down the road. What looks like steady endurance from one side is, from the other, the same charge that first drew two people across a room.

programming_partner.teaching: Duration is only half of it. UL 42, Moving to Perfection, carries the other half, the art of letting go. They share a long focus on endings, on death, on what is released back. The one who knows what to preserve is held by the one who knows what to release, and between them is the whole breath of a life: a thing held strong, a thing let go, neither without the other.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Illusion
codon_ring.teaching: Within the Ring of Illusion this code sits with one sibling, UL 28, the crossing into the dark. The ring's theme is what is not as it seems, the great illusions of failure and of death, the fears that look solid and dissolve when you walk into them. This code carries the illusion of failure; its sibling carries the illusion of death. Both are doors the body mistakes for walls.

The ring gives the Moon, the dreaming water under consciousness where memory and fear move unseen. Thunder above gives the Tower and Judgement, the shock that breaks the false structure and the call that wakes the buried thing. Wind below gives the Wheel of Fortune and Death, the turning of the long cycle and the passage that changes form without ending. Not one of the five stands still, and that is the teaching: what lasts here lasts by turning, breaking, and being called up again.

sky.teaching: the last water of the wheel, where the separate forms dissolve back into the one current, memory and dreaming and the chain that runs through all of it.

immortals.teaching: Cao Guojiu stands above, the noble who walked away from the inherited court to find a truer ground, and He Xian Gu below, who took the way of purity and lived on the breath of the mountains. Neither an inherited court nor mountain breath can be owned; what lasts never clings to position. One let go of borrowed power, one fed on what was light and essential, and both endured by holding to a course rather than a possession.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the dreaming mind below waking, what lies under consciousness, the path running from Netzach to Malkuth that carries the deep pattern down into the body.

keywords: The Story Told at Its Hour
cards.essence: Looking back is the energy here, the part of you that turns to read the road it has already walked. A life is mostly read the other way, as what is coming, with the next thing always arriving, so the road behind drops away unread and the same week comes round again as if it were new. This energy stops and turns. Gathered and held until it makes sense, what happened to you stops being a wound. It becomes something you can hand to another person. It lives in the quiet you keep for yourself, and in the story you tell when the quiet is over.

glance.reading:
Looking back is the energy here, the part of you that turns to read the road it has already walked. A life is mostly read the other way, as what is coming, with the next thing always arriving, so the road behind drops away unread and the same week comes round again as if it were new. This energy stops and turns. Gathered and held until it makes sense, what happened to you stops being a wound. It becomes something you can hand to another person. It lives in the quiet you keep for yourself, and in the story you tell when the quiet is over.

Hindsight as a practice gives part of every day to what has just gone by. Ask what was best about yesterday and bring it back, the hours you were awake, into the body; the hours you were not, let go down the stream, forgiven. A day with no pause in it has no harvest, however much was done, and that is why some lives are exhausting in a way nobody can name. The pause need not be a thing set apart. Tea drunk with attention is a pause, and so is work done as if it mattered. Done with a friend, it is the oldest thing people do: sit by a fire and talk about the good times.

The way runs in seasons, and it is not always the season for turning round. When it is, the people near you will call it by the wrong names, dwelling, living in the past, and often you will call it that yourself. There will be days when you have gone quiet, hard to reach, without deciding to, and it is not the same as being lost. Something is being read in there that has not finished. What it comes to will be worth the wait.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Mountain: the sky far above, and under it a mountain, which is where walking stops. The sky moves on while the mountain stays, and the distance that opens between them is the retreat. The traditional character is footprints that stop short, beside a small pig cut in two by a hand: an offering made on the way out, the wealth a person carries off by walking away.
iching.reading:
You are asked to leave, and to leave well. Something small has been gaining ground for a while, and it will not be argued with; this is the sixth month, when the days begin to shorten, which nobody can stop. To stay and fight is to spend strength on ground that is already going. What the season asks is to withdraw while withdrawing is still yours to choose, and that is not flight. You leave with what you own, at the pace you set, keeping your strength for a day when it will count.

Keep the small at a distance, and do not hate it, since hating would tie you to it. Be firm, be stern, shut the door, and keep no bitterness behind it. Knowing when to withdraw is the hardest wisdom there is, and the whole of it is timing: a step back at the right hour turns out later to have been the way forward. In small things it still pays to hold to what is right, because that is where the ground is kept for the return.

In the body this energy is the head and the hand, the head above still going on, the hand below stopped. Notice where you are holding yourself now: the hand that has let go of the work, the head still up and looking. Let the hand rest, keep the head where it is, and go.
judgement_lines: Retreat. It comes through.
In what is small, holding to what is true still serves.
image_lines: A mountain under heaven: that is retreat.
So the wise keep the small at a distance, not in anger, with reserve.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
lower_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lines.image: the tail of the retreat, and danger.
lines.reading: At the tail of the retreat, with the danger at your back: you have left it late, and you are the last one out. Any move now would only draw the danger on. The deer that outlives the tiger runs at the head of the herd; if you cannot reach the front, step aside and stand still while the rush goes past. Make no move in any direction.

lines.image: held fast with a strap of yellow ox hide, which no one can loosen.
lines.reading: Held fast by a strap of yellow ox hide, which nobody can loosen: your purpose to withdraw is tied off, and nothing outside can work it free. Yellow is the colour of the soil at the centre, and hide cured that way does not give. Stay quiet, stay empty, so that nothing from outside gets in, no thought slips out, and neither praise nor money can move you.

lines.image: a retreat that is tied, dragging its sickness after it.
lines.reading: A retreat that is tied, dragging its sickness after it: you want to go and cannot, because you are held by what is near you, too familiar to let go of. Held like that, nothing large can be done, and the strain of it wears you down. What you can still do is feed the household that depends on you. Keep that much, and let the great work wait.

lines.image: a willing retreat, made in spite of what you love.
lines.reading: A willing retreat, made in spite of what you love: the thing you are leaving is a thing you wanted, and that is the whole of the test. The small cannot do it; they cling, and call the clinging loyalty. Store the strength away while the small thing is still small, guard your life the way you would guard a jewel, and go without a backward pull.

lines.image: an admirable retreat, made at its proper hour.
lines.reading: An admirable retreat, made at its proper hour: the work is done, and the one who did it steps down before anyone asks. He could have taken the throne and did not. With brilliance to spare he shows none of it, keeps to the good, and lets nothing false damage what is real. Hold to what is right, and withdraw while it can still be done well.

lines.image: a rich retreat, and nothing left to doubt.
lines.reading: A rich retreat, with nothing left in doubt: you go with everything you came in carrying, and nothing can move you or bind you. Inside there is no damage, outside no loss, and there is nothing to hold down, since nothing in you is pulling the other way. Go, and go gladly, because everything serves.

gene_keys.shadow:
You have lived this week before, and it arrives feeling new. The argument and the cold days after it, many times over, each time as if for the first. That is what forgetting is like from inside: not a gap, but the present. A life is read as a rush, with something always coming at you, the next thing on the screen, and the road already walked drops away behind you unread. What keeps you asleep is the memories you carry, and what keeps you making more of them is every wish you have, each one pulling the net a little tighter. One wish loosens it, the wish to remember yourself.

The people you cannot get free of do most of the loosening. Someone you feel you have known from somewhere, loved and fought with in turns, is where the forgetting is thinnest, if you stay. Unattended, the forgetting leaves you feeling separate, alone, and that feeling is the one thing everyone shares.
gene_keys.repressive: This person has gone into hiding. They say little, cannot get out of their own silence, feel forgotten by the world and arrange to be, in work or in a numbness that passes for calm. When they do wake, the wisdom they took in surprises everyone, themselves first.
gene_keys.reactive: Others prod. Out of an old anger they point at the faults of the people near them, dressed as help, until they get the reaction they were after, because a fight proves someone is there. It builds until it bursts. When the pattern breaks, they remember what it is to be loved.
gene_keys.gift:
Something changes the day you catch yourself in the middle of an argument and see that you have forgotten who you are. You are not free of the pattern yet; you can see it, which is new, and for a while seeing is worse than sleeping, because now every repeat is felt. The patterns seem to get stronger the nearer you come to the end of them. They are not; you are more awake. Nothing you do can hurry it, and the only thing to lean on is the watching.

The old picture for it is a clearing in a forest. You have been walking head down for months, then the trees open, there is light, a place to sit, and from there the path you have been on can be seen for the first time. Sit down in it. What you bring back from there goes into the body, and told to a friend it softens the edges between you. This is also where genius lives: what you can watch in yourself without drowning is what you can make something from, once you are out of its way.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Revelation is a flood, and it comes as silence. Everything you were is forgotten, everything you could be is remembered, all at once, the whole of the story rising out of the deep of time so that you see it entire, and there is no past left to be cut off from. After the flood in the old stories there is always a sign, a dove or a rainbow, and the flood itself is a memory of your own future. The ones who live here have nothing to say, and when they speak it is to say so.

It has the colour of autumn: the leaves come down, brighter just before they fall, and the light turns inward. The story is ending, and the ending is not a loss. Fall in love with your own story and follow it without holding anything back; it will reach its end, unlike anyone else's.
gene_keys.programming_partner: UL 19 stands at the far side of the wheel from this code. The one who would retreat and remember is held by the one who feels the pull toward closeness and need. You forget yourself most thoroughly in the company of the people who need you most, and that same crowded room is the one place you can wake back up.

human_design.gate:
Turning what happened to you into a story that can be handed on is the pressure this energy puts on the body. Gate 33 is where it enters: the need to step back from the world, alone, until what you went through has given up its meaning, then to come back and tell it. It is not gossip and it is not a report. It is the meaning that was hidden inside the experience while it was happening, found afterwards, in private, and carried out to whoever needs it. You need more time alone than most, and the time is not against anyone.

From outside the stepping back looks like distance, the looking back like dwelling on what is over, and both get said to you. The cost is a story that has set hard around the pain, told and retold as what was done to you, which keeps you where you were, with whoever hears it. People who carry this all their lives learn that a story has finished teaching only when it can be told so that someone else stands up straighter, and they wait for that hour.
human_design.centre:
The throat holds this pressure, the Throat Centre, the one place in a person where what is inside becomes something outside, a word or a deed. Everything in you presses to get here, from every side, and it has no engine of its own: whichever part of you it is joined to is the one that talks through it. Here the join is to the centre of the chest, where who you are lives, so what you say comes from who you are, and you are what you talk about. That is also why a hard word about what you told can shut you for years: it landed on you, not on the story.

In about seven people in ten this centre is switched on, and the voice is the same in every room, one song, sent out rather than taken in. For someone like that the retelling is always there to be done, and the whole craft is when. In the other three it is not, so the voice takes its shape from whoever is near and hands it back. For someone like that there is a pull to talk before anything has been listened to; kept quiet until asked, they end up saying what the whole room remembers.
human_design.channel: Looking back has nothing to tell until something has been taken in. Its other half is Gate 13, in the centre of the chest, the listener, the part that hears other people's stories and keeps them; the two make the Channel of the Prodigal, what was witnessed, held, then brought back changed. It gathers, goes quiet, and speaks at the hour the story can land. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the story comes back only where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: Within the Ring of Trials, this code is the first of the three tests. Its siblings, UL 12 and UL 56, carry the other two: the trial of the true self and the trial of distraction. Together they are the three places in the code where the sequence stops, the clearings in the forest, the trials that cannot be walked around, only through.
tarot.tarot_resonance: A single lamp goes up a dark mountain, carried by a man who left the road on purpose, and this card's Arcana come in by three roads. The codon ring gives one Arcana, the Hanged Man, the willing pause. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Heaven above as the Fool, the one who steps off into open air; Mountain below as the Hierophant and the Hermit, the keeper of what was handed down and the one who climbs alone to see. Between them the retreat shows its full shape, a stepping back that is also a stepping up, into stillness, into the long view.

body.physiology:
Your throat is given this energy because you have only ever heard your own voice from inside. Everyone else hears your voice through the air. You hear it by a second road too, through the bones of your own head, which carry the low notes best. So the voice you have listened to all your life is the one from within. The voice everyone else knows reaches you only played back, thin and high, like a stranger's. That is looking back in your flesh: a life heard from the inside by the one it happened to. Below your voice sits the gland that keeps a store of what it makes, two to three months laid down ahead, so that what is running you today was made a while ago.

Block both ears with your fingers and say a few words. Your voice is louder and deeper at once, because the road through the air is shut, leaving only the one through the bone. What you hear then is the part of your own voice that was always yours alone.
body.amino_acid:
No substance in you answers to this energy. It is a mark in what you are written in, one of three that name nothing, and where your body reads it the reading stops. The message runs on past it, written out to its end; it is the reading that stops there, not the writing. When this mark comes alive in you, it begins to unplug you from the world your outer senses show. Further on, past every stop in you, another beginning is written, so that something starts where you come to an end.

Two others in you carry the same stop, and this is the first of the three, where all of it begins. What shakes a body out of its sleep is the strength of its own dissatisfaction, and this is the stop that dissatisfaction wakes.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 34, this is the whole breath of strength, the power that surges forward and the wisdom that knows when to draw it back.

pair.teaching: Together with Sublime Power, these two are one motion seen from both ends. One is the great strength pushing forward at full force, the other is that same strength reading the turn and stepping back before it overspends itself. Advancing and withdrawing are not opposites here. They are the in-breath and the out-breath of the same power.

inverse.teaching: Together with Sublime Power, these two are one motion seen from both ends. One is the great strength pushing forward at full force, the other is that same strength reading the turn and stepping back before it overspends itself. Advancing and withdrawing are not opposites here. They are the in-breath and the out-breath of the same power.

programming_partner.teaching: UL 19 stands at the far side of the wheel from this code. The one who would retreat and remember is held by the one who feels the pull toward closeness and need. You forget yourself most thoroughly in the company of the people who need you most, and that same crowded room is the one place you can wake back up.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Trials
codon_ring.teaching: Within the Ring of Trials, this code is the first of the three tests. Its siblings, UL 12 and UL 56, carry the other two: the trial of the true self and the trial of distraction. Together they are the three places in the code where the sequence stops, the clearings in the forest, the trials that cannot be walked around, only through.

tarot.teaching: A single lamp goes up a dark mountain, carried by a man who left the road on purpose, and this card's Arcana come in by three roads. The codon ring gives one Arcana, the Hanged Man, the willing pause. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Heaven above as the Fool, the one who steps off into open air; Mountain below as the Hierophant and the Hermit, the keeper of what was handed down and the one who climbs alone to see. Between them the retreat shows its full shape, a stepping back that is also a stepping up, into stillness, into the long view.

sky.teaching: the yielding element that wears down the hardest rock without force, that finds the low place and rests there, the still deep that surrenders and so cannot be broken.

immortals.teaching: Han Xiangzi stands above, the flute-player who could call flowers into bloom out of season and who chose the recluse's road over the world's reward, and Zhang Guo Lao below, the old hermit who rides his donkey facing backward, watching the road already travelled. The recluse's road cost the flute-player nothing, and the backward rider sees best from the far end, so withdrawal subtracts nothing, and facing where you came from is its own clear-eyed way of seeing.

hebrew_letter.teaching: reversal and surrender, the letter of the deep waters that hang the situation upside down so it can be seen true. The ring's path runs from Severity across to Splendour, strength learning to let go into form.

keywords: The Strongest One in the Room
cards.essence: This energy is power itself, the oldest strength there is. It was in the first seed that split its own shell to push up through the soil, and it is in you as the drive to make things happen, to be more than you were. There is a great deal of it in you, and people feel it when you come into a room. You did not choose it. It is what you are made of, and the whole of your life turns on how it is spent.

glance.reading:
This energy is power itself, the oldest strength there is. It was in the first seed that split its own shell to push up through the soil, and it is in you as the drive to make things happen, to be more than you were. There is a great deal of it in you, and people feel it when you come into a room. You did not choose it. It is what you are made of, and the whole of your life turns on how it is spent.

The power has no trying in it once it runs the way it is made to. Strength is the same force as pushing, with timing in it, and the difference between the two is a hair wide. It moves with the current, the way a swimmer goes with the water instead of against it. It comes from the belly, not the head, and the head cannot run it. The animals have it right: they do not move so much as they are moved. When you know a thing in your body the answer is simple, because it never went through the mind. Easy is right, and that does not mean lazy. It means the strong thing and the easy thing are one thing once you have stopped fighting your own life.

Wait, which for someone this strong is the hardest thing there is. The power was never built to start from pressure; it lies quiet until life puts something real in front of you, then pours the whole of itself in. Listen for the word try in your own mouth, because it arrives the moment you have begun pushing life where it will not go, and from there the pushing only gets harder. Stop pushing, and the force lets go of you. What is left is strength, which was underneath the whole time.

iching.trigram_combination: Thunder over Heaven: the sky with the whole of its strength, and above it the first crack of thunder. The strength has climbed nearly to the top, with only a little softness left above it. The traditional character sets an old weapon beside a scholar, force with a mind on it, and the word it writes means fully grown, at the peak of strength, the age when strength does damage.
iching.reading:
Your strength is at its full height, and the holding back that built it is over. Whatever you kept in through the long quiet has grown until there is more of it than anything around you can stop, and it came up on its own. This is power at its peak, the ram in its third year, at the age when its strength is greatest, and you are ready. That is the whole situation, and it is also the danger, because the danger here is never weakness. It is the strength itself. Power this size draws envy from people who have less, and it invites the reckless move.

What it asks is that the strength be held to what is right. Go nowhere that is out of accord, however strong you feel, because the strong move in this hour is the measured one. Never strike until you can strike at full strength, and never from vanity, since only the weak are merciless. Let the way open on its own before you go through it. Be the axle under the cart, the part that turns the wheels and is never looked at, rather than the cart everyone admires.

In the body it is the foot that carries this energy, the part of you that moves first and bears all the rest. Notice where the strength is sitting now, whether it has already reached the feet and wants to walk. Stand with the whole of it under you, unhurried, and hold it there until the way opens.
judgement_lines: Great power, the strength of what has grown to its full height.
It goes well for the one who holds it firm and holds it right.
image_lines: Thunder stands in the sky above: the picture of great power.
So the wise walk no road that is out of accord with what is right.

upper_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
upper_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: strength in the toes, and the toes already marching.
lines.reading: Strength has reached the toes, and already the toes want to march. What you have is real, though it is not gathered yet, so to set out now would be the early move, and the early move ends badly however certain it feels. Empty yourself and find someone who knows more. Keep the strength where it is until the rest of you has caught up with your feet.

lines.image: the strong one at rest in the middle, with no fence in sight.
lines.reading: Strong, and sitting in the middle, with no fence anywhere in sight. This strength has nothing to prove and nothing pushing it, so for once it is in balance: firm on the inside, giving on the outside, with more in reserve than shows. Strong here means no feeling can throw you, and active means no old habit holds you. Keep to that, and it goes well.

lines.image: a ram charging the fence, its horns caught in the wood.
lines.reading: A ram runs at the fence and its horns catch in the wood. The small spend every bit of strength they have out where it can be seen; the wise spend none. To push on here is dangerous even when you are right, because you would be hurt before you gained a thing. Hide the strength, look as though you had none, and keep away from the fence.

lines.image: the fence opened, and strength in the axle of the great cart.
lines.reading: The fence has opened by itself, and nothing catches. The strength has gone from the horns to the axle, the hidden bar under the cart that turns the wheels while everyone looks at the cart. Nothing needs forcing now, and any regret over what was forced before is gone. Set yourself right first, then others, who are ready to listen. Be the axle, and go.

lines.image: the ram lost in easy country, and no regret.
lines.reading: The ram is gone, lost in easy country, and nothing is lost with it. The time calls for strength and you have none of the butting kind left, which is no fault of yours. Open your mind instead to what others know, because that is how the ones who are not strong become strong. Empty the head, and the belly fills. Let the stubborn thing go, and stop charging.

lines.image: the ram caught in the fence, unable to go back or forward.
lines.reading: The ram is caught, and it can neither back out nor push through. At the far end of strength there is nowhere left for it to take you, and nothing you force from here will help. The one move left is the honest one: see the difficulty for what it is, because the seeing is the way out. Admit that you are stuck, and the fault will not last.

gene_keys.shadow:
Trying is the whole of this low, and you can hear it in your own mouth, in the words I am trying. They arrive the moment you start pushing life where it will not go on its own. From then on you cannot stop in the direction you set out in, and anything anyone says to help falls on deaf ears. The people around you cannot understand how you can be so blind, and their anger takes you by surprise, because the force has no idea it is doing anything. It is the oldest power there is, older than anything with a face, with one purpose, to keep one living thing alive, and it does not know that anyone else exists.

The body knows before you do. Every time you push against the grain of your life, your spine tightens somewhere, and the pushing grinds you down, into a stoop, into an ache in the back. Go to the ache and stay with it instead of fixing it from outside. It is there because of something you are doing or not doing, and the longer you listen to it, the more plainly it says where your life wanted to go.
gene_keys.repressive: This person is afraid of their own strength and hides from it. They put themselves down and take anyone else for the authority, usually because a childhood taught them to. People walk over them, all that power backs up inside, and it comes out as tiredness. Only leaving the situation brings the strength back.
gene_keys.reactive: Here is someone who pushes people around and has no idea they are doing it. Challenged, they are furious; warned, they charge on, and it ends badly for them. Underneath they are misunderstood, taught to be like this without knowing it. What they need is one hard thing to put the anger into.
gene_keys.gift:
Strength is power that has learned its timing. It uses the same wild energy as the pushing, spent on the right thing at the right moment, with nothing in its way. There can be enormous exertion in it, a whole day of work, with no resistance anywhere, so the work flows out of you and you are one with it. It is the strength of the one who has stopped provoking, whose easiest fight is the one never picked. The best of it is physical: the runner or the dancer, anyone whose movement people cannot look away from, and that comes the moment the watching self has stepped out of the way.

This power has always wanted to be seen, the way a flower opens its colour to bring the bee, and there is no vanity in it. Carried well, the wanting draws the right eyes, because real strength never goes unnoticed. This is where heroes come from, ordinary people who did the brave thing without deciding to, who are uneasy being praised for it because it seemed to happen through them. Strength does not know it is strong. That is the whole of its secret.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Majesty is what is left when there is no one trying to be strong or weak. A young man who had trained for years in the art of reconciliation sat on a crowded train, ready to flatten a drunk who was frightening everyone in it. Before he could move, a small old man called the drunk over and asked him about his garden, then, gently, whether he had a wife. The drunk wept with his head in the old man's lap, and the young man got off having watched everything he had trained for, done without a single move.

This is the body with nobody in it, moved by life, and the eye cannot look away from it. It stays hidden, and it always finds the easiest way. A god in a human shape would never know it was a god. That is what you are at this height: joy with a body.
gene_keys.programming_partner: UL 20, Emerging as the Code, holds the other end of this line. Raw power is held by pure presence, the now. Strength only becomes majesty in the instant when the one who has it disappears into the moment of acting and stops claiming the act as their own.

human_design.gate:
Using the strength you have is the pressure here, and Gate 34 is the door it comes through, the busiest door there is: a reserve of life force that has to be spent on something, that turns on you when it is not. You feel it as sheer available energy, the capacity to keep going long after others stop, or as the restlessness that builds when there is nothing real to put it behind. The pressure is not to start things but to answer them. When the answer is a true yes the strength is catalytic: it gathers the right people around one idea and gives it a push that lasts.

From outside, someone carrying this can look like the busiest one in the room while being the least effective, because power spent on things that never asked for it is only busyness, and it leaves you feeling powerless in the middle of all that doing. The cost of pushing to fill the time is that the strength runs out on nothing. People who carry this all their lives learn that the power was never theirs to wield, only to carry, and that it moves most when they have waited.
human_design.centre:
Low in the body, under the navel and above the legs, is the engine this pressure comes from, the Sacral Centre, the strongest engine you have. It gets up in the morning, works all day and falls asleep used up. It does not decide anything. It answers: something is put in front of you, a sound rises before you have thought, a yes that lifts or a no that goes flat, and it only ever answers what is actually there. The head cannot run this engine. When you drive it from the head, deciding to be powerful, the strength goes to waste.

In about seven people in ten this engine runs all the time. For someone like that the power renews by being used on the work they had a yes for, and it burns out two ways: doing what had no yes, or doing nothing at all. Every drive seated here passes through the first excitement, the jump in, then a flat stretch where nothing moves and the only question is whether you are finished or paused. In the other three the engine runs on whatever is near it. Someone like that takes in the strength of everyone around them, can outwork any of them for a while, and cannot keep it up. What they have instead is the pause, knowing when enough is enough before the body has to say so.
human_design.channel: This pressure has no single partner. It reaches three ways at once, into a knot of four about surviving as yourself. To Gate 20 in the throat it makes the Channel of Charisma, where the power gets a voice. To Gate 10 in the chest it makes the Channel of Exploration, where it becomes behaviour that is yours alone. To Gate 57 in the gut it makes the Channel of Power, where it gets an ear for the right instant. Whether the other ends sit in you or in someone near you, the strength moves only where two meet.

tarot.ring_role: The Ring of Destiny holds only two cards, this one and UL 43, Breakthrough. One is the force that moves through the body, the other the knowing that breaks through the mind, and together they shape the destiny of the whole line, the strength that stood the human spine upright and the insight that came once it was standing. A small ring, and a heavy one.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Lightning takes the top off a tower, and this card gathers its Arcana from three directions at once. The codon ring gives one Arcana, the Wheel of Fortune, the turning of fate. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Thunder above as the Tower and Judgement, the strength that shatters and the strength that wakes; Heaven below as the Fool and the Empress, the pure beginning and the abundance it grows into. Taken as one image, this is raw power turning on the wheel of timing, breaking and waking above, originating and fruitful below.

body.physiology:
This energy lives in your sacral plexus, and the reason is the belly. Power comes from the belly; pushing comes from the head, and you can tell them apart by where you feel them. The sacral plexus is a weave of nerves low in you, below and behind the navel, lying against the inside of the flat bone at the base of your spine. Nothing in you is watched less, and nothing in you is stronger. It drives the great muscle of the buttock, the one that holds a human being upright, it sends the largest nerve in the body down each leg, and it does all of it without asking you.

Stand up from a chair. The muscle that straightened your hip took its order from this weave before you had finished deciding to stand, and so did the muscles that kept your hips level while your weight moved. You did not do it, and you will not feel it. That is the power in you that no one is watching, and it is the strongest thing you have.
body.amino_acid:
The strength in you has a substance, and the substance is asparagine. Your body makes it for itself, out of what it already has, and asks nothing from your plate for it. The proteins that face outward from every cell you have wear their coat of sugar on it. When you are lost to the force moving through you and can hear no one, this is the chemistry at work. Left alone, the life in you runs fluid and cheap; every push against the way it wants to go burns more of you than the flow would have, which is the tiredness that follows forcing.

The strength that moves you and the knowing that breaks in on you unasked are made of one substance in you. The softest thing there is goes through rock without once pushing, and given its way the strength in you does the same.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 33, this is the full breath of strength, the long holding back and the moment the held power finally moves.

pair.teaching: Together with Echos of Time, these two are one motion seen from its two ends. One is the strategic withdrawal, the strength pulled back and conserved. The other is that same strength arrived at its peak and released. You cannot have the great power without the retreat that stored it. Holding back and breaking out are the in-breath and the out-breath of one force.

inverse.teaching: Turn this hexagram over and it becomes its own pair, Retreat. The strength that climbs from the ground here reads, from the other end, as the strength that knows when to leave the field. Power and the wisdom to withhold power are the same lines, simply approached from a different direction.

programming_partner.teaching: UL 20, Emerging as the Code, holds the other end of this line. Raw power is held by pure presence, the now. Strength only becomes majesty in the instant when the one who has it disappears into the moment of acting and stops claiming the act as their own.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Destiny
codon_ring.teaching: The Ring of Destiny holds only two cards, this one and UL 43, Breakthrough. One is the force that moves through the body, the other the knowing that breaks through the mind, and together they shape the destiny of the whole line, the strength that stood the human spine upright and the insight that came once it was standing. A small ring, and a heavy one.

tarot.teaching: Lightning takes the top off a tower, and this card gathers its Arcana from three directions at once. The codon ring gives one Arcana, the Wheel of Fortune, the turning of fate. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Thunder above as the Tower and Judgement, the strength that shatters and the strength that wakes; Heaven below as the Fool and the Empress, the pure beginning and the abundance it grows into. Taken as one image, this is raw power turning on the wheel of timing, breaking and waking above, originating and fruitful below.

sky.teaching: the planet of expansion and largeness, the force that magnifies whatever it touches. Great power under Jupiter is strength asked to grow without swelling into excess.

immortals.teaching: Cao Guo Jiu stands above, the noble who walked away from the inherited court to find a truer ground, and Han Xiangzi below, the flute-playing wanderer who made flowers bloom out of season and cared nothing for rank. One renounced borrowed authority and one turned his force into music, and great power rests easy with the pair of them because neither grips the strength he carries.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the hand held open, fate received rather than seized, cycles turning through the grip that does not close. The ring's path runs from Chesed to Netzach, mercy reaching down into the endurance that carries it.

cards.essence: This energy is hunger: the wanting that nothing you have yet has satisfied. In you it is the reach for the next thing: the street you have not walked, the face you have not met, the experience still ahead, wanted now, before the one in your hand is finished. It is the part of you that cannot leave life alone, the appetite under everything you would call progress. Whatever you hold, some of you is already looking past it, and that looking is what moves you.

glance.reading:
This energy is hunger: the wanting that nothing you have yet has satisfied. In you it is the reach for the next thing: the street you have not walked, the face you have not met, the experience still ahead, wanted now, before the one in your hand is finished. It is the part of you that cannot leave life alone, the appetite under everything you would call progress. Whatever you hold, some of you is already looking past it, and that looking is what moves you.

This hunger is sweet as long as you sip it and do not swallow it. It can be savoured and drawn out. It is what makes you human, and what brings people to one table. It does not need a far country. A circle half a mile wide around your own door holds more than one life can get through, provided you meet the same street as new each time. It is new; even the sky over it has moved since yesterday. What goes stale is the looking, not the world, and looking kept fresh makes an ordinary morning something you taste.

Take the hunger to the edge and stop there, the way a glass of wine is best a sip short of too much, so that a smile from someone you love is what tips you over. Keep a little hunger back. A little of it is your backbone; too much you pay for, in tiredness and in wanting more. In a hard stretch the hunger and your impatience feed each other, wanting it now, then wanting the next thing sooner, until nothing you reach for is tasted at all. You will overshoot more times than you can count. Be as forgiving of that as you would be of anyone else who was hungry.

iching.trigram_combination: Fire over Earth: the sun, and under it the ground it is climbing away from. This is the sun just up, clear of the field and still rising, the light spreading further every minute until the whole day stands open. Its creature is the horse, spirited strength that keeps to the ground. The traditional character sets the sun beside a sign for reaching: the daylight world, spreading.
iching.reading:
You are in the easy part of something, when the light is coming up and the way ahead is clear. What you set going is growing on its own now, the way young plants grow in full sun, and other people can see it. This is the season when you are wanted. The old picture is a lord at ease, given horses by his king in great number, called in to see him three times in one day, so well liked that his company is wanted morning, noon and night. You did not seize any of it. Being received is the situation itself.

What it asks is that you rise the way he rose. He served the ones above him with loyalty, the ones below him with generosity, and that was the whole of his climb. Advance like a mouse, small and quiet, then take your seat like a lion. Be willing to change before you ask anything else to. The light coming up does not make you good; it shows the good that was already in you, so let it show, then brighten it a little every day. The one thing that can spoil this is grabbing at it, because a good run pushed becomes a chase.

In the body this energy is the eyes. Notice where your looking is now: lifted, ahead, taking in more than it did an hour ago. Hold yourself as the sun holds itself in the morning, rising with no hurry, lighting everything on the way.
judgement_lines: Progress. The lord at ease is given horses in great number, and is received three times in one day.
image_lines: The sun comes up over the earth: the image of Progress.
So the wise brighten the bright worth that was already in them.

upper_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
upper_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: wishing to advance, and held back.
lines.reading: Held back at the first step, with nobody yet ready to trust you. The block is outside you, so is the trust, and neither says anything about what you are. Stay straight, stay calm, and keep a large mind toward the ones who have not believed you yet. Be generous before it is earned; the trust follows the patience, never the other way.

lines.image: advancing, and sorrowing; a great blessing from the grandmother.
lines.reading: Going up and grieving at the same time, the way you dread a winter before it comes. Both are true, one does not cancel the other, so hold your course through the sadness without hurrying to fix it. The blessing here comes from behind you, from those who went before and put something by. What arrives now was planted a long time ago; let yourself receive it.

lines.image: everyone around you in agreement.
lines.reading: The people round you come into agreement, and the regret you were carrying lifts. Rising is not only being seen from above; it is others moving with you, you with them. Where your own light is dim, borrow theirs without shame, since that is what company is for. Go along with them, and let them go along with you.

lines.image: advancing like a rat.
lines.reading: Getting on the way a rat gets on, quick and low, at night, hoarding what it can grab. From outside it looks bright and inside it is dark, so however correct each move is, the place you are in cannot hold what you are reaching for. Watch, too, for who is feeding on what you have built. Advance so that you could be seen doing it, or do not advance.

lines.image: regret gone; loss and gain no longer worth a worry.
lines.reading: The regret is gone, and from here it no longer matters whether any one day goes up or down. Loss takes its turn with gain, and what is promised is the long run. Empty your mind of the score, and the belly fills. Go forward now, one step at a time, and everything you meet will help.

lines.image: advancing the horns.
lines.reading: At the top of the climb, horns lowered, the only thing left to advance with is force. Turned outward it is conquest, and it spoils everything the light did. Turned on your own city, the unruly parts of you, it is the hard work of self-mastery, and it succeeds. Do it without drawing it out, and know that having needed force at all is the regret you keep.

gene_keys.shadow:
The low of this energy is a hunger that no meal ends. You eat, and within the hour the emptiness is back, faint at first, then not, until you are reaching again. You do not know what you want; you only know you want it now, and while you want it you cannot think about what it costs. So the reach goes out through the door, for food, for someone, and each fills you for about as long as it takes to notice you are full. Then the emptying starts. At that moment two mistakes wait: you hold on to the thing, calling it love, or you blame it for failing you and move on.

Nothing brought in through that door has ended it, because what would end it is not out there; a taste of fullness fetched from outside leaves you hungrier than before. What changes it is not starving it and not stuffing it. It is to feel, all the way down, how completely the hunger has hold of you. Seen whole, its grip loosens. The reach turns round, comes back in, and that turning is the whole of the way out.
gene_keys.repressive: Pushed under, the hunger goes quiet in this person. Afraid of where it would take their life, they hold it down, and holding a force that size takes nearly all they have. It comes up anyway, tempts them, goes under again. They are bored and do not know it. The face has stopped shining.
gene_keys.reactive: Too busy to be bored, this person fills every hour. An empty one frightens them: flower to flower in a frenzy, blaming each for not being enough. Nothing lasts, nothing joins up, no wisdom comes of it. They run from their past toward a perfect place or person, straight past the gold, the going itself.
gene_keys.gift:
Adventure is this hunger met: the same wanting with the door open, walked through toward life instead of away from it. The wanting that spilled out into the world turns, comes home, and what changes is you. What breaks the hunger is love, not a person who fills you for a while but the feeling of being joined to everything, felt low behind the chest. From there the frontier is inward. There is still fear in you; you have found a footing high enough to outwit it.

A life is kept in sealed rooms, the job that never speaks to the marriage, the belief that lets no new thought in, and one wall taken down between two of them lets the whole house breathe. Learn the name of the man in the shop; listen to your children's music. When someone begins talking in the middle of your work, stop and give them the whole of you, because that pause is where the strange things happen. Of everything in you this is the one place you have a real choice, and it is taken by giving with no price on it. Give like that and something in you settles.
gene_keys.siddhi:
There is no door here, because there is no wall, and no one left inside to be hungry. The one who wanted is gone, and what remains has no edges. The mind cannot hold this; it comes apart on contact, which is the point, since it was never the mind that knew it. The heart knows no bounds; from here the word for love and the word for being aware turn out to be one word. There is no beginning to anything and no end. A child already knows this. To a child anything is possible, and so it is.

Seen from here the whole long hunger was love that had not arrived yet, reaching in the dark for what it already was. The wanting, the bored years, the frantic ones, all of it was this, felt through too small an opening. Nothing is asked of you now. When something impossible happens near you, it is not surprising.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Every code has its counterweight, and here it is UL 5, The Space Between Time. The hunger that cannot wait is held by the one who knows how to wait, and what they learn together is that the reaching only becomes adventure when it stops being a rush. Impatience fuels the hunger. Patience is what turns it into a life.

human_design.gate:
What presses here is the experience you have not had yet, and then the telling of it. In the body it comes in at Gate 35: a hunger for life itself, for the new place, and for the wisdom that only comes from having lived it. Nothing learned from a page satisfies it. The same road, the same conversation, and something in you is already looking for the next.

From outside it looks like inconsistency. What is happening is the drive doing its work, gathering what it exists to gather, and the wisdom comes afterwards, only from the wandering. The cost is the rush: one experience straight into the next with nothing taken in, until you have done everything and learned nothing. After enough has been seen, the appetite curdles into the certainty that there is nothing new under the sun, and you settle into rooms that ask nothing of you. People who carry this all their lives learn to keep meeting life as if they had not done it before, even when they have done a version of it a hundred times, and to choose the experiences worth their time.
human_design.centre:
The throat is where this pressure arrives, the Throat Centre, the place everything in you crosses to become a word, an act, or a thing in the world. Of all the places in you it is the one joined to the most others, the town square every road runs into, which is why this drive sits there: an experience is not finished until it has been told, and this is where telling happens. Held back, unspoken, what you lived turns sour in you. Let through, it becomes something another person can use.

In about seven people in ten this centre is switched on, and the voice is steady whoever they are with: one particular song, broadcast rather than received. For someone like that, what they lived comes out as story. In the other three it is not, so the voice takes in every voice in the room and gives it back, matching each person it meets. For someone like that there is pressure to speak with nothing yet to say; they speak without being heard, or blurt, or talk on past the point, and the whole of it works only once they stop pushing to be heard, so the right people can come to them. Carried in an open throat, this drive shows as many talents, a voice that speaks from what it has lived, and no patience at all for what is not worth doing.
human_design.channel: Experience alone is a string of moments that do not add up. Its other half is Gate 36, deep in the feelings, the drive to feel the new thing to the bottom, crisis included. The two make the Channel of Transitoriness: appetite joined to the feeling that makes an event cut deep enough to mark you, then to become a story others can live by. It runs on a wave of feeling, with a wait in it before you act. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the story comes only when the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: This code holds the Ring of Miracles alone. It has no siblings. Where every other code sits in a family bound by a shared chemistry, this one is an island in the genome, a single card that is its own ring. That solitude is the teaching. The thing stands apart because it is the door, the one place in the whole structure where a person can reach through and change the laws that bind everyone else.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Strength comes first, handed to this hexagram by its codon ring: the courage that gentles the animal in us rather than caging it. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Fire above as the Emperor and the Sun, the order that holds and the light that gladdens; Earth below as the Devil and the World, the appetite that binds and the whole at last made round. The Devil holds the chain and the World holds the wreath, and this card is the distance a hunger travels between them once courage walks it.

body.physiology:
This energy is given to the thyroid, and the reason is that nothing hurries it. The thyroid sits low in the front of your neck, across the windpipe, and what it makes sets the pace your body runs at. It is the slowest dial in you: what it makes lasts about a week in your blood, a change shows over weeks, and nothing done today changes it by tonight. Whatever the hunger of the day wants, the pace of your body was set weeks ago and changes slowly, by the same gland whose hormone turns a tadpole into a frog. The change you wait for arrives on its own, and you never catch the moment it happens.

Put two fingers on the inside of your wrist and find the beat. Fear can put it up in a second; the beat you find at rest is the one this gland set, a while back, and no amount of wanting hurries it. Rest your fingers there and you are resting them on the part of you that cannot be rushed.
body.amino_acid:
The hunger you were born with runs on a substance, and the substance is tryptophan. You cannot make it; it comes in with meat, eggs, cheese or beans, and of all the pieces you are built from it is the rarest. From it your body makes serotonin, the chemistry of having had enough, most of it in the wall of your gut rather than your head. The hunger and the being satisfied are one chemistry, made inside you from what is fed in, so nothing fetched from outside ends it. What would end it is made in you, where the hunger is.

It is one link in a chain your body makes for itself. What sets it running is giving with nothing wanted back; give like that and what follows is happiness, then a trust that the whole of your life is in order.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 36, this is the whole motion of light: the sun risen clear above the field, and the same light driven back underground to be kept safe.

pair.teaching: Together with Crystal Creation, these two are one light seen at opposite hours. Here the sun stands clear above the earth and everything is shown. There it has sunk below the earth and the brightness must hide to survive. Rising and going under are the same fire, and you need both to know what the light is for.

inverse.teaching: Together with Crystal Creation, these two are one light seen at opposite hours. Here the sun stands clear above the earth and everything is shown. There it has sunk below the earth and the brightness must hide to survive. Rising and going under are the same fire, and you need both to know what the light is for.

programming_partner.teaching: Every code has its counterweight, and here it is UL 5, The Space Between Time. The hunger that cannot wait is held by the one who knows how to wait, and what they learn together is that the reaching only becomes adventure when it stops being a rush. Impatience fuels the hunger. Patience is what turns it into a life.

codon_ring.teaching: This code holds the Ring of Miracles alone. It has no siblings. Where every other code sits in a family bound by a shared chemistry, this one is an island in the genome, a single card that is its own ring. That solitude is the teaching.
