The two trigrams each give their own faces: Lake above as the Lovers and the Star, the choice and the hope rising off the gathered water; Heaven below as the Fool and the Empress, the leap into the unknown and the fertile ground it lands in. What they share is timing: the flood breaks when the wheel says so, and not an hour before.

sky.teaching: the planet of expansion and sudden good fortune, the force that widens a life and brings the turn of luck the Wheel keeps spinning.

immortals.teaching: Zhong Li Quan stands above, the immortal whose fan revives the dead and who came to wisdom only after his certainties collapsed, and Han Xiangzi below, the flute player who walked away from worldly ambition to follow an unseen knowing. His certainties had to collapse before the fan worked, and the flute was heard before anyone else could. Breakthrough runs on both losses.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the cupped palm that grasps and lets go, the fist that opens, holding fortune loosely because it turns whether you grip it or not. The ring's path runs from Mercy across toward Endurance on the Tree.

keywords: The Same Story in a New Face
cards.essence: Who you meet is this energy, and why you meet them. The people closest to you hold the secret of where your life is going, and each one who arrives is teaching you exactly what you need to know now. You drew them, without knowing it, and the pull you feel toward some of them is older than you both. A stranger who seems familiar the moment you meet is someone you have business with, and a lesson you do not learn from one person comes back to your door in another face.

glance.reading:
Who you meet is this energy, and why you meet them. The people closest to you hold the secret of where your life is going, and each one who arrives is teaching you exactly what you need to know now. You drew them, without knowing it, and the pull you feel toward some of them is older than you both. A stranger who seems familiar the moment you meet is someone you have business with, and a lesson you do not learn from one person comes back to your door in another face.

This energy reads people once fear is out of it. You know who someone is in the first seconds, before the reasons arrive, and you can tell the ones who belong near you from the ones who do not. Each of your own leads you to the next, until a company has gathered around you that you never recruited, only recognised. The sign that it is the right company is devotion.

Stop fighting the friction. When the same trouble keeps arriving in new faces, the fault is not in the faces. It is in how you are seeing the room, and it was there before any of them walked in. Feel it all the way through instead of leaving, and your sense of people comes back clean. Then life begins to arrange itself around you, not all at once, but if you stay with it.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Wind: the sky, with the wind under it, going everywhere and touching every living thing. One soft line has come in at the bottom under five firm ones, hardly there. The traditional character sets a woman beside a queen, bowing to the one she has come to meet. The word means to meet by chance, to couple, to be gripped by a pull you never chose.
iching.reading:
Something has come to meet you that you did not arrange: a person, or a chance, with a pull stronger than your reasons. It is small for now, one soft thing under everything firm, and it looks like almost nothing. Its season is the longest day, when the light has just begun to shorten. Everything alive was made by two things meeting, so there is nothing to refuse in it. What is asked is that you see it for what it is while it is still small.

Meet it, then. Do not marry it. What comes to you this way is strong, but a life built on it does not last: what enters softly goes on entering, and one thing let past the door unchecked moves one good thing after another out of its place. Hold it the way a firm hand holds a rope, neither crushing it nor letting it run. The wind under the sky reaches every corner of the land, and so does a meeting once it is let in: what you allow now travels through the whole of your life, the way a ruler's word goes out to the four quarters.

In the body this energy is the head over the thighs, the part of you that sees far set over the legs that carry you toward whoever you are about to meet. Notice where you are holding yourself now. Stand as the sky stands over the wind, steady above, open below, letting nothing in that you have not looked at.
judgement_lines: Coming to Meet. The one who comes is strong. Do not take her for a wife.
The soft meets the firm, and what they make does not last long.
When heaven and earth meet, everything alive is shown. When the firm meets what is central and right, the whole world moves. Great is the season of meeting.
image_lines: Under the sky, the wind. That is the picture of coming to meet.
So the prince sends out his commands, and they reach the four quarters of the land.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
lower_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lines.image: held to a metal brake, and a lean pig straining to leap.
lines.reading: Tied to a metal brake, what has just come in cannot move, and for now that is right. It is small, and the harm it can do is not. One thin pig loosed will leap, and the whole herd goes after it. Do not set out toward the thing you have just met. There is another road for you, and this is the time to turn onto it.

lines.image: a fish in the bag, and no share of it for the guests.
lines.reading: The fish is in the bag, and there is no fault in holding it. You saw what came to you before it saw you, which is why it can do no harm. What you have is enough for you and not yet enough for two or three. Keep it close, and let no one you have welcomed in near what is yours.

lines.image: the skin worn from the thighs, so that every step is hard.
lines.reading: Walking hurts here, because you are cut off from what you wanted to reach, and every step reminds you. The place is dangerous, though the harm done to you is small. Most of what you feel is the trouble looking larger than it is. Keep watch by day, be careful at night, steady your walk. Do not dust yourself off and go back down the same road.

lines.image: the bag opened, and no fish in it.
lines.reading: You reach into the bag and find it empty. What you thought you held has gone, and it went while you stood too far above the people to notice. Nobody took it. You kept yourself apart, talking of high things, and the ones who might have stayed drifted off. Before you set out, go down among the people and find out who is still with you.

lines.image: a melon wrapped in willow, and something dropping from the sky.
lines.reading: The melon ripens under the willow's long branches, wrapped out of sight, with nothing forcing its growing. Keep what is bright in you covered the same way. Use no force against what is coming up beneath you, hold to the centre, and what you have carried arrives on its own, dropped into your hands. What drops from the sky was in you all along, waiting to be found.

lines.image: meeting others with the horns.
lines.reading: At the very top there is nothing soft left in you to meet with, so you meet the world with your horns, stiff and apart. It is a humiliating place, and no fault of yours. Withdrawn this far you are of no use to anyone for now, but you are out of the disorder below. Take the small shame of standing apart. It is the price of staying clear.

gene_keys.shadow:
When this energy runs on fear it sounds like a room where everyone plays their own tune and nobody hears anyone else. A family that loves each other and cannot stop wounding each other. Work done by good people that makes only friction. Two ways of playing appear in such a room. Some go along with anything to keep the peace. In others the fear comes out as irritation, as anger, as the need to control everything down to the smallest movement, and most people have been both at different times. The sum of it is resentment, and resentment ends in a break: between people a break-up, inside one person a breakdown.

The usual conclusion is that the other person is the problem, so you leave for cleaner ground, and the same trouble is waiting a little further along with a new face. It was never about the others. The noise begins in you, as a way of seeing the room that is rooted in fear, and from you it goes out into everyone you meet. The bonds that grip hardest are carrying something older than you, and they return until it has been felt all the way through.
gene_keys.repressive: One bad bond was enough, and the door shut. This person lives among others, works beside them, and keeps every one at arm's length, so quietly that nobody notices, not even them. Half of it was inherited and half learned young. What they guard against is a pain that already happened.
gene_keys.reactive: Nobody gets shut out by this person, and nothing gets learned either. The instinct that should read people fires through static, so they take up with the ones who do not respect them, then break the tie and meet the same face in the next person. Their sense of people works only among their own.
gene_keys.gift:
Felt all the way through, the noise clears, and what is left is a nose for people. You know someone in the first seconds, from a handshake, before the mind has a word for it, and you have to be in the room with them to know it. What you are reading comes in through the skin. Once the fear is out of the reading it stops misfiring, and you begin to pick up the scent of your own: the people who feel familiar the moment you meet them, because you have business together. Life becomes a matter of following each scent to the next.

The team that gathers this way was never recruited. It is the section you belong to, the ones who play what you play, and when you find them the music that comes out is not work but play. Nobody stands over anyone. Each part is given its freedom, and the order runs sideways rather than down. There is more life in you, because everything that went into defence has been freed. You become the point they gather around, without organising anyone, because the same thing is moving through all of you at once.
gene_keys.siddhi:
All of it is one music, and the conductor is inside every player. From here you see the whole weave of who meets whom, across the years, back through the blood, and you do not stand outside it to study it. You dissolve into it. With nothing in you resisting, you can hear every part of the great hive moving, and the secret of hearing it is silence. Nobody leads, because everybody leads together, each one unlike the rest and each a perfect fit.

Nothing needs fixing from here. You see everything as it is and leave it where it is, since every life finds its own way through, even the ones still lost in the noise. The harmony was there from the beginning, wound about with the interference that hid it, and that wound is why there was suffering, why there was growing at all. By the time you arrive there, the separate person who set out has disappeared.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Frequency Flutter, UL 24, is the code this one runs beside, the return that keeps coming back. The one who reads who belongs is bound to the one who cannot stop circling the same thought, and together they hold the hard truth of all relating, that the bond you do not clear will return wearing a new face until you do.

human_design.gate:
Remembering is the pressure here. Gate 44 is where it presses: the part of you that keeps what happened last time, who hurt you, what worked, and reads every new meeting against it. It is alertness, an animal watchfulness that sizes up whoever walks in before there is anything to point at. Under it is one fear in one sentence: last time I did this, it did not work. The pressure exists so the past will not repeat itself unchanged, so that what caused pain is seen and what served is kept. With it comes a sense of timing, of when one round of things is closing and the next about to begin.

From outside it can look like suspicion, or a grudge held too long. The cost runs the other way: believing the painful patterns are inevitable, so that you stop moving at all. People who carry this all their lives learn that the memory is there to sharpen the reading, not to jam it, and that pain read right turns into purpose.
human_design.centre:
Low on the left side of the body is where this pressure is felt, the Spleen Centre, the oldest kind of knowing you have, shared with every animal. It works in the moment, through the senses, and its answer comes as a hunch: this is safe or it is not, now, with no repeat. A cat asleep on a doorstep is the picture, ears turning while it rests, ready to move, and it can rest at all because it trusts it will be warned. It speaks once, softly, and a person who waits for proof has usually missed it.

In about fifty-five people in a hundred this centre is switched on, and the hunch is there every day. For someone like that the body is strong, strong enough to push past feeling unwell, which is its own risk. The loudest thing in their way is the mind, overriding what the body already said. In the other forty-five it is not, so the body is more sensitive: it takes in the fears of whoever is near and makes them louder. A choice that felt safe with a certain person in the room can feel unsafe the moment they leave, so they do not rush. They hold on to people, or to things, longer than is good for them. When they are well they can tell what is theirs from what is not, better than anyone.
human_design.channel: A memory of what worked has no way to act on its own. Its other half is Gate 26, in the small place over the heart, the will that carries what is valuable to the people who need it. Together they make the Channel of Surrender: the past read for what served your people, then the will to convince them that what you have is worth having, which is the gift of a good sale. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the reading only moves people where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: This code sits in a ring of only two, bound to UL 50, Melt Into Perfection, by a single shared chemistry. One reads who belongs, the other keeps the inherited order they belong inside. A ring this small is the teaching's own claim made flesh, that every clean human pattern begins as a binary, two who have cleared what stood between them before anything larger can assemble.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Justice holds the scales over this card, the ring's one Arcana, weighing what is true in a meeting. The two trigrams give their own faces: Heaven above as the Fool and the Empress, the open beginning and the fertile ground; Wind below as the Wheel of Fortune and Death, the turning and the passage. The Fool trusts the meeting before he can name it and Justice will not grant it until the scales have settled, and this card is the interval where both are true.

body.physiology:
Your immune system is where this energy lives in the body, and the reason is smell. It is not in one place in you. It stands along every surface where the outside touches you, the skin, the gut, and meets whatever comes in before anything else does. It knows by touch, by the fit of a shape, the way your nose knows a smell. Having met a thing once, it keeps cells in you that know that one thing, for years or for life. The people you took to on sight, the ones you kept at arm's length, were read at the surface before your mind had a word. The ones your body read wrong it keeps meeting, until it reads them right.

A fever of childhood comes to you once and never again. That is your immune system keeping what it met. Where there is a round scar high on your arm, a memory was put in on purpose. Scratch the skin: within minutes the place is warm and pink, the part of you that meets everything, arriving.
body.amino_acid:
Fear puts out signals in you that go one of two ways: some hold you down, some fire you up, water or fire, and either way it has you. The noise between you and other people begins there, in your cells. So does the peace. This energy has a chemistry in you, whose substance is glutamic acid: one of the twenty pieces every protein in you is built from, made by your body, the savoury taste itself, what hard cheese and a ripe tomato have in common on your tongue.

You share that chemistry with your kin, one substance in two bodies, the way a hive is held together by one queen, who keeps the direction of every bee by what she gives off, so that when she dies the hive falls apart. The teamwork is in your cells too. They learn to work together, and you are their captain.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 43, this is the whole motion of a hidden thing breaking into the open and the quiet meeting that lets it back in.

pair.teaching: Turned over, this code becomes Breakthrough, its own inverse. One is the soft thing slipping in unnoticed from below, the other is the firm thing forcing its way out into the light from the top. A meeting and a breakthrough are the same event read from two ends, the quiet arrival and the loud departure, what comes in and what at last gets out.

inverse.teaching: The five firm lines and the single soft one, flipped, put the soft line on top instead of underneath. What enters quietly here leaves decisively there. Seen from the other side, the meeting you let in becomes the truth you finally have to declare.

programming_partner.teaching: Frequency Flutter, UL 24, is the code this one runs beside, the return that keeps coming back. The one who reads who belongs is bound to the one who cannot stop circling the same thought, and together they hold the hard truth of all relating, that the bond you do not clear will return wearing a new face until you do.

sky.teaching: the cardinal air of the scales, the season of partnership and the weighing of one against another, the sign that turns alone toward the other and asks what is fair between them.

immortals.teaching: Han Xiangzi stands above, the flute-playing immortal who could make flowers bloom out of season and whose music gathered listeners into one feeling, and He Xian Gu below, the one woman among the eight, who carried the lotus and walked a path of devotion. The flute calls what gathers here, and the lotus keeps it pure; nothing in this meeting is held by force.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the ox-goad that drives and directs, the prod that keeps the team moving toward its true work. The path it walks on the Tree is the path of Justice, the balancing that runs between the heart and the disciplines of will.

cards.essence: This energy is gathering: people drawn to one place around a thing they all need, and a voice that holds them there. In you it is the pull to bring people together, then to say, out loud, what there is and how it will be shared. Everyone who came, came for something. Food once; later a purpose, or a person. Whatever it was, the pull to gather is what turned a scattering of people into everything they have built since, and it has not stopped pulling.

glance.reading:
This energy is gathering: people drawn to one place around a thing they all need, and a voice that holds them there. In you it is the pull to bring people together, then to say, out loud, what there is and how it will be shared. Everyone who came, came for something. Food once; later a purpose, or a person. Whatever it was, the pull to gather is what turned a scattering of people into everything they have built since, and it has not stopped pulling.

Your place is holding what there is at the table it has gathered, without needing the high seat. You want the people fed, then able to feed themselves, so what you do with a resource is teach it before you hand it out. Your authority is not in how you perform it but in how you are present, and people can tell the difference from across a room. Whoever you would not have chosen may turn out to be the one who stays.

The way is an open hand. Life slips, so the hand closes on what it has: a corner of the world, or a person, held as if either could be taken along. Every acre of ground somewhere has a paper attached to it, and most grips only loosen near the end. In a hard stretch you feel this as a tightening, the whole of you contracting the moment you step out of the door, because out there it is a contest again. Loosen the hand first, on purpose, while the people it was closed around are still here.

iching.trigram_combination: Lake over Earth: water gathered on the ground, and the ground drinking it in. Where the wet earth is richest everything living crowds together, and the name means dense grass, blades so close you cannot see between them. Its creatures are the fish and the dragon, gathered in one assembly. The traditional character is a picture of that grass: a crowd, growing where it can drink.
iching.reading:
A crowd is forming around something all of them need, and you are in it. The gain is real: more hands, more warmth, a better chance of coming through the winter. A crowd is not yet one body, though. Everyone brings their fear in with them, and fear in a crowd turns fast into jostling for the better place. That is the situation: many, gathered, and not yet safe with each other.

What it asks is one thing to face. The old picture is a king going up to the temple of his ancestors before anything else, to stand in front of what is larger than himself. The crowd is held by facing it with him. Find the one worth seeing. Bring the best you have, since a gathering built on a small offering stays small. Have somewhere to go, because people who have gathered with no direction come apart. Then do the strange thing the wise do while the crowd is happy: keep the weapons ready. Where people mass, friction comes, and the one who pretends otherwise is the one it overruns. What holds the crowd in the end is sincerity, never force.

In the body this energy is the mouth. Notice yours now: speaking, eating, or shut on something it has not said. Hold yourself as the ground holds under the lake, taking the weight of everyone at once and drinking in what is given.
judgement_lines: Gathering together. Success. The king goes up to his temple.
It helps to see the great one; holding to what is true carries it through.
Bring the best you have, and it goes well. It helps to have somewhere to go.
image_lines: Over the earth, the lake: the image of Gathering Together.
So the wise keep their weapons ready, to meet what has not yet come.

upper_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
upper_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: sincere, but not to the end; confusion, then gathering.
lines.reading: Your wish to belong is real but it wavers, so the gathering turns to a scramble and you run with whoever is loudest. Call out, to the one you belong with rather than to the crowd, and one grasp of a hand turns the tears to laughter. Do not grieve over the confusion. Go toward that hand; there is no blame in it.

lines.image: letting yourself be drawn; the small spring offering accepted.
lines.reading: You are drawn toward the middle, and you do not have to push. Let yourself be led by the one who answers you. Sincerity is the whole of what is asked here; when it is there, even the thin offering of spring, made when the stores are low, is received. Bring what little you have, honestly, and it counts.

lines.image: gathering amid sighs; nothing that would further.
lines.reading: Gathering amid sighs: you want in and nobody above answers. Pushing gains nothing here, and forcing the door only shames you. Go sideways instead, to the ones who will have you rather than the place you were fixed on, and let them lend you what you lack. A little loss of face, and no blame.

lines.image: great good fortune, and no blame.
lines.reading: People are gathering to you rather than to the one above you, and that is the danger inside the good. You did not seek it; your steadiness drew them. The fortune holds only if you stay clean about it, doing the gathering and never reaching for the crown. Hold the crowd for someone else's house, and there is no blame.

lines.image: the gathering has its position; some are not yet sincere.
lines.reading: In the seat now, with the people gathered around the place you hold, which is not the same as around you. Some are not yours yet. Do not tighten the grip to win them; hand real charge to the one below you and forget the seat. Keep on being large, steady, true, so that the ones you would not have chosen prove faithful; then the regret goes.

lines.image: sighing and weeping, floods of tears.
lines.reading: At the top yet outside it, reaching for a belonging that will not have you, and it hurts down to the tears. Nobody is safe up here. Let the crowd see you weep, since it is the weeping that proves you meant it, and what force could not open, honest grief does. No blame in the tears; the door opens last.

gene_keys.shadow:
Under nearly everything people build together sits one old question: is there enough, and will you get yours. The answer the body gives is no, not for certain, and out of that no comes rank. To feel safe at the table you push someone down so that you sit higher, and the table feeds you for it. It began around food, since whoever holds the food holds the power, and money is that same fact in newer clothes. Mostly it is small: the tightening when someone younger does it better, or a person's loyalty held as yours.

Nobody is to blame for it, not the ones at the top, not you. The fear is older than any of you. In you it is a learned flinch, from a morning in childhood when the world turned out not to be safe and the whole of you drew in. Safety is a feeling in your cells, and when fear takes it you lose touch with the whole that is holding you up. Feel the unsafe feeling instead of passing it on as pressure, and it thins. Behind it is trust, the wide feeling that everything is fine, even in trouble.
gene_keys.repressive: This person bows the head. Whoever stands above them gets their spirit, handed over for the sake of not rocking the boat, out of a fear so old they cannot see it: that no good ever came from crossing someone higher up. It looks like keeping the peace. Most people live here without knowing it.
gene_keys.reactive: Climbing is this person's answer, which means pushing others down. Once up, they keep the ones below them timid, because a steady supply of timid is what holds a height in place. It looks like confidence. It is the bowed head's fear run the other way, and the two keep each other in the game.
gene_keys.gift:
Synergy is what happens at a table where nobody needs the head seat. Trust does it, not trust decided but trust settled in the body, the sense of being held up by the whole instead of pitched against it. Then a group finds its own order, the way iron filings on a paper find the magnet under it, then fall into a pattern nobody drew; the field was there all along, and the trust lets it show. A group given time and space arrives at an arrangement better than any member could have planned, though it usually passes first through one person carrying the whole group's fear.

The hard part falls on whoever holds the power. To hand real charge to someone else, meaning it, looks like loss and is the opposite. Goodwill let loose in a network comes back multiplied, by word of mouth and by luck, in ways no ledger shows. Gather the people you trust, give them their freedom, and the crowd stops being managed, starts being alive. What you own asks the same of you. Share it rather than trade it, since most trading is fear with a price on it.
gene_keys.siddhi:
At the table now there is no host. The meal is passed; everyone is fed by everyone, since at this height you are each other's food, and money, which was only ever food by another name, has nothing left to do. The feeling is an early Sunday morning before anything has started: the hush over the land that even the birds seem in on, the world just born, nobody asking why they are here or what they must do. Being here is enough.

From here the whole order of rank reads as the shape of this, seen through fear. The arrangement was always there, waiting; what people called leading was a place where goodwill passes through into everyone. Dying after a life like this would be no different from living. You drift in, you drift out, and nothing needs to be missed.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Keeping is the other half of gathering, and it belongs to UL 26, Lighter Than a Feather, the one who manages and accumulates what the tribe holds. The gatherer who shares the resource is balanced by the keeper who builds it up, and together they hold the whole question of wealth, how it is amassed and how it is given out, neither half able to keep an economy honest alone.

human_design.gate:
This pressure is the crowd and what it needs: the pull to gather people around what there is, then to be the one who says how it is shared. In the body it comes in at Gate 45, the gatherer, the king or queen at the head of the tribe, whose words carry weight because people came to hear them. It is not the drive to be admired. It is the drive to hold the resource for everyone, and the surest way it has of sharing is teaching, so that what you hand over makes people able to provide for themselves.

From outside it can look like bossiness, and the person carrying it can mistake it for that too. The cost is the fear underneath: when scarcity gets into the voice, the hand that should be sharing withholds, or the leading turns loud and showy to prove it deserves the seat. There is also the need to be heard, which, unmet, makes this person either go quiet or get louder. People who carry this all their lives learn when to step forward and when to step back. The power in it flows from being present, never from performing.
human_design.centre:
This pressure comes out at the throat, the Throat Centre, where everything in you turns into a word or a deed. All the energy in you is trying to get here, because nothing happens in the world until it has passed through. This is also the place that sets how you take in and digest food, life too for that matter, which is why gathering people around food is spoken from here.

In about seven people in ten this centre is switched on. The voice is always there to be used, with a confidence that comes from never having to wait for it. When this pressure sits behind a voice like that, joined to the will, the voice has an engine, and it carries something like a command to be heard. People around it feel able to act. In the other three it is not, so the voice takes in every voice in the room and amplifies it. For someone like that there is pressure to speak for the whole room, to say what the others cannot; done from need, it wears them out, and done from stillness it works. They take in what people are trying to say, the way a mother bird softens food before giving it to the young, and give it back clear. Carried in an open throat, this drive shows as a teacher's voice, speaking to guide the tribe once the tribe has asked.
human_design.channel: Saying how a thing is shared is a king with an empty store. Its other half is Gate 21, in the small place over the heart, the drive to take hold of the thing itself. The two make the Channel of the Money Line: the one place in a person where they take charge outright, the will behind the voice so what is said gets done. Its cost is trusting nobody else to be as able, then doing it all until burnt out. Whether the other half sits in you or near you, sharing begins once something has been caught.

One masters the resource and makes it skilful, the other gathers the people and shares it out. Between them they carry the whole of worldly abundance, the having and the distributing held as a single chemistry.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Gathering is the whole subject of this card, and the Tarot comes to it from three seats. The Ring of Prosperity gives the World, the dance at the end of the long work where everything that was scattered comes round into one whole. The two trigrams give their own faces. Lake above as the Lovers and the Star, the choosing that binds people and the steady hope that gathers them. Earth below as the Devil and the World, the grip that hoards and the wholeness that releases. What they ask of you is to stand inside the crowd without gripping it, so that the gathering communes instead of clutching.

body.physiology:
This energy has its place in the thyroid, and the reason is the sea. The thyroid sits low in the front of your neck, across the windpipe, and it is the one organ in you that needs iodine, a thing of the sea. It reaches you in food, in fish or seaweed, milk or eggs, and in the salt on most kitchen tables, added there for this gland alone. The gland gathers it out of your blood, holds it far stronger than your blood does, and from that one gathered thing makes what the rest of you runs on. That is what this energy does everywhere else in your life: one thing gathered out of what everyone eats, held, then given out to all.

Look at the salt in your kitchen: somewhere on the packet is the word iodised, or iodine added, put there for the gland in your neck. Rest a hand at the base of your throat and you are resting it on the part of you that is fed from the sea.
body.amino_acid:
The gathering has a chemistry in you, and one piece of it is cysteine. It is in every protein you are built from, one of only two pieces that carry sulfur. Where two of them meet across a folded protein they clasp, sulfur to sulfur, and hold the shape. The insulin in you holds at three such clasps, and a perm holds because those clasps were broken, then remade.

What this chemistry does in you is fuse: pieces joined into a working that is more than any of them, which is also what happens between people when you gather the ones you trust and give them their freedom. Power travels through a group only once it has been given away; the more of what you have is spread out, then joined back, the further it reaches.

relations.unity_line: Beside UL 46, this is the crowd that gathers on the ground and the single growth that rises out of it once the gathering has taken.

pair.teaching: Turned over, the massing crowd of this code becomes the lone shoot of Fountain of Light, pushing up through the dark toward the light. The two are one motion seen at two scales. First the many come together on the earth, then out of that gathered ground a single thing rises. Gathering is what makes the rising possible.

sky.teaching: the planet of structure and time, of what is built to last and what must finally be let go. The World's sky, the long patience that gathers a thing slowly and holds it whole.

immortals.teaching: Zhong Li Quan stands above, chief of the eight, who carries the fan that wakes the dead and turns base stone to gold, and Lan Cai He below, the wandering minstrel with the flower basket who sings that life is brief and gives their coins to the poor. A fan that turns stone to gold, coins scattered to the poor: real prosperity revives what was spent and holds it lightly, gathered and given away in the same breath.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the last letter, the sign of completion and of matter made sacred, the path that joins the foundation to the ground we stand on. The crowd brought all the way down into the world and finished there.

keywords: Glad to Be in a Body
The Grip on How It Should Go
cards.essence: Lightness is the energy you carry, the rising that happens in a life when nothing in it is gripping. In you it is the plain gladness of being alive in a body: food that tastes of something, sleep that goes all the way down, a day with a shine on it. It lives below thinking, in the body itself, and it is what people are feeling when they call you lucky.

glance.reading:
Lightness is the energy you carry, the rising that happens in a life when nothing in it is gripping. In you it is the plain gladness of being alive in a body: food that tastes of something, sleep that goes all the way down, a day with a shine on it. It lives below thinking, in the body itself, and it is what people are feeling when they call you lucky.

It looks like this once the grip is undone. A village in a long drought sends for the rainmaker, an old man who asks only for a hut, to be left alone; after a few days it rains. His secret is that he has no power over the weather at all. He has found what he is for, so he goes where he feels like going, and where he goes it happens to rain. Luck is what happens when you stop interfering with life; it is the world telling you that you are in step with it. So you hold your aims loosely enough to drop them if life offers something better, and let yourself be taken where it was going to take you anyway. People near you feel life turned up a little, and drift toward it without knowing why.

Tread lightly and worry less than you do, because life will take you where it wants you to go. Mostly the work is undoing a grip. There is a game a parent plays with a small child: hold them tight, and the harder they struggle the tighter the hold. The moment they go still the arms loosen, until they learn that the way out is to do nothing. You are the child, and the arms are your own. When the heavy seasons come, in which you are braced against how things will turn out, that is the hold, and it loosens the same way.

iching.trigram_combination: Earth over Wind, and wind here is also wood: a tree growing inside the ground, the root at work before anything green has broken the surface. The ground gives way, because that is what ground does. The traditional character means to rise, and it also names a measure for strong drink drawn off a ferment: the rising is a distilling, the finer thing coming up out of the thick.
iching.reading:
You are rising, and the rising is the kind that does not show. Something in your life is growing the way a tree grows inside the ground, adding to itself where nobody can see. The situation is a good one: the old text promises great growth, tells you not to fear, and sends you toward the south, the warm, bright side of things. What it asks is that you keep going in that direction without straining, heaping up small things until something high stands there. Do not overlook the small gains; they are what does the lifting. It asks, too, that you go and see the great one, whoever has already been where you are going, because the rising is welcomed from above only when you approach it.

What tries to bury you does not know you are a seed. Pressed down is exactly how a seed begins, so the weight on you is not against the rising; it is what the rising pushes off. Give it time to come through the resistance of the ground. Honour your roots as you go, because the roots decide how long you stay up.

In the body this energy is the thighs, the strongest muscle you own, the one that lifts you up a stair. Notice how you are carried now, whether the legs are doing the work or the shoulders are trying to. Let the lift come from low down, as a tree's does, and the top of you can stay light.
judgement_lines: Pushing upward: from the source it goes through and grows.
It serves to see the great one. Have no cares.
Set out toward the south, and it goes well.
image_lines: Within the earth, wood grows: pushing upward.
So the wise, yielding, heap up the small until it stands high and great.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
lower_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lines.image: a rising that is welcomed, a good seed in good ground.
lines.reading: The rising begins with a welcome, and the ground is ready for it: the seed is good, the soil too. Those above you agree with where you are going, so nothing here resists. Come to it humble and willing, approaching the ones who know more than you. This is the kind of rising that goes all the way.

lines.image: sincere, so that even a small offering at the spring rite is accepted.
lines.reading: You have less to bring than the others, and a feeling of not belonging follows you in. It is a spring offering, made when the stores are low, and it is accepted for what is in it rather than what it cost. You feel wrong here, and you are not. Stay sincere, bring the small thing, and there is joy in it.

lines.image: rising into an empty city.
lines.reading: You go up and meet no resistance at all: the gates open, nobody on the walls. It may be that the way is truly clear, or that you have rushed ahead of everyone who could have told you what was there. The city does not say which. Go forward, since there is nothing to push against, but go as one who has not yet found out what the emptiness holds.

lines.image: the king makes his offering on the twin-peaked mountain.
lines.reading: The mountain is the place the whole line came from, and the offering is made there, at the source. To rise this way is to rise by honouring what you grew out of, going from low to high in order, entering a fine place by degrees. Present yourself where you began, and the rising keeps its roots.

lines.image: steady and upright, going up the steps.
lines.reading: Near the height the rising has become a stair, one step after the next with nothing skipped. What carries you the rest of the way is steadiness, and the pull here is to take the steps two at a time. The increase of what is good in you is as easy as a stair, when you take it as a stair. Go up one step at a time, calmly.

lines.image: rising in the dark, and no pause in being upright.
lines.reading: At the top the rising has gone blind: you have what you wanted and are still climbing, into the dark, past where up means anything, at the cost of what you gathered. What helps is to stay true without a pause, as a tree grows in the night as in the day. Keep your breath steady, keep to what is right, and rise by constancy or not at all.

gene_keys.shadow:
A small dark cloud travels over some lives, and it rains on them whenever they least want it to. That is seriousness, the most common ailment there is: worrying, expecting, wishing life were other than it is right now, with the attention fixed on what is coming or on what is gone. It feels like maturity, like caring how things turn out. What it is, mostly, is a grip, one that takes you out of life and love into control. Being out of step with the whole is what makes it rain.

It was laid down early. Your body learned in its first years whether the world was safe, from the people round you rather than from anything said. A body that did not learn it braces. The mind can be told that all is well; it is the body that has to feel it, and the mind will not settle until the body has. The grown-ups who handed you the bracing had forgotten how to play, and meant no harm by it. Nobody is more serious than the people who are trying hardest to be good, and it shows in their faces.
gene_keys.repressive: The heaviness freezes this person. Their capacity to feel goes cold; they hide from life out of fear of their own body, and disliking it sours the life in them. It sets in the face as a pinched look. Enjoying the body instead of judging it is what thaws them, from a warmth buried deep.
gene_keys.reactive: This seriousness hides under a show of taking nothing seriously. The person plays the light one, joking; a scratch on the surface finds anger, which comes out when somebody is honest with them. Underneath they take life more deadly seriously than anyone, so they run from the truth, in loves that are many and short.
gene_keys.gift:
Delight is what is left when the grip lets go, and it is not a mood you make. It comes from owning what is yours, the acceptance of a thing seen; once a thing has been seen and let go, more of you is free for being glad. Nothing really matters except life and love. A person who knows that in the body moves through the world lightly, letting the past go, riding the present, with no worries anyone can find. Others call them lucky. What they are is in step.

You train for years for a medal, fall ill the day before, fall in love with the nurse, and only years on see that missing the medal was the point: success is understood in hindsight. The body comes back to life: you wake with the sun, and you keep the habits the body enjoys instead of the pleasures you pay for later. You taste things the way a child does, through the whole body. You love good food and laughter. People find you attractive on a plain physical level, as if there were more life in you than in most, which has nothing to do with how you look.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Ecstasy is what the body is for, and it comes through the heart, not from anywhere far away. It is your state whenever the mind comes all the way to rest: the moment the mind is needed it steps back, and the moment the task is done it returns. A person living here does the shopping, sits at the family table, and is felt across a room by people who know nothing about any of this. It comes in waves, swelling and dropping like wind, so you give yourself to it.

There is no work on earth more important than play. The heart makes none of the mind's distinctions, success from failure, past from future. It knows only that it is alive and beating right now, which floods you. If you have felt it once you can find it again. It waits in the chambers of your heart, and it begins with a breath let out slowly.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This code walks with UL 25, The Mysteries Play. Embodied delight is held by innocent love, and a body fully inhabited turns out to be the same arrival as a heart left open. One is the ground, the other is the opening of it, and neither lands without the other.

human_design.gate:
The pressure here is to be all the way inside your body. Gate 46 is the door it comes through: the love of the body, the joy of being in one, meeting life through its senses. It is the determination of a child in the womb pushing its way out. In you it is felt as a pull toward touch and movement, toward treating the body with tenderness, as what carries who you are rather than a bag the real you is kept in.

From outside it can look like vanity, or like a lack of interest in higher things. It is the opposite: this is the pressure that knows nothing higher can land in you until the body is a place worth landing. Turned away from, it is a person at odds with their own body, neglecting it, hiding it, or trying to make it into something else. It draws some to sport or to yoga, and leaves others out of step with the body altogether. People who carry it all their lives learn to ask how much life the body can hold, and to live with that much.
human_design.centre:
Who you are, and which way your life faces, are kept in the centre of the chest, the Identity Centre. This pressure lives there because the centre is the spark that called you into a body. It has no engine. It draws, only draws, pulling toward you the people and the places a life needs. In the old teaching it is love itself, drawing what is beautiful toward it. The same spark leaves the body at the end.

In a little over half of people this centre is switched on, and the self stays put whoever they are with. For someone like that there is a self to rely on, a steady road, a life chosen from the menu. The body they are glad in is the same body every day. The risk is taking the solidity for granted, never asking whether they are glad in it at all. In the other four it is not, so the self comes and goes with the company. For someone like that it is a relief to hear that the thing they are doing is not the thing they must do forever. They fit any room, play the part, and leave it behind. What they have instead of a fixed self is the moment: writing, they are a writer, and in a body that is glad they are that gladness for as long as it lasts.
human_design.channel: The love of the body alone has nowhere to go. Its other half is Gate 29, low in the belly, the part of you that says yes, means it, and stays. Together they make the Channel of Discovery: you commit your whole self to an experience without knowing where it leads, which is the discovery. Once the belly has said yes the stamina is there; you turn up in the right place at the right time, succeeding where others fail. Whether the other half sits in you or near you, the finding out happens only where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: Within the Ring of Matter, this code stands as the rising of spirit through dense ground. Its siblings, UL 18, 48, and 57, carry the rest of the work the material world asks: the correcting of what decayed, the deep well that feeds, the gentle wind that reaches in. At its higher turn the ring is also a ring of no-matter, the same density grown light. Together they hold the labour of making the physical plane a home.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Nothing rises far without ground beneath it, and the Tarot lays that ground on three axes. The codon ring gives the Emperor, the founder who builds an order that lasts. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Earth above as the Devil and the World, the attachment that binds and the wholeness that completes; Wind below as the Wheel of Fortune and Death, the turning of luck and the passage that remakes. Between them they describe one climb, slow enough to keep its roots and light enough to let the Wheel do the turning.

body.physiology:
This energy is given to the blood in the body, and the reason is warmth. The blood in you is made from what you eat, and comes out red; it is remade all the time, two or three million new cells a second. It goes out to your palms so they can hold, to your feet so they can walk; where it draws back, a part of you goes white and numb. The warmth in your skin is it arriving. When you are at ease in your body it comes to the surface, so you are warm to the touch, with colour in your face. When you are braced it withdraws, and your hands go cold. Your body decides this before you do.

Lay a cold hand flat against the warm skin of your belly. What you feel is blood, heat made deep inside you, carried out to the skin. The same hand held in cold water goes white because the blood has drawn back from it. That is the energy you can feel arriving.
body.amino_acid:
The gladness of being in a body has a substance in you, and the substance is alanine. It is one of the twenty small pieces every part of you is built from, in nearly everything you eat, though your body makes its own anyway. It took you seven years to arrive fully in your body; what you learned then about being safe is written in how you breathe and touch things.

Delight is feeling alive in the flesh, and in you it has a chemistry. On a long walk with the meal gone, your muscle sends alanine through your blood to your liver, which sends it back as sugar. The same piece goes out as one thing and comes back as another. A body is there to be filled all the way through by what lives in it, and what follows is not something you make; it grows.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 45, this is the gathering and the rising it makes possible, the crowd assembled and the single tree that grows up out of it.

pair.teaching: Together with Tribal Tapestry, these two are assembly and ascent. One draws the many into one place, the other is the growth that becomes possible once they are gathered. The old reading is plain about the order: from the gathering comes the rising. You cannot push upward from scattered ground. First the crowd, then the tree.

inverse.teaching: Together with Tribal Tapestry, these two are assembly and ascent. One draws the many into one place, the other is the growth that becomes possible once they are gathered. The old reading is plain about the order: from the gathering comes the rising. You cannot push upward from scattered ground. First the crowd, then the tree.
