sky.teaching: the planet of form and fertility, the force that draws energy into a body and holds it there, abundance kept to a shape.

immortals.teaching: Li Tie Guai stands above, the lame beggar who carries his medicine in a gourd and leans on an iron crutch, and Zhong Li Quan below, the elder whose fan stirs the dead back toward life. Between an iron crutch and a plain fan there is nothing large, and yet one carries a man and the other carries breath back into a body.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the opening through which abundance pours, the doorway that is also a boundary, a frame around what passes through. The path runs from Chokmah to Binah, wisdom finding its first form.

cards.essence: Inner truth is the energy here, the knowing in you that has no proof, and it comes with a question. Why is the first question anyone asks, and in you it never stops: it wells up from somewhere deeper than thought, refusing every made-up answer. It is what you know without knowing how you know, the thing you would still hold to if everyone at the table disagreed. In a life it is the wondering that keeps you awake, with a quiet certainty underneath it.

glance.reading:
Inner truth is the energy here, the knowing in you that has no proof, and it comes with a question. Why is the first question anyone asks, and in you it never stops: it wells up from somewhere deeper than thought, refusing every made-up answer. It is what you know without knowing how you know, the thing you would still hold to if everyone at the table disagreed. In a life it is the wondering that keeps you awake, with a quiet certainty underneath it.

This knowing stops needing the question answered once you trust it. The why cannot be answered by thinking, because thought goes round in a circle to the question again, and a mind under that pressure will accept anything that promises to end it. What comes instead is inspiration, in flashes, when it comes and for as long as it stays; after one you are never quite the same. It cannot be forced, so it has to be waited for, and between the flashes there are flat days. The way through them is making something with your hands, a garden or a song. The moment the making begins the mind empties, and what was troubling it settles like silt in still water.

Stand inside the question instead of running from it. Not knowing is the whole of what is asked; the mind is not your enemy, only it was never there to keep you safe. Something in you is sure without a reason, the way you know a friend is telling the truth before the sentence is finished, and that sureness moves people more than any argument could. Live without the answer long enough and the pressure of the question turns into wonder.

iching.trigram_combination: Wind over Lake: the wind cannot be seen, and the water shows it, every gust written on the surface. What is inside you is like that, unseen, known only by what it moves. The traditional character is an arrow through the centre of a target, beside a bird's foot laid over its young: a bird sitting on the nest, truth kept warm in the middle until its day comes.
iching.reading:
Sincerity is asked of you here, and it is a thing you are, not a thing you say. Truth held in the middle of you reaches people the way wind reaches water, unseen, plainly shown in what it moves. It reaches even those nobody else can reach, the ones who trust no one and have heard every argument. What moves them is not a better case. It is that there is no gap in you between what you show and what you hold.

What it asks is emptiness in the middle. Go in with no fixed idea of how it should come out, the way an empty boat crosses water that a loaded one would sink in, and you can cross what looks too wide. Where you have to judge someone, judge slowly: take the time to understand why they did what they did before you decide what it costs them, and put the sentence off as long as you can. Answer, rather than react. Stay firm in what you know without being able to prove it, because that is where this strength is made.

In the body this energy is the thighs above the mouth: what carries you, over what you say. Notice whether the two agree now, whether your walk and your word are one thing. Let the chest open, the middle of you empty, and speak only what the whole of you is standing on.
judgement_lines: Inner truth. It reaches even the pig and the fish, and it goes well.
It is worth crossing the great water. Holding to what is true brings it through.
image_lines: Wind over the lake, unseen, and shown in what it moves: the image of inner truth.
So the wise take their time over a judgement, and put off the sentence.

upper_trigram.name: Wind (Sun)
upper_trigram.nature: Subtly penetrating. Mild, nourishing. Wood and wind. The eldest daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Lake (Tui)
lower_trigram.nature: Open surface, interaction, pleasure, the mouth, exchange. The youngest daughter.

lines.image: at rest in yourself, and no rest if you look elsewhere.
lines.reading: At the start of trust, you are at rest in yourself, and that is the good fortune. Look to someone else for the certainty, or keep a private plan behind the trust, and the rest goes. The moment a second thought arises there is something else in the room, and the mind is no longer still. Decide what you can believe before you believe it, once, at the beginning.

lines.image: a crane calling from the shade, and its young answering.
lines.reading: A crane calls from the shade where nobody can see it, and its young answer, knowing the voice. Something true in you, said quietly and out of sight, is heard by the ones who share it; you do not need to be seen to be heard. You have a good cup and someone to share it with, none of it arranged. Speak from the shade, and let the answer come.

lines.image: a comrade found, and the drum beaten then dropped, the sob then the song.
lines.reading: You have found someone to match yourself against, and now your mood is theirs to set: you beat the drum, then stop; you weep, then sing. A truth that depends on another person's answer is not yet held in the middle of you, and it swings as they swing. None of that is wrong, only out of place. Bring the certainty back inside, where nobody else can turn it.

lines.image: the moon nearly full, and a horse leaving the one it was harnessed with.
lines.reading: The moon is nearly full, and a horse has left its team-mate, with no blame on either. Something in you has quietly grown near its full, and to go further you must leave the company you kept, the friend who matched you at the last stage. It is not a betrayal; a horse that stays in the team never rises. Turn toward what is higher, and let the pair go.

lines.image: truth that binds everyone to it, with no fault found.
lines.reading: In the place of authority, you are sincere all the way through, and it binds people to you the way one hand holds another. Nothing has to be added and nothing argued. What is inside matches what shows, so the whole room trusts it and stays. This is as far as sincerity goes, and it is enough. Keep it firm, and let the trust do the joining.

lines.image: a rooster crowing up at the sky, as if the crowing could take it there.
lines.reading: At the top, the voice has climbed past what is behind it, a rooster crowing at the sky as if the crowing could take it there. Words that fly higher than the truth under them fall, however sure they sound, and a bird built for the yard is hurt in the trying. Even holding firm will not save this. Bring the voice back down to what you actually know.

gene_keys.shadow:
Losing touch with what is real is the ordinary state of a mind, and in this energy it shows first as a question, the question why. It is the first word anyone learns to ask, and in you it rises from somewhere under thought, as a pressure the mind cannot bear to leave open. So the mind answers it, with anything, a religion or a science, whatever promises to make the pressure stop. The mind is sick for one reason: it is trying to find itself with itself, and it cannot, any more than an eye can see itself. The worst of it is worship. The moment you put someone above you as the one who knows, you have set yourself below the truth in you, and there you stay.

Everyone is in this to some degree, and being in it is no fault. What is asked is not that you think harder. The only release is to walk into the middle of the pressure instead of making it go away, and that takes apart what the mind built, which is why it has to be done slowly, in a body, on the ground.
gene_keys.repressive: This person turned away from the question when it frightened them, usually young. They went the ordinary road, school or career, did what was expected, did it well, and something in them gave up. Whatever they gain, they stay restless underneath, because the question is still there, unasked.
gene_keys.reactive: Here is someone who found the answer. One answer, one teacher or one creed, with the whole of life built round it so nothing is asked again. They carry it to everyone as a mission. Underneath it is a well of not knowing, and it comes up as anger whenever the question gets too near.
gene_keys.gift:
Inspiration is breath coming in, and this energy at its fullest is exactly that: something enters you that you did not think, changing the way you see. It comes in flashes, sudden and short, sometimes a longer spell; after even one you are not the person you were. Each flash takes apart a piece of what the mind had built in place of reality, and the energy that was tied up in the building is let loose, wanting to be made into something. So this is a maker's energy. When the mind is troubled, take up a trowel or a pencil; the moment the making starts the mind lets go, empties, and leaves only what matters, along with the thing you made.

It cannot be forced, so patience is most of the work, and the days in between can be flat. A man who lost his wife rose every dawn for a year to pour the grief into a garden; at the end there was a garden, a clear mind, something made for her. Being born in a body is being born with a wound, and this is how the wound is tended.
gene_keys.siddhi: Holiness is what is left when the inspiration has used itself up. One day a great silence comes down, full and heavy; the mind stops, all of it, in the middle of a question. The pressure that drove the question leaves the head to go out through the whole of you, everywhere at once, so that you are entirely empty and endlessly full in one moment, with no one inside to have the experience. The question why does not get answered here; it ends. What remains is living without answers, being the mystery instead of solving it, knowing nothing, in its own time. Until you rest in this you are asleep, whatever else you know. It is a lonely way, a lovely one: a flash of it, then a fall and the work begun again, until the night you sit on open rock while the full moon drifts up the mountain, with nothing left to empty.
gene_keys.programming_partner: UL 62 returns as the partner in the genetic code too, the same companion the deck already gave. Where the unity is the felt thing, this is the function. The pressure of why is routed straight into the intellect that turns it into a question, and the two together are the whole engine of human asking, the first word and the languages born out of it.

human_design.gate:
Wonder is the drive here, the pressure to know why. Gate 61 is where it enters: the part of you that reaches past what can be explained toward the mystery of the thing itself, and comes back with a knowing it cannot account for. You know things. You do not know how you know, you could not show your working, and you know them all the same. It is the drive that sits up at night with a question nobody else in the house is asking.

From outside it looks like being lost in thought, or out of step; people carrying this are often misunderstood, and the cost is that they begin to doubt what they know because nobody around them can confirm it. The other cost is the pressure itself. Left to run, the need to figure it out turns bitter, and the story of why things happened to you replaces the wonder that they happened at all. People who carry it all their lives learn the one trade this drive offers: give up needing the answer and keep the wonder, since being present turns out to hold more than knowing ever did.
human_design.centre:
The top of the head is where this pressure gathers, the Head Centre, the triangle at the very top of the chart. It makes questions and inspiration, nothing else: it has no engine, it cannot act, it decides nothing, its one road out is to the mind just beneath it, which has to turn its questions into something usable. It is a place of pressure, and the pressure is to answer. The moment a question rises, the need to close it rises with it, and the whole art of this centre is to leave the question open long enough for something to arrive.

Three people in ten have this pressure switched on, and their mind broadcasts all day like a station that never goes off air. For someone like that, quiet is not on offer, and the danger is the loop: a question with no answer coming, turned inward until it is despair. In the other seven it is not, so the questions in a room are taken in from whoever is there and made louder. For someone like that, the mind is tossed by every conversation, and by evening they cannot say what they think. What both are given, when the pressure is not obeyed, is the same: a mind that can go still, the way a mountain stays where it is while everything on it moves.
human_design.channel: What rises as a question has nowhere to go until it is thought. Its other half is Gate 24, in the mind beneath the head, the part of you that turns a thing over until it makes sense. Together they are the Channel of Awareness: an inner process that keeps returning to the same question and refining the answer as more comes in. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone you are drawn to, what the two make is a knowing you can hold, though not always one you can say; not everything needs to be understood.

tarot.ring_role: Within the Ring of Gaia, this code is the inner question of the living planet itself. Its two siblings, UL 19 and UL 60, carry the rest of the family: the drawing near, and the limit that holds. Together they say that evolution is a force breaking out from inside matter, that the whole blue-green world is working toward its own inner truth, and that to find it you look inward.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Two of the three Tarot axes carry cards here, and the third is left open. The codon ring gives one Arcana, the Empress, the fertile ground that holds and nourishes. The Wind above gives two faces, the Wheel of Fortune and Death, the turning and the shedding. The Lake below carries no keyed Major in the source. An Empress carried on the Wheel and through Death is a nurturing depth that turns and dies and turns again, the mystery composting itself into new form.

body.physiology:
In the middle of your head, where the two halves of the brain meet, is a gland the size of a grain of rice called the pineal gland, and this energy is given to it because it works in the dark. Nearly everything in your brain comes in pairs, left and right; this one is single, in the centre. It never sees light; it learns from your eyes whether the day has gone, and while the light is on it does nothing at all. When the light has gone it begins, and what it makes is your body's dark. The question in you rises the same way, from a part of the mind no light reaches, and the knowing comes without your seeing how it was made.

Feel it over an evening. Sit in a dim room; over an hour or two your body slows and grows heavy, which is the gland at its work. Turn a bright light on and within minutes it stops. It cannot be felt happening, only arriving, as everything from this part of you arrives.
body.amino_acid:
The pressure of the mystery in you has a substance, and the substance is isoleucine. It is one of the twenty small pieces every protein in you is built from, one of the nine your body cannot make; it comes in with meat or beans, or not at all. It is the twin of another of the twenty, the same atoms in a slightly different order: two things that weigh the same, spelled from the same pieces, are not the same thing, and the difference is inside, out of your sight.

The mystery beats in every cell of your body, and whatever is of true value in you is hidden inside your body, never on the outside. That is chemistry as much as feeling, one substance shared with your kin. Taken apart in you, it goes two ways, part burned and part turned to sugar, which its twin cannot do.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 62, this is the wordless knowing and the precise speech that lets it be heard.

pair.teaching: Together with A Worthy Expression, these two are the deck's drama of the mystery and its telling. One reaches into the unspeakable and comes back full and silent. The other finds the small, exact words that let a little of it cross to another person. The wordless experience and the language that carries it are two halves of one act.

inverse.teaching: Turn these lines end for end and the shape does not move. This code is one of only eight that meets its own reflection, and the meaning is precise. A heart at the centre has no other side; what is true here is true read from any angle.

programming_partner.teaching: UL 62 returns as the partner in the genetic code too, the same companion the deck already gave. Where the unity is the felt thing, this is the function. The pressure of why is routed straight into the intellect that turns it into a question, and the two together are the whole engine of human asking, the first word and the languages born out of it.

codon_ring.teaching: Within the Ring of Gaia, this code is the inner question of the living planet itself. Its two siblings, UL 19 and UL 60, carry the rest of the family: the drawing near, and the limit that holds. Together they say that evolution is a force breaking out from inside matter, that the whole blue-green world is working toward its own inner truth, and that to find it you look inward.

tarot.teaching: Two of the three Tarot axes carry cards here, and the third is left open. The codon ring gives one Arcana, the Empress, the fertile ground that holds and nourishes. The Wind above gives two faces, the Wheel of Fortune and Death, the turning and the shedding. The Lake below carries no keyed Major in the source. An Empress carried on the Wheel and through Death is a nurturing depth that turns and dies and turns again, the mystery composting itself into new form.

sky.teaching: the planet of what draws and holds, the love that nurtures rather than conquers, fitting for a truth that reaches without forcing.

immortals.teaching: He Xian Gu stands above, the one woman among the eight, who carries the lotus that grows clean out of the mud and is said to have lived on light. Zhong Li Quan stands below, who carries the fan that revives the dead and knew the secret of turning base things to gold. A lotus takes its whiteness straight out of the mud, and a fan puts breath back into what everyone had given up on.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the opening between rooms, the threshold the spreading truth passes through, the way the wind enters under the door without breaking it. The ring's path is the Empress's path on the Tree.

keywords: Naming Things Instead of Feeling Them
cards.essence: Exactness is this energy, the right word in the right place and the small thing done well. In you it is the pause before you speak, when you feel what a word weighs, and the eye that catches the detail everyone else walked past. It lives in the quiet work most people never notice: the sentence cut to what it means, or the one small thing put right before anyone asked. Where others fill a silence, you wait, then say the one thing, and people lean in without knowing why.

glance.reading:
Exactness is this energy, the right word in the right place and the small thing done well. In you it is the pause before you speak, when you feel what a word weighs, and the eye that catches the detail everyone else walked past. It lives in the quiet work most people never notice: the sentence cut to what it means, or the one small thing put right before anyone asked. Where others fill a silence, you wait, then say the one thing, and people lean in without knowing why.

Exactness in its right place is warm, because the heart is choosing and the mind is only finding the words. Cleverness is of the head, where it can be argued with; understanding is of the heart, which a person with no schooling at all can have whole. So you spend words carefully, and what you say is spare enough to land. The truer it gets, the fewer words it needs, since the true ones keep dissolving back into silence. A touch is enough. A touch set in the right place is what turns a wheel.

Leave things out. There are days when the details are where you hide, the list growing so that the feeling underneath is never reached, and the fussing then is fear in the clothes of care. Put the small thing right, then stop. Wait until the word is the one, then let it go alone, with room around it, because the room is what lets it land. A crossing made by a small margin is still a crossing.

iching.trigram_combination: Thunder over Mountain: the sound that shakes the sky, going off above a peak that swallows it, so that it carries only a little way. The figure is a bird, its body the two firm lines in the middle, its wings the soft lines above and below. The traditional character shows a house with more on its beam than the beam was built for: going a little past the mark.
iching.reading:
You are in a season of small things, and the small things are the whole of what can be done now. The stir in you wants to go up, to make the large move, and the ground you stand on swallows most of the sound: what carries is what stays near. The old text gives its counsel to a bird. A bird that keeps climbing finds nothing to land on, while the one that comes down has a branch, so the message the bird leaves behind it is this: not up, down. Great good fortune lies that way.

What it asks is that you go a little past the mark in the small things, on the side of humility. Be a little more respectful than the occasion needs, grieve a little longer than is expected, spend a little less, since in a time like this too little is safer than too much. Do the near thing a little better than anyone else would, and go up one rung at a time. Do not reach for the great thing; it is not the hour, and reaching for it is how the year is lost. Strive downward, and let the downward striving lift you.

In the body this energy is the feet, the part of you that wants to go, held here by the hands, the part of you that keeps things where they are. Notice where you are holding yourself now. Keep the hands busy with the near thing, and let the feet stay on the ground.
judgement_lines: The small goes a little past the mark, and it goes through. It goes well for the one who holds to what is true.
Small things may be done; great things may not.
The bird on the wing leaves its call behind it: not up, but down. Great good fortune.
image_lines: Thunder on the mountain: that is the small going past the mark.
So the wise go a little far in respect, a little far in grief, a little far in thrift.

upper_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
upper_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lower_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
lower_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lines.image: a bird flying up, and misfortune.
lines.reading: A bird flies up at the very start, when it should be resting and getting ready. There is nothing up there to land on, and the hurry to get ahead is how you fall behind. Nothing can be done about it once it is done, so do not do it. Stay on the branch, and refine what you have.

lines.image: passing the grandfather, meeting the grandmother; not reaching the ruler, meeting the minister.
lines.reading: You set out for one person and meet another. Passing the grandfather you meet the grandmother; not reaching the ruler, you meet the one who serves him. You did not get as far as you meant to, and you got far enough, since the one you overlooked is the one who can help. Take what you meet, humbly, and there is no fault in it.

lines.image: no extra care taken, and a blow from behind.
lines.reading: Strong here, sure of it, you take no more care than usual, and someone comes up from behind to strike. The danger in a season of small things is the small enemy you did not think worth guarding against. Confidence is what leaves the door open. Take the precaution you think beneath you, and stay home to keep what is yours.

lines.image: no fault; meeting the moment without going past it.
lines.reading: You meet the moment as it is without going past it, and there is no fault in that. Going on from here is dangerous, so be on your guard and do not act. Do not keep gripping firmness as if it were always the right thing, because this situation will not last. Hold still, ready to change when the time does.

lines.image: dense clouds and no rain from the west; the prince takes what was in the cave with a tethered arrow.
lines.reading: The sky is heavy with cloud, no rain falls: something is building that has not broken. From the high seat you cannot make it rain alone. The prince sends a tethered arrow into a cave and brings out what was hiding there. The help you need has bowed out of sight. Look for it low down, among the ones who left the centre.

lines.image: passing by without meeting, and the bird flying too far.
lines.reading: At the top the bird does not come down at all. It passes the moment it should have met and flies on into the high air, past the flock, where nothing meets it. This is the pheasant crowing at heaven, the work that claims more than is true, and the harm is your own making. Know how to come back, as well as how to go on.

gene_keys.shadow:
Knowing the name of a thing is where this energy goes wrong, because a name is not the thing. Look at a tree through the clever mind and you see what you were taught, its name, its kind, never the tree. That mind lives on facts, and a fact cannot exist without a name, so a life built from facts is a life built out of words, on sand. Today's facts are tomorrow's fables. Your days run on numbers, the bank, the phone, and it is hard to see how much of what you take for the world is only a thing said about it.

You were not born like this. A child is already intelligent, in the way it moves its arms, in the brightness of its eyes, and school put information in until the brightness went quiet. Intelligence is of the heart, cleverness of the head, and the head will argue to the end rather than give itself up.
gene_keys.repressive: Turned inward, this becomes a person lost in the small things. The details are where they go not to feel what hurts, and the days fill until there is no room for what they might have made. It is not the details that hold them but the mind, using them as crutch and enemy.
gene_keys.reactive: Aimed at other people, it is a mind that cannot switch off. This person questions everything, and takes a pleasure in the obscure fact that proves someone else wrong, because looking at others is how they avoid looking in. Under it is a rage kept in a bottle, and something opens the bottle most days.
gene_keys.gift:
Precision is the heart in charge with the mind in its service, and it is warmer than the word sounds. It begins the day the questioning turns round on itself: the one lost in details starts to wonder why, and the one who used facts as a weapon finds that the misery was self-made, from years of looking at anything but their own pain. Then the windows are clean. You look at the tree, take it in, its aliveness, before you reach for its name, and the name comes out right because it came second.

This exactness is not stiffness. It is knowing which pattern is true and which only looks it, then putting people where they belong to each other, the way the seasons are exact without a clock. Sometimes the order has to go through disorder to arrive, and you can move through both without losing your footing. People cannot help listening when the heart is doing the arranging. The fear that comes with it, of being laughed at for speaking from the heart, is the sign that you are.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Nobody is home, and what is done from here cannot be wrong. The words no longer come through the mind at all; they come up out of the silence, plain, and there are fewer of them the higher you go, because they keep dissolving back into it. What has influence now is not what you make but the moment you make it in, the presence behind the act. A song never heard by anyone is not lost; the making of it stays, and it is the only thing that does.

Nothing in you is out of place, even the broken parts. A bowl mended with gold in the cracks is worth more than the one that never broke, and you are that bowl. Fear is gone, which is only to say there is no one left to be afraid, and the woodpecker, that small bird with the bright throat, goes on finding its food in the dead tree.
gene_keys.programming_partner: The genetic partner here is UL 61, Celestial Remembrance. It is the same pair, working a different seam. Where the pairing as a couple is the felt union of silence and speech, as programming partners these two run the split in the human mind itself, one trying to reach truth through the mind and one through bypassing it, and they only resolve when the heart is given the lead over both.

human_design.gate:
Getting ready is the pressure this energy puts on you. Gate 62 is where it comes through: the drive to take something vast and give it a handle a person can hold, to know the facts, the small things, so that when the time comes nothing is missing. It puts a hard idea into plain, practical words, one step after another, so that others can use it. This is a voice of reason, grounded on what can be checked.

From outside it can look like fussing. The way it fails is over-preparing: the plan becomes more important than the thing it was for, the lists grow to keep the fear of not being ready at bay, and the present moment goes by unattended. People who carry this all their lives learn that they will know what they need to know when they need to know it, and that readiness was never in the plan. It was in trusting what arrives.
human_design.centre:
This pressure comes out at the throat, the Throat Centre, the crossroads of a person: everything in you is trying to get here, and it is the one place where an inside thing becomes a word or an act. It cannot move anything by itself. It is the part that turns whatever it is joined to into speech, and here it is joined to the mind, so what comes out is your view of how things are, with the details in place. That kind of voice is meant to be asked for. Given before anyone asked, the same facts that would have been medicine turn to poison in the listener, and you are left having filled the room with your best thinking to no purpose. Speak before you act, and speak when asked.

In about seven people in ten this centre is switched on, so such a person can always say something; the voice is reliable, one tone, and it goes out whether or not anyone is ready. For someone like that the work is not finding the words but holding them until the hour. In the other three it is not, so the voice is borrowed from whoever is near and has many tones instead of one. For someone like that this drive gives the borrowed voice somewhere to stand: on the details, on what can be checked, a plain practical voice in a room full of opinions.
human_design.channel: Details are a pile, not an order. The other half of this is Gate 17, behind the brow, the mind's view of how things could go, and the two make the Channel of Acceptance: a way of seeing that has been given its facts, an order other people can take in. The view supplies the shape, the details supply the ground it stands on, and what comes out is a hard thing broken into steps a stranger can follow. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the order only holds where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: Within the Ring of No Return, this code is the speaker. Its one sibling, UL 31, is the leader whose influence carries, and together they hold the throat's great initiation, the moment a voice begins to transmit truth and cannot take it back. Once a word of light is spoken it goes out into the world for good. There is no return. That is the name and the law of this small family.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The Tarot reaches this card from two directions at once. The codon ring gives one Arcana, Judgement, the trumpet that wakes the dead. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Thunder above as the Tower and Judgement, the shock that breaks and the call that raises; Mountain below as the Hierophant and the Hermit, the keeper of the teaching and the one who carries the lamp alone. What they make together is a sound that breaks open the old, and a quiet that knows what to do with the space.

body.physiology:
Your throat is where this energy is kept, and the reason is the hum. Everything you have ever said began as a small hum, two folds no longer than a fingernail fluttering a hundred times a second or more, and the mouth cut that hum into words on its way out. The voice is made in the throat; the words are made after. Before there were words there was only that sound, the sigh, the groan, and speech was learned by shaping it. Sitting low across the front of the throat is the thyroid, the gland whose whole day's work is a fleck, held within a narrow band, and that fleck sets the pace of everything in you.

Lay a hand flat on your throat and hum. The buzz under your palm is the thing itself. Now whisper the same word: the buzz is gone, because a whisper is breath through folds left ajar, and what you felt a moment ago is what every word of yours is built from.
body.amino_acid:
What the head is sure of can be talked out of it; what the body is sure of cannot, and the only thing the body is that sure of is love. That sureness has a substance in you, and the substance is tyrosine, one of the twenty small pieces you are built from, which your body makes for itself, so it is never missing. As your words get more exact, light comes through you in them, and what they are spoken through was made in you before you chose them, unasked.

Every word, once it has left you, does not come back, and the substance it was made of is shared with the part of you that leads other people by words. Open an old hard cheese and find the white grains that crunch: that is the thing itself, come out as the cheese dried over the years.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 61, this is the whole of how truth comes through, the knowing that arrives in silence and the language that carries it into the world.

pair.teaching: Together with Celestial Remembrance, these two are the inner knowing and its outer voice. Its pair receives the truth in the still centre, wordless and direct. This code is what gives that truth a language and speaks it. One is the mystery felt, the other the mystery told. Inner Truth without a voice stays locked in. A voice without inner truth is only clever noise.

inverse.teaching: This code is one of the eight that turn over and stay themselves. Flip the lines and the bird is still the bird, the small still exceeding the great by a touch. It means the teaching here is whole on its own, with no opposite reading hidden in it. Whichever way you come at the small preponderance, it asks the same thing, come down rather than climb.

programming_partner.teaching: The genetic partner here is UL 61, Celestial Remembrance. It is the same pair, working a different seam. Where the pairing as a couple is the felt union of silence and speech, as programming partners these two run the split in the human mind itself, one trying to reach truth through the mind and one through bypassing it, and they only resolve when the heart is given the lead over both.

codon_ring.teaching: Within the Ring of No Return, this code is the speaker. Its one sibling, UL 31, is the leader whose influence carries, and together they hold the throat's great initiation, the moment a voice begins to transmit truth and cannot take it back. Once a word of light is spoken it goes out into the world for good. There is no return. That is the name and the law of this small family.

The two trigrams each give their own faces: Thunder above as the Tower and Judgement, the shock that breaks and the call that raises; Mountain below as the Hierophant and the Hermit, the keeper of the teaching and the one who carries the lamp alone. What they make together is a sound that breaks open the old, and a quiet that knows what to do with the space.

sky.teaching: the element of light and transmission, the spark that leaps from one to another and changes what it touches, never the same twice.

immortals.teaching: Cao Guo Jiu stands above, the noble who walked away from the inherited court to find a truer ground, and Zhang Guo Lao below, the old hermit who rides his donkey facing backwards, seeing where he came from more clearly than where he goes. Neither faces the way a great man should, one having walked out of the rank he was born to, the other riding with his back to the road ahead.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the fire of a new age, the transforming flame, the sound that breaks the old form to make way for the next. The path runs from Hod, the place of language and intellect, down to Malkuth, the world, which is the journey of this whole code, word coming all the way down into matter.

cards.essence: After something is finished, the questions begin. That is when you get curious about how the thing works, part by part, and whether it will hold. You go back over what everyone else has stopped looking at. There is always one more question behind the last one.

glance.reading:
After something is finished, the questions begin. That is when you get curious about how the thing works, part by part, and whether it will hold. You go back over what everyone else has stopped looking at. There is always one more question behind the last one.

Turned on the world around you, this curiosity finds the flaw everyone else missed and makes the thing work better. You take a theory or an engine apart piece by piece, and what you learn on the way is worth more than any one answer.

Some days the questions turn away from the thing you made and onto you, and you start doubting yourself. Tell someone you trust what is bothering you, and it starts to pass. Do not act in a hurry just to stop feeling unsure. Once everything is in its place, stay alert, because that is when a finished thing starts to slip. Some questions never get a final answer, and once you stop pushing for one, you can rest.

iching.trigram_combination: Water over Fire is the hexagram of what comes after a thing is done. Fire is the clarity in you that sets each part of your work where it belongs. Water is the part of you that knows where the danger still is. The watching sits above the order because once a thing is done, keeping it is the work that is left. This hexagram has long been read as a pot of water over a flame. Tend both, and the water boils. Let either run wild, and it puts an end to the other. You are never more at risk than when everything is in its place.
iching.reading:
The crossing is behind you, and what you set out to do is done. Every part of it is in its place. What is left is small, the settling in and the tidying up. This is where the danger lies. A thing in perfect order can move only one way, toward disorder. People stop watching once a matter is settled, and that is when they are most exposed. So the good fortune comes at the start of this time, and the disorder at its end.

Think about trouble while there is none, so you are ready when it comes. Keep going in the small things the way you did in the large ones. Think of the people who depend on what you have built, and put their good before your own. Know more than you use, and keep some of your strength back.

Your eyes and ears do the work now. The eyes go over what is finished. The ears catch the first drip of a leak. Sit the way someone sits when the day's work is done, with loose hands and open ears.
judgement_lines: After completion. Success in small things, and it goes well for the one who keeps on.
At the beginning good fortune. At the end, disorder.
image_lines: Water over fire: the pot on the flame, in balance for as long as it is watched.
So the wise take thought of trouble before it comes, and are ready for it in advance.

upper_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
upper_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lower_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
lower_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lines.image: the wheels held back, and the fox with its tail in the water.
lines.reading: You brake the wheels at the water's edge, and the fox's tail is wet from the crossing. The work is done and the next has not begun. The wheels skid because you are ready to go before it is time. Go slowly until you know where you are heading, and no blame comes of it.

lines.image: a woman who has lost the curtain of her carriage.
lines.reading: The curtain is gone from your carriage, and people can see in. Something that kept you private is lost, and you want to run after it. Chasing it would cost you your balance. Left alone, it comes back by the seventh day. Stay where you are and let it return.

lines.image: the great ancestor who took three years to subdue the far country.
lines.reading: The old king takes three years to win the far country, and he is worn out by it. Some things are finished only by a long campaign, well past the point where the end seemed near. Leave small-minded people out of it, since they can neither see the plan nor help carry it. Call on the unusual helper, and give it the years it takes.

lines.image: the finest clothes turning to rags, and rags kept ready for a leak.
lines.reading: The finest clothes turn to rags, so keep rags ready for the leak. In the middle of plenty something is already going thin. Doubt is useful here, the kind that looks for the drip before the boat fills. Be careful all day long while things are good.

lines.image: the neighbour in the east who kills an ox, the neighbour in the west with a small offering.
lines.reading: One neighbour kills an ox for the offering, and the other brings a little. The little is what is blessed. What counts is that you mean what you give, and give it at the right time. A cup already full has no room for anything to arrive. Give the small, honest thing, and the blessing comes in full.

lines.image: the head gone under the water.
lines.reading: Your head goes under the water at the end of the crossing. You kept going at full pace after the work was done, unable to stop. Now what you gained is slipping back into the river. Nothing here lasts, and that is the warning. Leave a finished thing while leaving is still your choice.

gene_keys.shadow:
Uncertainty is a pressure most people cannot bear. Whatever you settle, the doubt moves on to the next thing, and nothing ends it. So people take on a firm set of beliefs and hold them up against the doubt like a wall. Anyone who offers to end your uncertainty for good is selling you something false. Doubt is not the enemy. It turns harmful when you make it personal. Pushed out, it falls on the people closest to you. Turned in, it becomes doubt about yourself.

Here the mind works in the wrong order. Shown a sunset, it hears only its own words about it and is already thinking of tomorrow. Take a thing in first, and examine it after.
gene_keys.repressive: Held down, the doubt turns on the one holding it and runs on comparison. They measure themselves against everyone, come up short, then believe the measuring. Fear fixes it there, and it eats away at them as a steady worry. Nothing they do or say is ever good enough.
gene_keys.reactive: Let out, the same doubt becomes suspicion, and it falls on those closest. They doubt a partner, a boss, even their own child. The other person grows defensive, which looks like proof, so every round feeds the next. They call it being sceptical. A true sceptic has not made up their mind. This one made it up long ago.
gene_keys.gift:
Inquiry is doubt put to work. You can ask all your life without needing an answer to end it. A mind that fixes on one answer as the truth must defend it, and someone will always attack. An open mind has nothing to defend. It has the lightness of a child at play.

Ask deeply enough into anything and you find you are part of what you are looking at. From there the asking turns inward. What am I, asks the mind. What is love, asks the heart over and over, and it needs no final answer. A mind kept open grows soft, and an open mind opens the heart.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Truth arrives when the question swallows the one asking it. You climbed for years toward an answer and wore yourself out on the way. At the top you found it had been at the foot all along, before you took a step. Trusted far enough, doubt turns out to be the truth itself, and the doubter dissolves into it.

Then there is rest, like sitting under a tree on a warm evening after walking all day. Every sigh brings you nearer to it, and so does every time your face softens. It is your plain state, closer than your own heartbeat. It is there at every step of the way.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy moves one step at a time, testing each before the next. Communion holds what it lacks: the whole picture that arrives at once and cannot be taken apart. The mind that asks feeds the mind that imagines, and neither knows much without the other. Open it when your questions have run out and nothing new has come.

human_design.gate: Gate 63 sits at the top of your head and asks what comes next. It looks ahead to see which path will hold, what to follow and what to leave. It works by testing the next step before you take it, and it can tell a real teacher from a fake. Its fear is being wrong. Under the fear is a craving for certainty that no next step can meet.
human_design.centre:
The Head Center sits at the crown and is where questions start. It presses for an answer and cannot act on one, so every question it raises is carried down to be worked on somewhere else.

About three people in ten have this centre defined, and they always know what they think. Ask them where to eat and they already have an answer. Their thinking runs within set lines, so what they cannot picture they tend to refuse at first, and they are not always right. The other seven in ten have it open. They can see every side of a question and hold no fixed view. A thought does not stay with them for long, and a whole answer sometimes drops in from nowhere. A mind at rest is possible for them.
human_design.channel: A question alone is only pressure. Gate 4, in the mind just below, is the drive to turn a doubt into a formula. Together they make the Channel of Logic, which turns a doubt into a way of checking. It finds the flaw others miss, then proves a claim or drops it. It works best when someone has asked for the answer. Gate 4 may be in you or in a person close by, and the question is answered only when both are present.

tarot.ring_role: This energy asks, and asking is how every search begins. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Divinity, whose theme is suffering that opens you. UL 22, Treasure of the Way, carries grace. UL 36, Crystal Creation, carries the dark stretch that tests you. UL 37, Journey Home, carries the warmth of a family. This one carries the first question.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
Sleep is the reason this energy is given to the pineal gland. The gland is the part of you that says the day is finished. About two hours before your usual bedtime it begins to tell your body that night has come. It says only that it is night, and leaves the sleeping to you. On some evenings your head lets go when it hears this, and on others the questions go on.

It keeps a clock that runs a little longer than a day. Each morning the first light through your eyes sets it again. Kept in dim light, a person drifts later day by day, and a morning outdoors puts it right. In animals that breed by the season, the length of its night is how the body knows the time of year.
body.amino_acid:
The doubt in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is proline. Every protein in you is built from twenty pieces, and this is the one that turns the chain wherever it sits. When fear takes hold of doubt, heavy hormones go through you. Self-doubt taken all the way drains the body at that level, until your strength is simply gone.

Every person carries the same discomfort of not remembering who they truly are, and all people are equal in this one suffering. You share its chemistry with three other energies.

relations.unity_line: UL 64 is this card's pair, its inverse and its partner at once: the crossing still ahead, where this one has it behind.

pair.teaching: This energy asks how a finished thing works, and it runs out when the last question is answered. Communion is where it goes next: the open time before completion, where a new picture forms. Open it when every question has been answered and something new is waiting to begin. Each finish is the start of the next crossing.

inverse.teaching: Turn this energy end for end and what is finished becomes what is not yet done. Communion is the same river seen from the bank not yet reached. Open it when the order you made starts to feel too tidy to trust. Nothing stays finished for long.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy moves one step at a time, testing each before the next. Communion holds what it lacks: the whole picture that arrives at once and cannot be taken apart. The mind that asks feeds the mind that imagines, and neither knows much without the other. Open it when your questions have run out and nothing new has come.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Divinity
codon_ring.teaching: This energy asks, and asking is how every search begins. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Divinity, whose theme is suffering that opens you. UL 22, Treasure of the Way, carries grace. UL 36, Crystal Creation, carries the dark stretch that tests you. UL 37, Journey Home, carries the warmth of a family. This one carries the first question.

tarot.teaching: Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the fixed earth that keeps what has been built, steady and in no hurry to chase the next thing.

immortals.teaching: Water above carries Li Tie Guai, the healer who keeps his medicine in a gourd for the day it is needed. Fire below carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar who turned his sword on his own delusion. One keeps the cure ready, and the other cuts through a false certainty.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the nail that fastens one thing to another, so what is finished does not come loose.

cards.essence: Before completion, a thing is almost made and still open to change. Imagination lives in that stretch, showing you the shape and colour of what you are making long before your hands get there. The pictures come whole and out of order, often in the middle of a change.

glance.reading:
Before completion, a thing is almost made and still open to change. Imagination lives in that stretch, showing you the shape and colour of what you are making long before your hands get there. The pictures come whole and out of order, often in the middle of a change.

Seeing the picture is half of this gift, and making it is the rest. That takes nerve, because what you make will change the life you have. You can ride imagination the way you would ride a wild horse, only as far as it agrees to go. It cannot be hurried: try to work it all out in your head and it shuts down. Leave it be, and it hands you the next piece as you build. So your life becomes a work in progress, and nothing in it is ever quite finished.

There are stretches when nothing will settle and no picture is clear. Your mind will want a reason and something to do. Every step you take just to end the not knowing makes it worse. What these stretches need is time. Given that, the pictures come back. Near the end, keep your eyes on the work in front of you, because the picture can make a thing feel done before it is.

iching.trigram_combination: Fire over Water is the hexagram of being nearly across. Fire is the clearness in you that tells one thing from another. Water is the risk you are still standing in. The clearness sits above the risk because you can see where you are going long before you are out of danger. That is why this hexagram has long been read as a young fox crossing a river. A step from the bank it thinks it is across, its tail goes in the water, and it cannot go on. Fire climbs and water sinks, so the two draw apart until each is set in its place. You can see clearly and still be in danger.
iching.reading:
You are nearly across, and the last stretch is the one that decides it. Most of what you set out to do is done. The far bank is so close that watching your step now feels foolish. This is the moment the fox wets its tail. It acts as if it were across before it is, and loses the whole crossing at the last step.

What this time asks is that you check what is done before you call it done. Look at each part of what you have made and ask what it is really doing. Fire can warm water or boil it away, and water can cool a fire or put it out. The same two things help or harm depending on where they sit. So put each thing where it does its good.

Your feet are the last of you to cross, so keep your attention on them until you are out. Take the last step as carefully as the first. Wanting to be across is not the same as being across.
judgement_lines: Not yet across. Even so, it grows.
The young fox, nearly over, wets its tail.
Nothing is gained by forcing it.
image_lines: Fire above water, each going its own way.
So the wise one tells things apart with care and keeps each in its place.

upper_trigram.name: Fire (Li)
upper_trigram.nature: Glowing light spreading in all directions. The power of consciousness. Magical fire-bird. The middle daughter.

lower_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
lower_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lines.image: its tail in the water before the first real step.
lines.reading: Your tail is wet before the first real step. You set out to finish the whole thing from the very bottom, before you knew where your reach ended. The shame is small and it passes. Learn where your reach ends before you take the next step.

lines.image: a wheel dragged back, the cart held on the bank.
lines.reading: You drag the wheels and hold the cart back on the bank. From outside it can look like lost nerve, the way a skilled hand can look clumsy. It is strength kept for the moment it is needed. Hold to the middle of the road and it goes well.

lines.image: far bank in sight, the army wanting to march.
lines.reading: The far bank is in sight and you want to charge at it. Set out from here on your own strength and it goes badly. The river can still be crossed with help. Let someone who has been further carry you over.

lines.image: thunder loosed on the demon country, three years of it.
lines.reading: You stay true and the regret burns off. Now comes a long campaign against old habits that will not leave on their own. It takes three years, because what is true is slow to come back and what is false is slow to go. Keep at it and the reward is a whole country.

lines.image: a clear person's brightness, true all the way through.
lines.reading: The false shine has gone and a steadier light stands in its place. You are calm and quick at once. Nothing here needs regret. Your light is true, so let people see it.

lines.image: wine drunk in good faith, then the head going under.
lines.reading: The crossing is made, and you drink with the others in good faith. There is no fault in that. Drink until your head goes under and the good faith is gone. Too much trust at the end is the same mistake as too much doubt at the start. Keep your measure now.

gene_keys.shadow:
Confusion is what a mind feels when everything in it has come loose and nothing has its order yet. It comes when what you knew about yourself stops holding. In itself it is full of what could be. It turns painful only when the mind tries to explain it. The mind wants a reason, then something to do, then the old order back.

Being unfinished is hard to bear, so the pull is to keep things as they were. A change that was trying to move you gets pressed back into its old shape. While it lasts you feel alone in it.
gene_keys.repressive: Holding that much unease down takes the help of everyone else. So this nature copies. It follows its parents and its friends, and while everyone agrees nobody has to feel anything. Copying is the one thing imagination cannot live beside, though some manage to look original while they do it.
gene_keys.reactive: This nature cannot keep the unease down at all, so it spills out into the life. Closeness breaks in the same place again and again. The anger is aimed at a world that seems to have everything settled. The whole life becomes a way of getting even with life.
gene_keys.gift:
Imagination begins when you stop trying to make the not knowing go away. The mind that was busy explaining goes quiet. The energy it was using comes back to you, and you start to make things with it. What arrives first is often the ache you were trying to avoid. Give it a shape in paint, in words or in a song, and it begins to change in your hands. Keep going, and the fears you drew at the start turn out to hold something good.

Imagination is also the end of copying. It goes where nobody has been, too quick and too wild to stop and explain itself. It will not keep to what you did last year. It asks you to let your life keep changing.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Illumination is imagination that no longer belongs to you. The pictures and words still come, and they are made for whoever needs them. You stay empty while they pour through you.

Near such a person the eyes seem to shine and the room seems to shimmer. You hear such people only once you stop listening for the meaning. In the quiet between their words something true gets across.
gene_keys.programming_partner: This energy moves by leaps, and a leap needs somewhere steady to land. Adornments of Time holds what it lacks: reasoning that tests each step before it takes the next. One is the way of the artist and the other the way of the scientist. Open it when the picture is clear and nobody can follow how you got there.

human_design.gate: Gate 64 sits at the top of your head, where the question how begins. It fills with pictures: images, dreams and pieces of the past that arrive out of order. You can see them long before you can explain them. Along a straight line they read as a mess, which is why the gate is named for confusion. The pressure is to answer at once how each picture becomes real. Answered too early, that question shuts the dreaming down and leaves you tired and low.
human_design.centre:
The Head Center sits at the crown of your head and does one thing: it asks. It is one of two centres in the body that run on pressure, so a question and the push to answer it arrive together. It has no motor of its own and cannot act on anything it asks. It is not where a decision is made either. Most of us treat its questions as orders and move before the answer has come. Others turn the pressure inward, and it becomes worry.

About three people in ten have this centre defined. Their minds keep asking all day, and even while the pictures are unclear they know the mind is working on something. The other seven in ten have it open. They take in the questions of everyone around them and feel them louder than their own. Asked what they think, they can go blank. For them the relief is in noticing whose question it is.
human_design.channel: The Channel of Abstraction joins this gate to Gate 47, just below it in the Ajna. The head hands its pictures down, and Gate 47 turns them over until they mean something. Together they think in images and leaps, and they learn best with no set order. Without Gate 47, in you or in someone you are with, the pictures keep arriving and never add up.

tarot.ring_role: This energy turns a loose state into something new, and it does not do it alone. It belongs to a family of four called the Ring of Alchemy. UL 6 breaks down the walls between people, UL 40 builds that openness into communities, and UL 47 lets old ways change. This one opens a fresh set of possibilities.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

body.physiology:
The pineal gland carries this energy, and the reason is light. It is the size of a grain of rice and sits in the middle of your head, where no daylight ever reaches. It learns whether the sun is up from your eyes, by a long road down into the neck and back. When the eyes report that the light has gone, it lets out the hormone of the dark and your body begins to slow. So a gland that lives in the dark keeps your day by light.

Sit in a dim room in the evening and within an hour or two you feel yourself grow heavy. Switch on a bright screen and the gland reads it as day, and the heaviness holds off. In some lizards its relative is a third eye under the skin of the crown, with a lens of its own.
body.amino_acid:
The light that lies hidden in you until it is ready to show has a substance, and it is glycine. It is the smallest of the twenty pieces your proteins are built from. Your body makes its own and takes in more from meat, fish and the jelly a cooled stock sets into. In your brain it sits at the gate where memory is laid down, and that gate will not open until glycine is in its seat.

You share this substance with three kin, and together the four change one state into the next. That change has long been told in colours. It starts black and passes through white and yellow to the red of gold. So whatever feels dark in you now is where that change begins.

relations.unity_line: Read with UL 63, this is the two banks of one river, the crossing not yet made and the crossing already behind you.

pair.teaching: Imagination runs out the moment the thing it pictured is finished. Adornments of Time is where it goes next: the curiosity that asks how the finished thing works and finds its flaw. Open it when what you made has to be looked after. A thing that is built still has to be kept.

inverse.teaching: This energy stands in the river and looks at the far bank. Turned end for end it stands on that bank and looks back. Adornments of Time is that view. It is this energy's pair, partner and inverse at once.

programming_partner.teaching: This energy moves by leaps, and a leap needs somewhere steady to land. Adornments of Time holds what it lacks: reasoning that tests each step before it takes the next. One is the way of the artist and the other the way of the scientist. Open it when the picture is clear and nobody can follow how you got there.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Alchemy
codon_ring.teaching: This energy turns a loose state into something new, and it does not do it alone. It belongs to a family of four called the Ring of Alchemy. UL 6 breaks down the walls between people, UL 40 builds that openness into communities, and UL 47 lets old ways change. This one opens a fresh set of possibilities.

tarot.teaching: Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.

sky.teaching: the quick messenger moving between two shores with the word not yet delivered, the right sky for a crossing held open.

immortals.teaching: Fire above carries Lu Dong Bin, the scholar tested ten times before he was let through. He wears a sword and drives out whatever haunts a place. Water below carries Li Tie Guai, the healer who came back through his own death with his medicine in a gourd. One found clarity by trial, the other a cure by dying.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the room that gives a work four walls and a roof. Even a step from the bank an unfinished thing needs one, or it comes apart.
